layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Normal Irregularities Are Bad Enough

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 10. (C) Even without the extraordinary events described above, the process of selecting city leaders has always been one of the most opaque and corrupt aspects of Morocco's Communal Election process. According to International Republican Institute (IRI) training implementer Jamie Tronnes (protect), the Mayoral selection process is heavily influenced through the giving and taking of bribes. She said that while this election was no exception to the rule, increased government scrutiny over government-provided campaign funds had given increased incentive to parties to recruit wealthy individuals into parties to contribute to parties "slush funds." Tronnes pointed to political "kidnapping," of Council members to resort hotels (with their families) for the duration of the selection negotiations, rewards the councilors and denies competitors the opportunity to make counter offers so that, "once a candidate is bought, they stay bought."

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 11. (C) PAM success have been blunted a bit by a large number of legal challenges, at least tow of which it has already lost, including its new star, the young women mayor it had gotten elected in Marrakech, who has been ordered to face a rerun of the election in the district (septel). PAM officials indicate they will be fighting these challenges in court and appealing decisions that have gone against them.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 12. (S) One uncertainty in this is the role of the King. He was in the north through much of the unfortunate events in Oujda. Unconfirmed accounts have indicated that it was at his personal order that the PJD was kept out of the large cities. One source claimed that the King was pouring a lot of the government's money into the previously neglected north and particularly into the Oujda region, on Algeria's border, in order to prepare regional infrastructure for a potential reopening. The source said the King did not want the PJD to be able to claim credit for this largesse and the development it would promote.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: COMMENT

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 12. (C) As usual in Moroccan politics, this is a mixed bag with an unclear bottom line that points to both ongoing evolution and continued monarchical autocracy. Despite the relative transparency and success of the local Communal Elections on June 12 (Ref A), the subsequent Professional Elections for the selection of Mayors appears to represent at least a partial step backward for Moroccan democracy. For the PAM, despite having secured a plurality of council seats nationwide, elected hundreds of young reformers new to politics, and won leadership of some major cities, it has tarnished its effort to paint itself as a standard bearer of democratization. The combination of the PAM's extra-normal pressure tactics and its joint efforts with security officials to block PJD city leadership has largely confirmed previous criticism that it is an instrument of the Palace. But it too suffered several setbacks, as in Sahara. While probably still destined for victory in 2012, it will be subject to greater scrutiny.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: For the PJD, it may have been kept out of running major cities, both by normal hardball politics and, at least in Oujda by apparently blatant intervention by security and domestic intelligence services, denying it the chance showcase any example of good governance in a high profile city prior to the 2012 general election. Still, the modern Islamists of the PJD now run more cites than ever before and their number of local councilors remains 50 percent above what it scored last time around. In sum, this is enough of a

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: blow to frustrate them, but probably not enough to drive them from the game. The outcome may well erode further public support for Morocco's democratic processes, and future voter participation. But while the political season of cascading regional and upper house elections will continue run until October, and the legal fights will continue, on the local level, the public will turn to see how they govern. End Comment.

layout_dets.text: The FY 2009 request seeks \(2.5 million to support the expenses of the Inspector General. layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The Export-Import Bank of the United States is an independent executive agency and a wholly-owned U.S. Government corporation. Ex-Im Bank is the official export credit agency of the United States. Its mission is to support U.S. exports by providing export financing through its loan, guarantee, and insurance programs in cases where the private sector is unable or unwilling to provide financing or when such support is necessary to level the playing field due to financing provided by foreign governments to their exporters that are in competition for export sales with U.S. exporters. By facilitating the financing of U.S. exports, Ex-Im Bank helps companies create and maintain U.S. jobs. The Bank actively assists small and medium-sized businesses.

layout_dets.label: 表格

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The Overseas Private Investment Corporation (OPIC) is a self-sustaining agency that mobilizes American private investment by providing political risk insurance and financing in support of U.S. foreign policy in 156 developing nations and emerging markets around the world.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: OPIC's FY 2009 budget is fully self-funded. From its estimated offsetting collections of \(249.6 million in FY 2009, OPIC is requesting \)50.6 million for administrative expenses and $29 million for credit funding. This amount will support an estimated $1.8 billion in new direct loans and loan guaranties.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: OPIC will focus its efforts on quality projects that are highly developmental, based on both sector and geographic location. Based on U.S. development and foreign policy priorities, OPIC will place special emphasis on small business, investments in Africa, the broader Middle East, and Central America, and continue to increase private sector cooperation, increase the availability of housing for the developing world, and encourage renewable energy projects.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Private sector investment support provided by OPIC is market driven, and as a result, efficiently aligns government resources with projects that are most likely to drive economic growth. For many countries that have moved beyond basic humanitarian assistance, OPIC is an effective and efficient way to promote private sector growth. OPIC's goal is to generate "additionality" on each transaction it conducts, meaning OPIC is able to add value to every investment it supports.

layout_dets.text: U.S. Trade and Development Agency

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The Administration is requesting $50.8 million for the U.S. Trade and Development Agency (USTDA) in FY 2009. This request maintains USTDA's ability to spur economic development and advance U.S. commercial interests in developing and middle-income countries.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: USTDA's FY 2009 budget request encompasses USTDA's assistance programs which support key trade and foreign policy objectives of the Administration, including: 1) Promoting global energy security by providing early investment analysis and technical assistance designed to identify, develop, and transport to market new oil and gas reserves, while placing a high priority on projects that stimulate the development of alternative fuels, deploy technologies that promote the clean and efficient use of resources, and improve energy efficiency; 2) Applying environmental technologies in countries where there is need for significant improvement in areas such as water treatment, air quality, and hazardous waste management; 3) Ensuring secure and safe trade by assisting countries to comply with international safety and security regulations in aviation, rail, and maritime transport, which helps to improve their economies and meet higher security standards that are now required in international trade; and 4) Enhancing regional integration initiatives that support program activities which advance bilateral, regional, and global development assistance activities.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: USTDA's strategic use of foreign assistance funds to support sound investment policy and decision-making in host countries creates an enabling environment for trade, investment, and sustainable economic development. In carrying out its mission, USTDA places emphasis on economic sectors that benefit from exports of U.S. goods and services. USTDA provides a bridge to U.S. technical know-how and experience for developing and middle-income countries. The focus of the agency is unique in creating public-private partnerships that respond to foreign project sponsor needs and priorities. USTDA's programs help to identify and prepare projects for implementation that will establish the infrastructure necessary for economies to expand. At the same time, the agency's activities develop trade partnerships by enhancing the ability of U.S. firms to conduct business overseas through a variety of trade capacity building and technical assistance programs.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The agency uses various tools to facilitate U.S. business opportunities in the international marketplace. This support comes in the form of technical assistance, feasibility studies, orientation visits, training grants and conferences. USTDA has a proven capability to rapidly and effectively respond to new Administration priorities as they emerge. As a result of these early investments, USTDA is well positioned to continue its support of the Administration's efforts to create sustainable democratic societies within emerging states as well as throughout the Middle East. Moreover, USTDA continues to ensure that its programs remain results oriented and successfully deliver commercial foreign assistance by taking on an increasingly visible role in providing trade capacity-building assistance around the world.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The FY 2009 request of $1.58 billion for the Child Survival and Health Programs Fund (CSH) reflects the President's continuing commitment to improve interventions that address critical worldwide needs for HIV/AIDS, malaria, tuberculosis, other infectious diseases (including avian influenza), maternal and child health and nutrition, and family planning, as well as those of vulnerable children. Programs expand basic health services and strengthen national systems to significantly improve health and wellbeing especially of women, children, and other vulnerable populations.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: CSH funds are focused on countries where impact will be maximized based on the country's complete development picture, including consideration of health indicators, host country absorptive capacity, and the totality of U.S. and other donor resources in country. Allocation decisions for HIV/AIDS activities are planned in collaboration with the Office of the Global AIDS Coordinator in order to maximize complementarities with health interventions requested under the Global HIV/AIDS Initiative account.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Highlights:

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - $385.0 million to support the President's Malaria Initiative (PMI) that was expanded from seven to fifteen high-burden countries in FY 2007 and other ongoing malaria programs. Activities include prevention (spraying, insecticide-treated nets, and intermittent preventive therapy during pregnancy) and treatment.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - $342.03 million for HIV/AIDS programs to focus on prevention, care, and treatment efforts, and the support of children affected by AIDS in over 90 countries. This funding is an important component of the President's Emergency Plan for AIDS Relief (PEPFAR). The bulk of the funding for HIV/AIDS programming under PEPFAR is requested in the GHAI account. For additional information on PEPFAR, please refer to Annex A.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - $369.5 million for Child Survival and Maternal Health (CSMH) programs, focusing especially on increasing the availability and use of proven life-saving interventions, such as newborn care, immunization, community treatment of pneumonia, and treatment and prevention of postpartum hemorrhage, that address the major killers of mothers and children and improve their health and nutrition.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - $301.7 million for Family Planning and Reproductive Health (FP/RH) programs, focusing on programs that improve and expand access to high-quality voluntary family planning services and information, as well as other reproductive health care.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - $50 million to support programs to contain or prevent an avian influenza pandemic.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - $84.5 million for programs to combat tuberculosis, which is a major cause of death and debilitating illness throughout much of the developing world. Activities focus on effectively treating tuberculosis and preventing and treating multi-drug resistant and extensively drug resistant tuberculosis. USAID collaborates with PEPFAR on programs for HIV/TB co-infected individuals.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - \(35.1 million for other public health threats, including \)25 million for the President's new Neglected Tropical Diseases Initiative and $10.1 million for water supply and sanitation.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - $10 million for vulnerable children, including programs for displaced children and orphans.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The FY 2009 request represents an increase over the FY 2008 estimated levels for malaria, other public health threats, and water supply and sanitation.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The FY 2009 requests for funding for family planning and reproductive health, maternal and child health, avian influenza, and tuberculosis reflect the continuing recognition and Administration priority to address these important health problems. Over \(31\%\) of funds for these purposes are allocated to Africa, where health problems are the most severe.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The request for HIV/AIDS in CSH includes \(12.7 million to accommodate funding for Europe and Eurasia countries previously funded through the FSA and SEED accounts. A \)200 million contribution to the Global Fund for AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria is requested within the GHAI account. In FY 2009, as in FY 2008, a $300 million contribution to the Global Fund for AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria is requested within the Department of Health and Human Services' National Institutes of Health budget.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: For FY 2009, Sudan health programs which were requested in the ESF account for FY 2008 are requested from the CSH account.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: RECRUITING 3.0: WEB ADVANCES CHANGE THE LANDSCAPE

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: By SARAH E. NEEDLEMAN, published in the Wall Street Journal, February 13, 2008

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: This isn't your father's recruiting market, or even your older sister's. Advances in technology make the way jobs are found and filled online distinctly different from just a few years ago. Employers are now experimenting with innovative strategies for spreading their recruitment messages and screening candidates online. And Web-savvy job hunters are taking advantage of new Internet resources aimed at helping them make better career decisions.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Video, Podcasts and Interactive media

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Until recently, few employers produced Web videos describing what it's like to work for them. "Video is finally catching on with employers in a fairly big way," says Joel Cheesman, author of Cheezhead.com, a blog on Web recruiting.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Today's videos are a step above early examples. They're higher quality and tailored to address a variety of job hunter interests, he says. And, they're more ubiquitous, finding homes on job boards, company career sites and video-sharing sites like YouTube.com. One example: About 7,000 videos are currently posted on Jobing.com, a job board that specializes in listing career opportunities in specific geographic communities.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Similarly, a growing number of employers are creating podcasts, voiced by employees, on career-related topics. Accenture Ltd. has been producing about one a month

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: for its online career portal since mid-2006.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: To Captivate and engage job hunters, more employers are also adding interactive media to their online career portals such as games, blogs and real-time chat services.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: For example, in December, ASMLHolding N.V., an equipment supplier for the semiconductor industry, designed a recruitment-events page that job hunters can synchronize with their Microsoft Outlook calendars. Users also can opt to receive event reminders via email or text message.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Digital dirt, Digital attraction

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Scanning the Web for information that might derail a job hunter's candidacy is now routine procedure for recruiters at many firms, says Cynthia Shapiro, author of the forthcoming book, "What Does Somebody Have to Do to Get a Job Around Here" (Griffin Publishing LLC, 2008).

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Many recruiters now even engage in the practice before extending interview invites, she adds. "If what pops up is a ranting blog about the evils of corporate America or a picture of you topless in Cancun with a beer in your hand, you're in trouble," she warns. "Your resume will land in the trash and you won't even know what happened."

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Job hunters can turn the tables in their favor by creating a Web site, blog or networking profile specifically for employers, offers Ms. Shapiro. "The Internet lets you flaunt things you can't put on a resume," she says. "If you don't have that kind of presence on the Web, you are losing a

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: "Success is the ability to move from one failure to another with no loss of enthusiasm."

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - Sir Winston Churchill

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: critical opportunity to put yourself at the top of the list."

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Companies are also increasingly using social-networking sites to vet potential hires. It's ripe territory as the membership databases of these sites continue to grow rapidly. For example, five-year-old LinkedIn.com, which caters to experienced professionals, now has roughly 19 million members, up from 8 million in 2006.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Another example: Recruiters for Electronic Arts Inc. began perusing MySpace.com and Facebook.com a little over a year ago to learn more about and engage with prospective hires, says Matthew Jeffery, head of global talent brand for the gaming company. "We want people who are passionate gamers, and often on these sites, people talk about their hobbies," he says.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Job boards

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: While employers are doing more to reach out, there are also more online destinations than ever for job hunters to find employment ads.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: About 2,000 new job boards have launched annually since 2000, and there are currently about 50,000, says Peter Weddle, chief executive officer of Weddle's, a publisher of guides to job boards. Of these, about \(30\%\) are general job sites while \(70\%\) specialize in a particular niche,

layout_dets.label: 页脚
layout_dets.text: MARCH 2008

layout_dets.label: 页码
layout_dets.text: PAGE 2

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: he adds.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: One reason for the explosion: "very inexpensive entry costs," says Mark Mehler, co-founder of CareerXroads, a staffing consulting firm. Still, the nation's largest job boards saw fluctuations in traffic over the past year. For example, Monster.com had 11,317,000 unique visitors last month, about \(9\%\) less than for the same month a year earlier, according to comScore Inc., an Internet-research firm. And that's down more than \(7\%\) from 12,219,000 in July 2007.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: CareerBuilder.com had 24,752,000 unique visitors last month, about \(17\%\) more than for the same month the year before. But the site saw a \(14\%\) increase from July 2007 when it had 21,723,000 visitors. To broaden their customer bases and keep up with the masses, Monster and CareerBuilder both power job boards within newspaper and other Web sites: Monster services 4,150 in the U.S., and 3,350 outside the U.S.; CareerBuilder operates 8,750 in the U.S. and 250 elsewhere.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Many job sites have also added networking components to attract and retain more users. Among them is Dice.com, a technology job site, which launched discussion forums last year on a range of career-related topics. Site visitors can ask questions and swap advice with other users.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Ensuring a good fit

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Once you get from the job ad into the application process, more employers are adding assessments -- a form of candidate screening previously reserved for the interview stage, says John Hancock, managing director of recruiting services at Capital H Group, a human-resources consulting firm. The idea is to learn about candidates' intangible qualities, like leadership skills, work ethic and business acumen, he explains.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Companies are also using assessments to weed out applicants who aren't serious, says Mr. Hancock. "It's an indication of interest from a candidate to spend time completing a more comprehensive application process," he says. Indeed, some assessments can take up to an hour to complete, he adds.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: RECRUITERS JOB HUNTING TIPS

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: (Scott Reeves, Forbes magazine)

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Small Details

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Small things say a lot about your preparation for the interview. Get the pronunciation of all goods and services right. If you're meeting someone with a jawbreaker name, call the secretary and get it right. Nail down job titles.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Corporate Culture

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Dress appropriately for the corporate culture. Find out what employees generally wear each day and kick it up a notch. If it's jeans and a T-shirt at a dot-com, khakis and a sports coat or a blazer and a skirt will do just fine for the interview. When in doubt, overdress.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Kill The Cell Phone

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Turn off the cell phone during the interview. A ringing cell phone tells the interviewer that you're not serious about the job. Always make eye contact with the person you're speaking to.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Breaking News

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Always read the latest news about the company the morning of the interview. You don't want to be caught by surprise, and the ability to discuss the latest news underscores your interest in the company.

layout_dets.label: 页脚
layout_dets.text: MARCH 2008

layout_dets.label: 页码
layout_dets.text: PAGE 3

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Similarly, some Web sites now offer free assessment quizzes designed to help job hunters find positions that best match their qualifications, work history and job preferences. For example, visitors to nine-month old Climber.com are prompted to answer about 25 questions on these topics, which take about 30 minutes to complete, and results in a personal profile.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Climber works with roughly 40 corporate clients in a variety of industries and sends them profiles of job hunters that closely match their hiring needs. Job hunters whose profiles aren't a strong fit for any of Climber's clients are directed to ads for positions posted on the Web.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Video interviews

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: More employers are conducting first interviews with candidates over the Internet now that many popular personal-computer brands have built-in video capabilities, says Ms. Shapiro. "This is just starting to get going," she says. The strategy helps employers save time and avoid recruiting expenses like plane ticket and hotel costs, she adds.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Some employers are using the technique to have candidates meet hiring managers in faraway locations. Six candidates for a senior finance job recently came to One Communications Corp.'s Waltham, Mass.-headquarters and interviewed via video with executives based in several different locations at once, says Linda Chapman, executive vice president of human resources at the telecommunication firm. "Video really accelerates the hiring process," she says.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: MORE ON WEB RECRUITING

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - Target Practice: Some employers are using new methods to make Web ads visible only to ideal prospects.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - JobsInPods: An online library of podcast interviews with corporate hiring managers and employees about career topics.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: · \underline{Trovix:} Helps professionals find closely matching career opportunities without searching by keyword.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: · \underline{LateralLink:} A free job board for legal professionals

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: JOB HUNTING TIPS (Continued)

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: First Impression

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Always run your cover letter and résumé through the spell checker. Then have an eagle-eyed friend proofread it. This sounds obvious, but many candidates flub it, and a bad first impression is hard to overcome—assuming it's not a killer.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Keep It Short

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Limit your cover letter and résumé to a maximum of two pages each. Hit the highlights, and leave the nits and grits of prior jobs to the interview. A résumé is intended to grab an interviewer's attention--not provide chapter and verse of your entire career.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Play it Straight

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Write both your cover letter and résumé in clear, crisp language. Don't exaggerate your accomplishments or fudge on your education. But don't dumb things down either. If you're in a highly technical field, the interviewer will know what you're talking about.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Say Thanks

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: At the conclusion of the interview, always thank the interviewer for taking the time to discuss job prospects. Give a short recap of what you can do for the company and say why you're the best candidate for the job. Say that you'll follow up in a week with a phone call. A firm handshake says a lot on your way out the door.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: LISTEN UP, JOB HUNTERS

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text:
By Sarah E. Needleman,  
Published in the Wall Street Journal, February 12, 2008

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: What: \underline{JobsinPods.com}, an online library of podcast interviews with hiring managers and employees at roughly 20 U.S. companies, including International Business Machines Corp., AT&T Inc. and Intel Corp.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: When it launched: March 2007

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: How it works: New podcasts, or "jobcasts" as they're called on the site, are posted about once a week in a blog format. Older podcasts are archived by company name, job type and location. They average seven to 10 minutes in length.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Some podcasts describe employers' current hiring needs while others discuss what employers seek in candidates overall. They may also talk about a company's culture, job benefits and other workplace attributes.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Employers are charged \(329 per podcast and have the freedom to discuss any recruiting-related topic they choose, says Chris Russell, founder of JobsinPods. Mr. Russell provides employers with a list of questions he plans to ask in advance and records the interviews by phone, which

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: are then posted on the site and free to play or download.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Each podcast concludes with instructions on how to apply for jobs at those firms, plus where to find additional information online about the companies.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: What's so different: Many employers now feature podcasts on their online career portals about what it's like to work for them. But by going to JobsinPods, job hunters can avoid the cumbersome process of logging onto different company Web sites one at a time and then searching for podcasts, which may or may not be there. Plus, employers looking to market their career opportunities have access to a wider audience.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Who benefits: Since JobsinPods is a blog, job hunters can post comments about their experiences listening to its podcasts. Several point out that these are more engaging and insightful than the written job descriptions on many company Web sites and job boards. The podcasts also typically cover more ground since they span several minutes.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Another plus is that job seekers can download the site's podcasts to an iPod or other device, and listen to them at their leisure. The podcasts also can be played directly from the site.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Recruiters for AT&T Corp., for example, produced five podcasts for the site since August. They've been downloaded about 500 times each, says Christopher Hoyt, associate director, recruiting, for the telecommunications company.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: MAKE YOUR NETWORK WORK FOR YOU

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: By Barbara Safani, published in CareerSolvers, March 31, 2007

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Many job seekers are confused about what networking actually is, and therefore doubt its effectiveness. Networking is the art of building and maintaining mutually beneficial relationships. So, like anything else, networking requires a bit of practice and finesse, but if done correctly, networking can be an invaluable part of your job search campaign.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Here are a few tips to help you develop a network that works for you:

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Be Patient

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Networking doesn't happen overnight. As I've mentioned, it's a process, not just something you can check off your job search list like "Send resume to GE". While people may want to help you, they might not be able to right away. Quite simply, you may not be the first item on their agenda. So, if someone agrees to meet with you but can't do so immediately, accept their offer graciously and patiently.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Be Authentic

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: When you do meet with someone, take a sincere interest in their life, not just the information they can offer you. Don't push people for their knowledge or connections and

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: then abandon the relationship. Networking means fostering relationships. This objective cannot be achieved by one person constantly taking while the other constantly gives information or time.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Find ways to periodically reconnect with the contacts in your network to stay up to date on their lives, and let them know that you care about what is going on with them.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Be a Conduit

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Remember, the objective of networking is... well...more networking. You should be constantly adding people to your list of contacts. Always find more contacts to meet and, in turn, become a great connector yourself! Open up your network to others. Hopefully they'll follow suit and do the same for you, keeping the cycle going. Think about those contacts who could help others in your network, then introduce them!

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Be a Teacher

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Keep in mind that not everyone you meet will understand what networking is or how they can help you. Many people think that the best way they can help you as a job seeker is to take your resume and pass it along to their human resources department. While their intentions are noble, their strategy won't help you and could actually wind up losing you a great job.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: HR managers, like recruiters, are sometimes only motivated to take action on your resume if there is a current job opening within the organization that matches your skills. If a position is not available, they have no incentive to contact you and the connection is lost.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Rather than giving your contacts a resume, ask them if they could introduce you to a member of their company so that you can learn more about their position, industry, and organization. This way, you'll learn

layout_dets.label: 页脚

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: As a result of these discussions, the Embassy proposes that such personnel shall be accorded a status equivalent to that accorded to the administrative and technical staff of the Embassy of the United States of America under the Vienna Convention on Diplomatic Relations of April 18, 1961 (Vienna Convention). The understanding contained in the Embassy's Note. 835 dated July 3, 2001 and the Ministry's reply in Note No. D.M. 0300/2001 dated July 10, 2001, shall apply.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: United States personnel shall be permitted to enter and exit Panama with United States identification and with collective movement or individual travel orders, in accordance with an agreement on non-immigrant visas between the United States and Panama, which has been in force since June 1, 1956, as amended, except that the Government of Panama will waive the requirement for tourist cards and related fees. Panamanian authorities shall accept as valid driving licenses or permits issued by the appropriate U.S. authorities to United States personnel for operation of vehicles; and such personnel shall be authorized to wear U.S. Government attire (uniforms) and to carry authorized equipment when required for their mission while performing official duties.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The Embassy of the United States further proposes that the Government of Panama accord duty-free importation and exportation, as

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: well as exemption from inspection and taxation of products, services, property, materials, equipment, vehicles, vessels, and aircraft introduced and/or imported into, acquired in or exported from Panama by or on behalf of the U.S. Government or its personnel, in connection with their mission in Panama; except that United States personnel shall not be exempt from Panamanian taxes on items purchased in Panama for their personal use.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The two Governments shall cooperate in taking the necessary steps to ensure the security of United States personnel and property in Panama.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Vehicles, vessels, and aircraft owned or operated by or for United States Armed Forces shall not be subject to payment of landing or port fees, pilotage charges, navigation, overflight or parking charges or lighterage or harbor dues while in Panama, except for the charges related to the normal transit of the Panama Canal, previously agreed to; the United States Armed Forces shall pay reasonable charges for services requested and received.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: It shall be the responsibility of United States personnel to respect the laws of Panama and to abstain from any activity inconsistent with the spirit of their mission. Authorities of the Government of the United States shall take the necessary steps to that end.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Appropriate Panamanian and U.S. military or civilian police authorities shall cooperate in the investigation of any crime believed to have been committed by or against United States personnel.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The Government of Panama shall accept full responsibility for, and shall hold the United States Government harmless from, any and all claims arising from the use of projects constructed, or in the process of being constructed in whole or in part, by United States personnel in connection with their mission in Panama.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Finally, both governments shall waive any and all claims (other than contractual claims) against each other for personal injury to or death of their military or civilian personnel, or for damage, loss, or destruction of the other's property arising out of activities covered by this agreement. The United States shall pay, in accordance with United States law, fair and reasonable compensation in settlement of meritorious claims by third parties arising out of acts or omissions of United States personnel, or which are otherwise incident to agreed activities by United States personnel in connection with their mission in Panama.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Additional arrangements as may be necessary may be entered into by the appropriate authorities of the two Governments.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The Embassy of the United States of America proposes that this note and the Ministry's reply thereto shall constitute an agreement between the two Governments on this subject and that its provisions shall be in effect as of the date of the Ministry's reply.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Article 29

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The person of a diplomatic agent shall be inviolable. He shall not be liable to any form of arrest or detention. The receiving State shall treat him with due respect and shall take all appropriate steps to prevent any attack on his person, freedom or dignity.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Article 31

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: A diplomatic agent shall enjoy immunity from the criminal jurisdiction of the receiving State. He shall also enjoy immunity from its civil and administrative jurisdiction, except in the case of:

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: (a) a real action relating to private immovable property situated in the territory of the receiving State, unless he holds it on behalf of the sending State for the purposes of the mission;

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: (b) an action relating to succession in which the diplomatic agent is involved as executor, administrator, heir or legatee as a private person and not on behalf of the sending State;

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: (c) an action relating to any professional or commercial activity exercised by the diplomatic agent in the receiving State outside of his official functions.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: A diplomatic agent's family members are entitled to the same immunities unless they are United States nationals. ASTERISKS (*) IDENTIFY UNITED STATES NATIONALS

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Summary Points: North American HFC Submission to the Montreal Protocol

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The North American proposal includes the following key elements:

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Lists 20 HFCs as a new Annex F, including two substances sometimes referred to as HFOs.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - Recognizes that there may not be alternatives for all HFC applications and therefore utilizes a gradual phasedown mechanism with a plateau, as opposed to a phaseout.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - Establishes provisions for developed country (non-Article 5) and developing country (Article 5) phased down of production and consumption (see figure below):

layout_dets.label: 图名
layout_dets.text: HFC Reduction Steps for Article 5 and Non-Article 5 Countries (% of HCFCs and HFCs Production and Consumption, averaged over 2004 to 2006)

layout_dets.label: chart
layout_dets.text: 100% 90% 90% Non-A5 Reduction Steps 80% 80% A5 Reduction Steps 70% 70% 50% 50% 30% 30% 15% 15% Years

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - Uses weighting by Global Warming Potential for HCFCs and HFCs as compared to typical Montreal Protocol practice of Ozone Depleting Potential.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - Includes provisions to strictly limit HFC-23 byproduct emissions resulting from the production of HCFC-22, beginning in 2014.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - Requires licensing of HFC imports and exports, and bans imports and exports to non-Parties.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - Requires reporting on production and consumption of HFCs, and HFC-23 byproduct emissions.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - Makes eligible for funding under the Montreal Protocol's Multilateral Fund the phasedown of HFC production and consumption as well as reduction of HFC-23 byproduct emissions.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Cumulative benefits of the HFC phasedown estimated by the U.S. Government amount to reductions of 3,100 million metric tons of carbon dioxide equivalent (MMT $\mathrm{CO}_{2}$ eq) through 2020, and around 88,000 MMT $\mathrm{CO}_{2}$ eq through 2050.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Relationship to HCFC phaseout:

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - This amendment is designed to be compatible with HCFC phaseout.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - Recognizes that HFCs are alternatives in many existing HCFC applications. Thus, while the reduction steps apply only to HFCs, the baselines account for some level of transition to HFCs by using the average of 2004, 2005, and 2006 HCFC plus HFC consumption and production.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - The suite of known alternative chemicals, new technologies, and improved process/handling practices can significantly reduce HFC consumption while simultaneously supporting the HCFC phaseout.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Relationship with the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC):

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - The proposal is intended to support overall global efforts aimed at climate system protection.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - The proposal constitutes an amendment to the Montreal Protocol, and could be complemented by a related decision by the UNFCCC confirming the Montreal Protocol approach.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - Leaves unchanged the provisions of the UNFCCC / Kyoto Protocol that govern HFC emissions. Parties could follow Montreal Protocol obligations to meet certain UNFCCC obligations.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 中华人民共和国国家标准

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 婴幼儿及儿童纺织产品安全技术规范

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Safety technical code for infants and children textile products

layout_dets.label: 页脚
layout_dets.text: 中华人民共和国国家质量监督检验检疫总局中国国家标准化管理委员会 发布

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 前言

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本标准的全部技术内容为强制性。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本标准自2016年6月1日起实施，实施过渡期为2年，2016年6月1日前生产并符合相关标准要求的产品允许在市场上继续销售至2018年5月31日。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本标准按照GB/T1.1—2009给出的规则起草。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本标准由中国纺织工业联合会提出。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本标准由全国纺织品标准化技术委员会(SAC/TC209)和全国服装标准化技术委员会(SAC/TC219)归口。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本标准起草单位：纺织工业标准化研究所、纺织工业科学技术发展中心、国家纺织制品质量监督检验中心、上海市服装研究所。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本标准主要起草人：徐路、孙锡敏、方锡江、郑宇英、许鉴。

layout_dets.label: 页码
layout_dets.text: Ⅰ

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 婴幼儿及儿童纺织产品安全技术规范

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 1 范围

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本标准规定了婴幼儿及儿童纺织产品的安全技术要求、试验方法、检验规则。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本标准适用于在我国境内销售的婴幼儿及儿童纺织产品。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 注：布艺毛绒类玩具、布艺工艺品、一次性使用卫生用品、箱包、背提包、伞、地毯、专业运动服等不属于本标准的范围。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 2 规范性引用文件

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 下列文件对于本文件的应用是必不可少的。凡是注日期的引用文件，仅注日期的版本适用于本文件。凡是不注日期的引用文件，其最新版本(包括所有的修改单)适用于本文件。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: GB/T3920 纺织品 色牢度试验 耐摩擦色牢度

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: GB/T8629纺织品 试验用家庭洗涤和干燥程序

layout_dets.label: 段落

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 3 术语和定义

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 下列术语和定义适用于本文件。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 纺织产品 textile products

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 以天然纤维和化学纤维为主要原料，经纺、织、染等加工工艺或再经缝制、复合等工艺而制成的产品，如纱线、织物及其制成品。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 婴幼儿纺织产品 textile products for infants

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 年龄在36个月及以下的婴幼儿穿着或使用的纺织产品。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 注：一般适用于身高 \(100\mathrm{cm}\) 及以下婴幼儿穿着或使用的纺织产品可作为婴幼儿纺织产品。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 儿童纺织产品 textile products for children

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 年龄在3岁以上，14岁及以下的儿童穿着或使用的纺织产品。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 注：一般适用于身高 \(100\mathrm{cm}\) 以上、 \(155~\mathrm{cm}\) 及以下女童或 \(160~\mathrm{cm}\) 及以下男童穿着或使用的纺织产品可作为儿童纺织产品。其中， \(130~\mathrm{cm}\) 及以下儿童穿着的可作为7岁以下儿童服装。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 直接接触皮肤的纺织产品 textile products with direct contact to skin

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 在穿着或使用时，产品的大部分面积直接与人体皮肤接触的纺织产品。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 非直接接触皮肤的纺织产品 textile products without direct contact to skin

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 在穿着或使用时，产品不直接与人体皮肤接触或仅有小部分面积直接与人体皮肤接触的纺织产品。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 附件 attached components

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 纺织产品中起连接、装饰、标识或其他作用的部件。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 绳带 cords and drawstrings

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 以各种纺织或非纺织材料制成的、带有或不带有装饰物的绳索、拉带、带袢等。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 4 要求

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 4.1 总则

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 4.1.1 婴幼儿及儿童纺织产品的安全技术要求分为A类、B类和C类。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 注：本标准的安全技术类别与GB18401的安全技术类别一一对应。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 4.1.2 婴幼儿纺织产品应符合A类要求；直接接触皮肤的儿童纺织产品至少应符合B类要求；非直接接触皮肤的儿童纺织产品至少应符合C类要求。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 4.1.3 婴幼儿及儿童纺织产品应符合GB18401，同时最终产品还应符合 \(4.2\sim 4.5\) 的要求。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 4.1.4 婴幼儿纺织产品应在使用说明上标明本标准的编号及“婴幼儿用品”。儿童纺织产品应在使用说明上标明本标准的编号及符合的安全技术要求类别（例如，GB31701A类、GB31701B类或GB31701C类）。产品按件标注一种类别。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 注：按本标准要求标明了安全技术类别的婴幼儿及儿童纺织产品可不必标注GB18401的安全技术类别。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 4.2 织物的要求

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 婴幼儿及儿童纺织产品的面料、里料、附件所用织物应符合GB18401中对应安全技术类别的要求以及表1的要求。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 4.3 填充物的要求

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 婴幼儿及儿童纺织产品所用纤维类和羽绒羽毛填充物应符合GB18401中对应安全技术类别的要求，羽绒羽毛填充物应符合GB/T17685中微生物技术指标的要求。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 注：其他填充物的安全技术要求需按国家相关法规和强制性标准执行。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 4.4 附件的要求

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 4.4.1 婴幼儿纺织产品上，不宜使用 \(\leqslant 3\mathrm{mm}\) 的附件，可能被婴幼儿抓起咬住的各类附件抗拉强力应符合表2要求。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 4.4.2 婴幼儿及儿童纺织产品所用附件不应存在可触及的锐利尖端和锐利边缘。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 4.4.3 婴幼儿及儿童服装的绳带要求应符合表3要求。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 4.5 其他要求

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 4.5.1 婴幼儿及儿童纺织产品的包装中不应使用金属针等锐利物。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 4.5.2 婴幼儿及儿童纺织产品上不允许残留金属针等锐利物。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 4.5.3 对于缝制在可贴身穿着的婴幼儿服装上的耐久性标签，应置于不与皮肤直接接触的位置。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 5 试验方法

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 5.1 耐湿摩擦色牢度的测定按GB/T3920执行。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 5.2 重金属中总铅和总镉的测定按GB/T30157执行。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 5.3 邻苯二甲酸酯含量的测定按GB/T20388执行。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 5.4 燃烧性能的测定按GB/T14644执行。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 5.5 附件抗拉强力的测定按附录A执行。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 5.6 附件尖端和边缘的锐利性测定按GB/T31702执行。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 5.7 绳带和绳圈的长度采用钢板尺或钢卷尺测定其自然状态下的伸直长度，记录至 \(1\mathrm{mm}\)

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 6 检验规则

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 6.1 从每批产品中按品种随机抽取有代表性样品，每个品种按不同颜色各抽取1个样品，样品的大小或数量应满足试验需要。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 6.2 样品抽取后密封放置，不应进行任何处理。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 6.3 单件样品判定：根据产品的类别对照第4章的要求进行评定，如果样品的测试结果全部符合相应类别的要求（含有2种及以上组件的产品，每种组件均符合相应类别的要求），则该样品符合本标准，否则为不符合。对儿童纺织产品中重量不超过整件制品 \(1\%\) 的小型组件不考核4.2的项目。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 6.4 批样判定：如果所抽取样品全部符合，则判定该批产品符合本标准。如果有不符合的样品，则判定该样品所代表的品种或颜色的产品不符合本标准。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 附录A（规范性附录）附件抗拉强力试验方法

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: A.1 原理

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 用上夹钳和下夹钳分别夹持住附件和主体，拉伸至定负荷下作用一定的时间，评定附件是否从主体上脱落或松动。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 对于最大尺寸 \(\leqslant 3\mathrm{mm}\) ，或者无法夹持（夹持时附件发生变形或损伤）的附件，评定洗涤后附件的变化。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: A.2 设备

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: A.2.1 夹持器：能够夹持各类附件。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: A.2.2 拉伸仪：应能进行定负荷拉伸，精度为 \(\pm 1\mathrm{N}\)

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: A.2.3 洗衣机：符合GB/T8629中A型洗衣机的规定。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: A.3 样品

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 将制品置于温度为 \(20^{\circ}\mathrm{C} \pm 2^{\circ}\mathrm{C}\) 、相对湿度为 \(65\% \pm 4\%\) 的标准大气中调湿至平衡，并在这一温度和湿度下进行试验。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 注：该试验一般不需剪取试样，直接测试成品上的附件。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: A.4 步骤

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: A.4.1 抗拉强力试验

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: A.4.1.1 选择合适的夹持器安装在拉伸仪上，根据附件尺寸和表2的规定选择和设定拉伸定负荷值为 \(70\mathrm{N}\) 或 \(50\mathrm{N}\)。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: A.4.1.2 一个夹钳夹持住附件与产品联结处的织物，另一个夹钳夹持住被测附件。夹持时不得引起被测附件明显变形、破碎等不良现象。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: A.4.1.3 开启拉伸仪，以一定的速度缓慢拉伸试样至定负荷，在定负荷下保持 \(10\mathrm{~s}\) 。出现以下情况为附件抗拉强力不合格：

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: ——附件从主体上脱落；

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: ——附件破损；

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: ——织物断裂、撕裂等。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: A.4.1.4 按以上步骤，对样品上其他附件进行试验。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: A.4.2 洗涤试验

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: A.4.2.1 检查试样上的每个附件，并详细记录附件在试样上的初始状态。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: A.4.2.2 按照GB/T8629中的规定，采用A型洗衣机， \(40^{\circ}\mathrm{C}\) 正常搅拌程序对试样进行洗涤，悬挂晾干。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: A.4.2.3 检查洗涤后试样上的每个附件，记录洗涤后附件状态。出现下列情况中的轻微变化、明显变

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 化或完全脱离时为不合格：

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: ——无变化；

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: ——有可忽略的变化：附件与初始状态比较有微小变化，但仍牢固地附着在试样上；

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: ——有轻微变化：附件有轻微、可见的松动；

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 有明显变化：附件或者织物明显损坏；

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: ——完全脱离：附件从织物上完全脱离。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: A.5 试验报告

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 试验报告应包括以下内容：

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: a） 制品描述；

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: b）附件的种类、尺寸、数量和位置；

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: c）每个附件的抗拉强力以及破坏类型；

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: d）如果需要，试样洗涤后附件的外观状态；

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: e）偏离本附录的说明。

layout_dets.text: 前言

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本文件按照GB/T1.1—2020《标准化工作导则第1部分：标准化文件的结构和起草规则》的规定起草。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本文件代替GB/T13788—2017《冷轧带肋钢筋》，与GB/T13788—2017相比，除结构调整和编辑性改动外，主要技术变化如下：

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: ——删除了四面肋外形及其相关规定（见2017年版的5.2、表2）；

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: ——更改了原料的有关规定（见6.1、附录A，2017年版的6.1）；

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: ——更改了交货状态的有关规定（见6.2，2017年版的6.2）；

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: ——更改了CRB550断后伸长率指标、CRB650和CRB800最大力总延伸率指标（见表2，2017年版的表3）；

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: ——增加了出厂检验中“盘”“卷”的有关规定（见表4）；

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: ——更改了钢筋牌号标志（见9.2，2017年版的9.2）。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 请注意本文件的某些内容可能涉及专利。本文件的发布机构不承担识别专利的责任。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本文件由中华人民共和国工业和信息化部提出并归口。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本文件所代替文件的历次版本发布情况为：

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: ——1992年首次发布为GB13788—1992，2000年第一次修订，2008年第二次修订；

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 1 范围

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本文件规定了冷轧带肋钢筋（以下简称钢筋）的牌号、尺寸、外形、重量及允许偏差、原料及性能、试验方法、检验规则、包装、标志和质量证明书。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本文件适用于普通钢筋混凝土、制造焊接网、预应力混凝土用冷轧带肋钢筋。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 2 规范性引用文件

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 下列文件中的内容通过文中的规范性引用而构成本文件必不可少的条款。其中，注日期的引用文件，仅该日期对应的版本适用于本文件；不注日期的引用文件，其最新版本(包括所有的修改单)适用于本文件。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 3 术语和定义

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 下列术语和定义适用于本文件。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 冷轧带肋钢筋 cold rolled ribbed steel bars

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 热轧圆盘条经冷轧后，在其表面带有沿长度方向均匀分布的横肋的钢筋。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 公称直径 nominal diameter

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 与钢筋的公称横截面积相等的圆的直径。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 相对肋面积 specific projected rib area

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 横肋在与钢筋轴线垂直平面上的投影面积与钢筋公称周长和横肋间距的乘积之比。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 横肋间隙rib spacing

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 钢筋周圈上横肋不连续部分在垂直于钢筋轴线平面上投影的弦长。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 4 牌号

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 钢筋分为CRB550、CRB600H、CRB650、CRB800、CRB800H五个牌号。CRB550、CRB600H为普

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 通钢筋混凝土用钢筋，CRB650、CRB800、CRB800H为预应力混凝土用钢筋。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: C、R、B、H分别为冷轧（Cold rolled）、带肋（Ribbed）、钢筋（Bars）、高延性（High elongation）四个词的英文首位字母；数字代表抗拉强度特征值。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 5 尺寸、外形、重量及允许偏差

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 5.1 公称直径范围

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: CRB550钢筋的公称直径范围为 \(4\mathrm{mm}\sim 12\mathrm{mm}\) ，CRB600H钢筋的公称直径范围为 \(4\mathrm{mm}\sim\) \(16\mathrm{mm}\) ，CRB650及以上牌号钢筋的公称直径为 \(4\mathrm{mm},5\mathrm{mm},6\mathrm{mm}\)

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 5.2 外形

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 5.2.1 外形要求

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: CRB600H应为二面肋（见图1），CRB550、CRB650应为三面肋（见图2）。经供需双方协商，CRB800、CRB800H准许采用其他外形。

layout_dets.text: 5.2.2 横肋要求

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 5.2.2.1 二面肋和三面肋钢筋横肋呈月牙形。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 5.2.2.2 横肋沿钢筋横截面周圈上均匀分布，二面肋钢筋其中一面肋的倾角应与另一面反向，三面肋钢筋有一面肋的倾角应与另两面反向。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 5.2.2.3 二面肋和三面肋钢筋横肋中心线和钢筋纵轴线夹角 \(\beta\) 应为 \(40^{\circ} \sim 60^{\circ}\)。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 5.2.2.4 二面肋和三面肋钢筋横肋两侧面和钢筋表面斜角 \(\alpha\) 不应小于 \(45^{\circ}\)

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 5.2.2.5 二面肋和三面肋钢筋横肋间隙的总和应不大于公称周长的 \(20\% (\sum f_{i}\leqslant 0.2\pi d)\)

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 5.4 交货型式、长度及允许偏差

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 钢筋有直条、盘卷两种交货型式。按直条交货时应注明定尺长度，其长度及允许偏差按供需双方协商确定。盘卷交货时应切头切尾。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 5.5 弯曲度

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 直条钢筋的每米弯曲度应不大于 \(4\mathrm{mm}\)，总弯曲度应不大于钢筋全长的 \(0.4\%\)。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 5.6 重量

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 5.6.1 盘卷钢筋的重量应不小于 \(500\mathrm{kg}\) 。每盘应由一根钢筋组成，CRB650、CRB800、CRB800H不应有焊接接头。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 5.6.2 直条钢筋按同一牌号、同一规格、同一长度成捆交货，捆重由供需双方协商确定。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 6 原料及性能

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 6.1 原料

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 制造钢筋的原料应符合附录A的规定。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 6.2 交货状态

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 钢筋按冷加工状态交货，准许冷轧后进行热处理

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 6.3 力学性能和工艺性能

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 6.3.1 钢筋的力学性能和工艺性能应符合表2的规定。当进行弯曲试验时，按表2规定的弯曲压头直径弯曲 \(180^{\circ}\) 后，钢筋受弯曲部位表面不应产生裂纹。反复弯曲试验的弯曲半径应符合表3的规定。

layout_dets.text: 6.3.3 经供需双方协商，准许使用推算法确定 \(1000\mathrm{h}\) 松弛率。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 6.4 表面质量

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 6.4.1 钢筋表面不应有裂纹、折叠、结疤、油污、机械损伤。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 6.4.2 钢筋表面准许有浮锈，但不应有锈皮及目视可见的麻坑腐蚀现象。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 7.2 力学性能

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 计算钢筋强度采用表1所列公称横截面积

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 7.3 应力松弛试验

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 7.3.1 试验期间试样的环境温度应保持在 \(20^{\circ}\mathrm{C} \pm 2^{\circ}\mathrm{C}\)

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 7.3.2 试样准许进行机械矫直，但不应进行任何热处理和其他冷加工。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 7.3.3 加在试样上的初始试验力为试样公称抗拉强度的 70% 乘以试样公称横截面积。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 7.3.4加荷速度为 \(200\mathrm{MPa / min}\pm 50\mathrm{MPa / min}\) ，初始负荷应在 \(3\mathrm{min}\sim 5\mathrm{min}\) 加荷完毕，保持载荷\(2\mathrm{min}\) 后开始记录松弛值。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 7.3.5 试样长度不小于公称直径的60倍。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 7.3.6 准许用至少$120\mathrm{h}$的测试数据推算$1000\mathrm{h}$的松弛率值。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 7.4 尺寸测量

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 7.4.1 横肋高度的测量采用测量同一截面每列横肋高度取其平均值；横肋间距采用测量平均间距的方法，即测取同一列横肋第1个与第11个横肋的中心距离除以10，即为横肋间距的平均值。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 7.4.2 尺寸测量精度精确到 $0.02\mathrm{mm}$

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 7.5 重量偏差的测量

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 测量钢筋重量偏差时，试样长度应不小于 $500\mathrm{mm}$ 。长度测量精确到 $1\mathrm{mm}$，重量测定精确到 $1\mathrm{g}$。钢筋重量偏差（%） 按式（3）计算：

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 式中：

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: $\eta$ ——实际重量与理论重量的偏差，%；

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: $M$ ——试样实际重量，单位为克 $(\mathrm{g})$；

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: $L$ ——试样长度，单位为毫米 $(\mathrm{mm})$；

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: $m$ ——理论单位重量，单位为克每毫米 $(\mathrm{g / mm})$ 。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 7.6 数值修约

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 检验结果的数值修约与判定应符合YB/T081的规定。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 8 检验规则

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 8.1 检查和验收

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 钢筋的检查和验收由供方质量监督部门进行。需方有权进行检验

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 8.2 组批规则

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 钢筋应按批进行检查和验收，每批应由同一牌号、同一外形、同一规格、同一生产工艺和同一交货状态的钢筋组成，每批不大于 \(60\mathrm{t}\)。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 8.3 取样数量

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 钢筋检验的取样数量应符合表4的规定。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 8.4 复验与判定

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 钢筋的复验与判定应符合GB/T17505的规定。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 9 包装、标志和质量证明书

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 9.1 每盘(捆)钢筋应均匀捆扎不少于3道，端头应弯入盘内。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 9.2 钢筋应轧上明显且完整的钢筋牌号标志，标志间距为横肋间距的2倍，标志间距内的一条横肋取消，如图3所示；高延性冷轧带肋钢筋还应在第3个标志间距内增加一条短横肋，如图4所示；钢筋仅准许轧上厂名或厂标，并不应轧制在包括横肋取消部位等影响完整钢筋牌号标志部位。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 9.3 每盘(捆)钢筋应挂有不少于2个标牌，注明生产厂、生产日期、钢筋牌号和规格。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 9.4除上述规定外，钢筋的包装、标志和质量证明书应符合GB/T2101或GB/T2103的有关规定。

layout_dets.text: 前 言

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本文件按照GB/T1.1—2020《标准化工作导则第1部分：标准化文件的结构和起草规则》的规定起草。

layout_dets.text: 本文件代替GB 16710—2010《土方机械  噪声限值》，与GB16710—2010相比，除结构调整和编辑性改动外，主要技术变化如下：

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: a）更改了标准的适用范围（见第1章，2010年版的第1章）；

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: b）更改了土方机械机外发射噪声限值及实施阶段的规定（见表1，2010年版的表1）；

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: c）更改了土方机械司机位置处噪声限值及实施阶段的规定（见表2，2010年版的表2）；

layout_dets.label: 段落

layout_dets.label: 页码
layout_dets.text: Ⅰ

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 引 言

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 随着技术的发展和对环境及人身健康的关注，世界各国对机器噪声控制的要求越来越严格。为保护环境和人体健康，需要对土方机械的机器发射噪声进行控制。噪声限值的控制水平，既要满足环境保护、司机听力保护的需要，也要考虑国内产品的技术现状。本文件规定的限值，是现阶段我国对土方机械产品噪声的最低要求。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 考虑到技术进步，尤其是在声源处降低噪声措施的有效性，机器在设计和制造时，需尽可能降低噪声发射对环境和人体健康的影响，并考虑在声源处控制噪声的可行性及技术措施。推荐的低噪声机器设计方法见GB/T25078（所有部分）。

layout_dets.label: 页码
layout_dets.text: II

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 1 范围

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本文件规定了土方机械的机外发射噪声限值和司机位置噪声限值，描述了相应的试验方法。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本文件适用于以内燃机为动力的土方机械、水平定向钻机和轮胎式叉装机。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本文件不适用于GB/T 44254 定义的电动土方机械。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本文件不适用于在本文件规定的噪声限值（见表1、表2)实施前制造的机器。

layout_dets.label: 段落

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 水平定向钻机 horizontal directional drilling machine

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 使用一个可调向操控的钻头，钻头连接在钻杆组的端部，用于地下水平钻孔的机器。

layout_dets.label: 段落

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 注2：水平定向钻机一般是用一个平行于作业地面或倾斜至 30^{\circ} 的钻架对钻杆组施加作用力。

layout_dets.text: 5 试验方法

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 5.1.1 铲运机、吊管机、挖沟机和水平定向钻机的声功率级按GB/T25612的规定测定，水平定向钻机的基本长度 \((l)\) 按GB/T25603—2010中的图 \(1\sim\) 图3确定。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 5.1.2 作业宽度不大于 \(1\mathrm{m}\) 的非驾乘式和遥控型振动压路机的机外发射噪声按GB/T25684.13—2021中A.3的规定测定。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 5.1.3 其他土方机械的声功率级按GB/T 25614 的规定测定。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 5.2 司机位置处发射声压级的测定

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 5.2.1 铲运机、吊管机、挖沟机、水平定向钻机和轮胎式叉装机的司机位置处的发射声压级按GB/T25613的规定测定。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 5.2.2 其他土方机械司机位置处的发射声压级按GB/T25615的规定测定。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本文件按照GB/T1.1—2020《标准化工作导则第1部分：标准化文件的结构和起草规则》的规定起草。

layout_dets.text: 本文件规定了质量相关技术要求，食品安全相关要求见有关法律法规、政策和食品安全标准等文件。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本文件代替GB16798—1997《食品机械安全卫生》，与GB16798—1997相比，除结构调整和编辑性改动外，主要技术变化如下：

layout_dets.label: 段落

layout_dets.label: 段落

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: ——更改了结构材料要求（见第4章，1997年版的第4章）；

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: ——更改了设备结构（见第5章，1997年版的第5章、第6章、第7章、第8章）；

layout_dets.label: 段落

layout_dets.label: 段落

layout_dets.label: 段落

layout_dets.label: 页码
layout_dets.text: I

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 引言

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 制定本文件的主要目的在于防止产品在生产加工过程中由机械设备因素引起的物质传递（包括物理、化学等方面，如产品接触材料的脱落、反应、溶解、分解等），以及加工过程的残留物变质，防止由此对人体产生有害作用。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本文件着重于保证产品在生产加工过程中可能接触的任何表面的安全、无害，及保持设备良好的洁净状态，同时，考虑到了食品机械需要具有的通用安全要求。与食品（类似于食品）有直接接触表面的其他机械、仪器仪表和零部件等可参照执行。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本文件规定了食品机械安全相关的结构材料要求、设备结构和设备的配置安装，以及标准的实施。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本文件适用于食品加工过程的机器与设备。

layout_dets.text: 3 术语和定义

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 下列术语和定义适用于本文件。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 食品机械 food machinery

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 用于食品加工过程的机器与设备。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 产品 product

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 食品加工过程中的原、辅料，以及半制成品和制成品。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 工作空气 working air

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 用于产品加热、冷却、干燥、输送、吹扫和检验设备密封等情况的洁净空气。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 产品区域 area of product

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 在其范围内进行产品加工的一个空间。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 注：包含直接或间接与产品接触的各种单元及边沿区段。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 结构材料 materials of construction

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 构造食品加工机械的原材料和制品，包括金属、非金属材料及辅助材料。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 注：辅助材料指焊接材料、粘接材料、涂层等。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 产品接触表面 product contact surface

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 在产品处理、加工及包装过程中，需直接或间接暴露于产品，并与产品接触的表面。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 非产品接触表面 noncontact surface of product

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 在产品区域内的除产品接触表面外的其他暴露表面。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 注：通常不与产品接触，然而，由于泄漏、溢出、设备损伤、人手触摸等原因而有可能直接或间接与产品接触。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 主要工艺设备 main process equipment

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 具有产品接触表面的用于产品预处理、加工、贮存、输送和包装的设备。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 辅助设备 auxiliary equipment

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 按照功能要求，经常或周期性地处于产品区域内，但不具有产品接触表面的设备。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 注：主要指在工艺上起辅助作用的设备，如产品盛装容器的整理和输送设备，产品包装后的计量、检测、剔除等设备。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 易于清洗和检查 easy to clean and check

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 无须采用特殊手段，也不需要对操作人员进行专门培训，仅在短时间内用水、洗涤剂、消毒剂即可将设备清洗干净并完成其安全卫生检查。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 检验性清洗 verifying rinse

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 采用感官方法评定表面质量所做的清洗工作。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 在线清洗 clean-in-place; CIP

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 原位清洗

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 清洗设备内部但不移动或拆卸设备的方法。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 注：设备清洗不一定需要消毒，通常使用清洁的水配合酸、碱，按照一定程序对设备进行冲洗，完成设备的清洗过程。

layout_dets.text: 本文件在修订过程中，纳入了GB26485—2011《开卷矫平剪切生产线 安全要求》、GB27608—2011《联合冲剪机 安全要求》、GB28240—2012《剪板机 安全技术要求》、GB28242—2012《螺旋压力机 安全技术要求》、GB28243—2012《液压板料折弯机 安全技术要求》、GB28244—2012《自动锻压机 安全技术要求》、GB28760—2012《弯管机 安全技术要求》及GB30458—2013《卷板机 安全技术要求》这8项标准的强制性内容，均属于安全条款。后续8项标准中的其他内容将陆续转化为本文件配套的推荐性国家标准。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本文件针对锻压机械及其附属设备存在的主要危险，提出了保障锻压机械安全的基本安全技术要求和措施，鼓励采取更多的风险减小措施，防止危险事故的发生。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本文件规定了锻压机械设计、制造和使用的安全要求。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本文件适用于锻压机械的设计、制造和验收。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本文件不适用于在本文件实施前制造的锻压机械。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本文件按照GB/T1.1—2020《标准化工作导则第1部分：标准化文件的结构和起草规则》的规定起草。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本文件按照GB/T1.1—2020《标准化工作导则第1部分：标准化文件的结构和起草规则》的规定起草。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本文件代替GB25038—2010《胶鞋健康安全技术规范》，整合了GB21536—2008《田径运动鞋》和GB25037—2010《工矿靴》的强制性内容。与GB25038—2010相比，除结构调整和编辑性改动外，主要技术变化如下：

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: a）更改了标准范围（见第1章，2010年版的第1章）；

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: b）增加了“钉尖和断针”的要求及试验方法（见4.1、5.1）；

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: c）增加了“六价铬”的要求及试验方法（见4.2、5.2）

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: d）删除了“pH值”的要求及试验方法（见2010年版的第5章、6.1）；

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: e）更改了“游离甲醛”的要求及试验方法（见4.2、5.4，2010年版的第5章、6.2）；

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: f）删除了“可萃取的重金属”的要求及试验方法（见2010年版的第5章、6.3）；

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: g）更改了“可分解致癌芳香胺染料”的要求及试验方法（见4.2、5.3，2010年版的第5章、6.4）；

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: h）增加了“富马酸二甲酯”的要求及试验方法（见4.2、5.5）；

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: i）增加了皮革和毛皮中“含氯苯酚”的要求及试验方法（见4.2、5.6）；

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: j）增加了“邻苯二甲酸酯”的要求及试验方法（见4.2、5.7）；

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: k）增加了“短链氯化石蜡”的要求及试验方法（见4.2、5.8）；

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1）删除了“N-亚硝基胺”的要求及试验方法（见2010年版的第5章、6.6）；

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: m）删除了“鞋里和内底摩擦色牢度”的要求及试验方法（见2010年版的第5章、6.7）；

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: n）删除了“取样方法”（见2010年版的7.1）；

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: o）删除了规范性附录“橡胶中不应检出的N-亚硝基胺清单”（见2010年版的附录B）；

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: p）增加了规范性附录“限用邻苯二甲酸酯类增塑剂信息”（见附录B）。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 请注意本文件的某些内容可能涉及专利。本文件的发布机构不承担识别专利的责任。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本文件由中华人民共和国工业和信息化部提出并归口。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本文件及其所代替文件的历次版本发布情况为：

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: ——本次为第一次修订，整合了GB25038—2010的全部内容，以及GB21536—2008和GB25037—2010的强制性内容。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 鞋类通用安全要求

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 1 范围

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本文件界定了鞋类相关的术语和定义，规定了鞋类通用安全的技术要求、判定，描述了相应的试验方法。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本文件适用于用各种材料制作的鞋类产品。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本文件不适用于防护鞋（靴）和14岁（含）以下儿童穿用的鞋类产品。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 2 规范性引用文件

layout_dets.text: 3 术语和定义

layout_dets.label: 段落

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 可触及 accessible

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 用关节式可触及探头伸至鞋上被测部位或部件，如果其轴肩之前的任何部分能接触到鞋上的部位或部件即可确定。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 4 技术要求

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 4.1 钉尖和断针要求

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 4.1.1 鞋内腔不应有钉尖。除特殊风格和功能性需求外，鞋外部不应有钉尖。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 4.1.2 鞋内外不应有断针。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 4.2 化学物质限量要求

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 化学物质限量要求见表1。

layout_dets.label: 表名
layout_dets.text: 表 1 化学物质限量要求

layout_dets.label: 表格
layout_dets.html:
序号项目a指标b
1六价铬(CAS号:18540-29-9)/(mg/kg)皮革、毛皮≤10
2可分解致癌芳香胺染料/(mg/kg)纺织品≤20
人造革、合成革≤30
皮革、毛皮≤30
3甲醛(CAS号:50-00-0)/(mg/kg)纺织品、人造革、合成革、皮革、毛皮直接接触皮肤的材料d≤75
非直接接触皮肤的材料d≤300
4富马酸二甲酯(CAS号:624-49-7)/(mg/kg)纺织品、人造革、合成革、皮革、毛皮≤0.1
5含氯苯酚/(mg/kg)纺织品、人造革、合成革五氯苯酚(CAS号:87-86-5)≤0.5
2,3,5,6-四氯苯酚(CAS号:935-95-5)≤0.5
皮革、毛皮五氯苯酚(CAS号:87-86-5)≤0.5
6邻苯二甲酸酯带涂层(印花)材料、人造革、合成革、橡胶、塑料等合成材料DEHP、DBP、BBP、DIBP四种总量<0.1%
7短链氯化石蜡(C10~C13,CAS号:85535-84-8)纺织品、人造革、合成革、皮革、毛皮、橡胶、塑料等合成材料<0.15%
a 应对可触及部件的材料进行检验。b 按皮革的试验方法测试化学物质含量时,以试样实际质量为基准计算结果。c 附录A给出了在还原条件下染料中可能分解出的致癌芳香胺清单。d 一般情况下,衬里、内垫(内底)为直接接触皮肤材料,帮面、外底为非直接接触皮肤材料。但如果没有衬里、内垫(内底)的情况下,则帮面或外底为直接接触皮肤材料。e 附录B给出了限用邻苯二甲酸酯类增塑剂信息。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本部分起草单位：浙江中控自动化仪表有限公司、横河电机（北京）研发中心、福建顺昌虹润精密仪器有限公司、杭州盟控仪表技术有限公司、轻工业自动化研究所、浙江大学、北京燕山石化公司研究院、上海工业自动化仪表研究院。

layout_dets.label: 段落

layout_dets.text: V

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text:
工业自动化产品安全要求
第10部分：记录仪表的安全要求

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 1 范围

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: GB30439的本部分规定了记录仪表的防电击、防机械危险、耐机械冲击和撞击、防止火焰蔓延、设备的温度限值和耐热的安全内容。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本部分不包括与安全无关的设备的功能、性能或其他特性、运输包装的有效性、电磁兼容(EMC)要求、功能安全、对爆炸环境的防护措施、维修（修理）、维修（修理）人员的防护。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 如果要将记录仪表用于其他环境（例如医疗、食品、核电、船舶等），则记录仪表还必须满足适用于相应环境的特殊要求、标准及安装准则。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本部分适用于工业产品制造或加工过程中，自动采集和记录过程信号的记录仪表，其额定电压不超过 \(300\mathrm{V}\) 、电源连接方式为导线连接。本部分还适用于预定与自动化产品一起使用的附件（如仪表的检定装置）。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 3 术语和定义

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: GB4793.1界定的以及下列术语和定义适用于本文件。为了便于使用，以下重复列出了GB4793.1中的某些术语和定义。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 除另有规定外，“电压”值和“电流”值均指交流、直流，或者合成的电压或电流的有效值。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 3.1 设备和设备的类别

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 固定式设备 fixed equipment

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 固定在支撑件上的或需另外固定在特定位置上的设备。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 永久性连接式设备 permanently connected equipment

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 预定要用螺钉接线端子或其他可靠方法与建筑物安装配线连接的设备。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 3.2 零部件和附件

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 端子 terminal

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 为使装置（设备）与外部导体相连而提供的一种元件。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 注：端子可以含有一个或几个接触件，因此该术语也包括插座、连接器等。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 功能接地端子 functional earth terminal

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 用来直接与测量电路或控制电路的某一点，或者直接与某个屏蔽部分进行电气连接的，而且预定还要用来为安全目的以外的任何功能目的接地的端子。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 注：对测量设备，该端子常被称为测量接地端子。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 保护导体端子 protective conductor terminal

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 为安全目的而与设备的导电零部件相连接的，而且预定还要与外部保护接地系统相连接的端子。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 外壳 enclosure

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 防止设备受到某些外部影响和防止从任何方向直接接触而提供的零部件。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 挡板 barrier

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 防止从任何正常接近的方向直接接触而提供的零部件。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 注：外壳和挡板可以提供火焰蔓延的防护[见9.2.1b)。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 1 范围

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本文件界定了童鞋安全的术语和定义，规定了产品分类、技术要求和判定，描述了相应的试验方法。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本文件适用于用各种材料制作的、供14岁（含）以下儿童及婴幼儿穿用的鞋类产品。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 3 术语和定义

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: GB/T2703界定的以及下列术语和定义适用于本文件。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 可触及 accessible

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 用关节式可触及探头伸至鞋上被测部位或部件，如果其轴肩之前的任何部分能接触到鞋上的部位或部件即可确定。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 锐利边缘 sharp edge

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 童鞋上任意部件的两表面连接处形成的长度超过 \(2.0\mathrm{mm}\) 的可能对使用者产生伤害的边缘。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 锐利尖端 sharp point

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 童鞋任意部件上的可能对使用者产生伤害的突出尖端。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 可拆卸小附件 removable small accessory

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 鞋上预定不用工具就能拆卸的零件或部件。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 儿童鞋 children's footwear

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 鞋号大于170，一般可供3岁以上至14岁儿童穿用的鞋。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 婴幼儿鞋 infants' footwear

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 鞋号不大于170，一般可供3岁及以下婴幼儿穿用的鞋。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 4 产品分类

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 童鞋按穿用对象分为以下两类：

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: a）婴幼儿鞋；

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: b）儿童鞋。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 5 技术要求

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 5.1 基本要求

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 5.1.1 鞋内外不应有断针。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 5.1.2 鞋内外不应有可触及的锐利边缘和锐利尖端，竞技用田径鞋、足球鞋等儿童鞋上的功能性鞋钉除外。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 5.1.3 有效跟高不应大于 \(25\mathrm{mm}\)

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 5.2 婴幼儿鞋小附件要求

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 5.2.1 可拆卸小附件不应完全容入小零件试验器

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 5.2.2 经规定拉力测试后脱落的小附件（含拉力测试过程中脱落的附件碎片和连同帮面材料共同脱落的附件），不应有可触及的锐利边缘和锐利尖端，不应完全容入小零件试验器。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 5.2.3 拉力测试后损坏但未脱落的小附件不应有可触及的锐利边缘和锐利尖端。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 注：鞋上绒毛、纤维填充材料、纺织物（含非织造布）、纱线、弹性织物、细绳等类型小附件不进行拉力测试和小零件容入试验。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 6 试验方法

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 6.1 断针

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 用金属检测仪和/或目测、手感等方式检测断针。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 6.2 可触及的锐利边缘和锐利尖端

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 分别按GB6675.2—2014中5.8和5.9规定进行检验。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 6.3 有效跟高

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 鞋后跟部位内底后端点及跖趾部位内底最低点分别到地面的垂直距离，两者之差为有效跟高。用精度不低于 \(1\mathrm{mm}\) 的适当量具测量。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 6.4 婴幼儿鞋小附件

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 6.4.1 不可拆卸小附件的拉力测试

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 6.4.2 小附件容入试验

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 按照GB 6675.2—2014中5.2规定进行试验，判定其是否可完全容入小零件试验器。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 6.5 六价铬

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 不同样品分开检验，按GB/T22807或GB/T38402进行检验，当发生争议时，以GB/T38402的测试结果为准。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 6.6 可分解致癌芳香胺染料

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 6.6.1 不同样品分开检验。如果衬里和帮面不能分开时，则在一起检验，按衬里材料的试验方法进行检验。对于背面贴合其他材料的待测样品，应将背面贴合的其他材料完全剥离之后再进行检验。若实在难以去除，应在报告中注明情况。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 6.6.2纺织品、人造革、合成革按GB/T17592进行检验；皮革和毛皮按GB/T19942进行检验。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 6.7 甲醛

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 6.7.2纺织品、人造革、合成革按GB/T2912.1进行检验；皮革和毛皮按GB/T19941.1或GB/T19941.2进行检验，当发生争议时，以GB/T19941.1的测试结果为准。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 6.8 重金属总量

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 不同样品分开检验，按QB/T4340进行检验。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 6.9 富马酸二甲酯

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 不同样品分开检验，按GB/T26713进行检验。

layout_dets.text: 6.10 含氯苯酚

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 前言

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本标准的全部技术内容为强制性。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本标准按照GB/T1.1—2009给出的规则起草。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本标准由国家煤矿安全监察局提出。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本标准由全国煤炭标准化技术委员会(SAC/TC42)归口。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本标准主要起草单位：煤炭科学技术研究院有限公司煤化工分院、北京神华恒运能源科技有限公司、北京华夏力鸿商品检验有限公司、神华销售集团有限公司。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本标准主要起草人：罗陨飞、姜英、白向飞、朱川、连进京、崔凤海、谷红伟、刘翊、刘占宾、张志文、郝文玉、李娜、刘兴海、王元臣。

layout_dets.label: 页码
layout_dets.text: I

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 商品煤质量 民用散煤

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 1 范围

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本标准规定了民用散煤的术语和定义、原料要求、产品分类、要求和试验方法、检验规则、标识、运输及贮存。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本标准适用于生产、加工、储运、销售、使用等各环节的民用散煤。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 2 规范性引用文件

layout_dets.text: 下列文件对于本文件的应用是必不可少的。凡是注日期的引用文件，仅注日期的版本适用于本文件。凡是不注日期的引用文件，其最新版本(包括所有的修改单)适用于本文件。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 3 术语和定义

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: GB/T31356界定的以及下列术语和定义适用于本文件。为了便于使用，以下重复列出了GB/T31356—2014中的某些术语和定义。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 商品煤 commercial coal

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 原煤经过加工处理后用于销售的煤炭产品。可分为动力用煤、冶金用煤、化工用原料煤等类别。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 动力用煤 steam coal

layout_dets.label: 段落标题
layout_dets.text: 动力煤

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 通过煤的燃烧来利用其热值的煤炭产品统称动力用煤。动力用煤按用途可分为发电用煤、工业锅炉及窑炉用煤和其他用于燃烧的煤炭产品等。

layout_dets.label: 段落标题
layout_dets.text: 民用煤 civil coal

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 用于居民炊事、取暖等分散式使用的动力用煤，可分为民用散煤和民用型煤两类。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 民用散煤 civil bulk coal

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 未经成型加工的民用煤。

layout_dets.label: 段落标题
layout_dets.text: 民用型煤 civil briquette

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 以适当的工艺和设备加工成型的民用煤，包括蜂窝煤和其他型煤。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 4 原料要求

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 4.1 类别

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 民用散煤的原料为无烟煤、烟煤和其他煤制品，如兰炭等。禁止褐煤、洗中煤、煤泥等低质、劣质煤作为民用煤使用。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 4.2 品种

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 无烟煤、烟煤的品种为符合GB/T17608规定的块煤或混煤；兰炭的品种为符合GB/T25212规定的兰炭块或兰炭混。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 5 产品分类

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 民用散煤按其质量指标分为无烟1号、无烟2号、烟煤1号和烟煤2号四类产品。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 6 要求和试验方法

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 6.1 民用散煤中不应含有 \(\mathrm{GB / T31087}\) 规定的木块、纸屑等影响利用和环保的杂物。

layout_dets.text: 7 检验规则

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 7.1 组批

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 产品按批检验，以每天产量或销量为一批。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 7.2 采样与制备

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 产品按GB/T475或GB/T19494.1的规定采取，按GB/T474或GB/T19494.2的规定制备。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 7.3 出厂检验

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 生产企业、经销企业应按表2要求的检验项目进行出厂检验。

layout_dets.label: 表名
layout_dets.text: 表 2 检验项目表
