layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 陈道明:我的“诈糊人生”

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 钱多多

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 近日，电视剧《庆余年2》在观众们的期盼中播出了，老戏骨陈道明饰演的庆帝既是掌权者、谋略家，也是一个爱子的父亲。庆帝性格矛盾，为人狠辣，但内心也有柔软之处，陈道明老师凭借着他过硬的表演让庆帝角色立体地呈现在观众面前。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 《庆余年2》路演时，男主角范闲的饰演者张若昀曾说：“道明叔叔喜欢和爸爸打麻将，我从小就看，叔叔一和就能和一天。”此时，大家才知道陈道明竟然喜欢打麻将。论演技，陈道明一直是站在中国男演员金字塔尖的人。然而很少有人知道，他的麻将和演技一样棒，还得过竞技麻将全国冠军。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 爱上麻将

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1955年4月26日，陈道明出生在天津。他自幼聪明有悟性，会画画、会朗诵、会写美术字、会弹钢琴、会拉手风琴……就连班里出黑板报、写标语这样的事老师都会交给他。陈道明什么都做得好，但就是不喜欢学习，只爱看闲书。他还继承了天津人开朗爱玩的性子，不仅爱打麻将，而且牌技很好，每次打麻将都能推算出对手的牌面。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 不上课的时候，陈道明常常呼朋引伴打麻将。孩子们很快就不爱和他打麻将了，因为他牌技太好，别人和他打麻将老输。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 没人一起玩，陈道明只好去老街里看大爷们打麻将，看的次数多了，他偶尔也会给打麻将的人出主意。一次他站在后面观战时说道：“你别出六万，出九万啊，然后就能听牌了。”同在麻将桌上的人不乐意了：“小伙子，看牌就看牌，怎么还能瞎指挥呢！”陈道明一听这话不乐意了：“我哪里是瞎指挥，我说的本来就对啊！留九万听牌的机会少啊！”

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: “别说的自己好像很厉害似的，有本事咱们打一把。”对方一听来了脾气，愣是要和陈道明叫板。陈道明二话没说，坐下就和他们开战，几圈下来，陈道明都和了。一个孩子打败三个大人，陈道明一下子成了

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 街坊里的“名人”，大家有事没事都爱喊他打两圈。他几乎每次都会赢。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 一段时间过去后，陈道明的牌技好在十里八乡都出名了。慕名前来挑战的人很多，陈道明赢的次数也很多，连他的哥哥陈道凯也曾经说：“道明不看电视，书房里堆满了书，常常睡在书里。他还喜欢打牌，几乎从来没输过，有时候手气很好，就不抓炮只自摸，我们都说他牌品很好。”虽然能够赢别人很开心，但是陈道明的精力还是放在未来发展上。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1971年，陈道明中学即将毕业，摆在他面前的只有找工作或者下乡。彼时，天津人民艺术剧院去陈道明所就读的十二中招生，班主任陈鉴铜老师让陈道明去报名，陈道明没有去，因为他更想当医生或者外交官。为了躲开陈鉴铜老师，他跑街口和大爷们打麻将去了。打着打着，陈道明无意中说出人艺招生的事情，几个牌友立马放下牌，押着陈道明就去面试了。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 去面试的路上，大家还七嘴八舌地劝他：“能唱戏、演出多好啊，那是多少人梦寐以求的地方。”“就是，说不定以后我们想见你还得掏钱买票看你演出呢！”“你长得好看又聪明，肯定能考上。”

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 大爷们把他“押”到学校，陈鉴铜老师又找了班上三个同学“押”着他进了考场。陈道明什么都没准备，进考场晃了一圈就出来了。没过多久，陈道明就接到了录取通知书，进入天津人民艺术剧院学习舞台剧表演。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 进入天津人艺后，陈道明发现生活和自己想象的“艺术生涯”完全不一样。他每天不是演匪兵，就是演伪军，要不就演尸体，总之没有一个靠谱的角色，全都是不起眼的龙套。看不见未来的生活让陈道明感到非常沮丧。就在陈道明想要放弃时，他遇见了改变自己一生的女孩——杜宪。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 彼时，杜宪是北京广播学院大一的学生。暑假时，她来到天津看望自己的舅舅。杜宪的舅舅在天津人艺工作，便带杜宪去看话剧，陈道明恰好出演了这

layout_dets.label: 页眉
layout_dets.text: 海外版名人明星

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 部话剧。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 杜宪看剧时就对那个坐着“一动不动”的年轻人很感兴趣，在舅舅的介绍下，她才知道那个年轻人名叫陈道明，他演的是一面镜子。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 在舅舅的引荐下，杜宪和陈道明认识了。杜宪对陈道明说：“你演的镜子真好笑。”陈道明对开朗大方的杜宪颇有好感，于是主动提出：“你在天津的这段时间，我带你四处逛逛吧！”

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 杜宪的舅舅对此提议非常赞成，对杜宪说：“小陈琴棋书画样样都会，又是老天津，吃的玩的都知道，让他带你逛逛一定比我带你更有意思。”

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 麻将为媒

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 接下来的日子里，陈道明带着杜宪品尝了各色美食，逛遍了天津的大街小巷。陈道明还会给杜宪弹钢琴、唱歌，爱意在两人之间悄悄滋长。逛街逛多了也会无聊，陈道明就想到教杜宪打麻将。他哄着杜宪：“教你打麻将吧，等你学会了，我带你去大杀四方。”杜宪自然欢喜。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 陈道明就在家里摆开“龙门阵”，一点点教杜宪打麻将的规则。等杜宪学会了，他又陪着杜宪打了几把，觉得杜宪打麻将的技术不错了，就带着杜宪去他常去打麻将的街口，让杜宪和街坊们打麻将。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 在陈道明的指导下，杜宪真的赢了好几次。打麻将的过程中，大爷们也看出陈道明对杜宪的感情不同，在他们临走时，大爷们悄悄嘱咐陈道明：“这姑娘不错，还愿意陪我们这些老头打麻将，你小子可得好好把握啊！”

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 陈道明听着大爷们的鼓励，看着眼前靓丽活泼的杜宪暗下决心，一定要告诉她自己的心意。晚上，送杜宪回家的路上，陈道明对她说：“刚才大爷们都夸你好，叫我要把握机会。”

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 杜宪其实已经听懂了陈道明的意思，但是矜持让她只是嗯了一声。见杜宪没有反对，陈道明大胆握住了她的手：“做我女朋友吧！”就这样，他们两人走到了一起。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 自此之后，陈道明更是经常约杜宪一起打麻将，他甚至对杜宪说：“话剧和麻将就是我们的媒人。”

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 暑假很快结束了，相爱的两个人也面临着分离。杜宪需要回到北京继续读书，而陈道明则需要留在人艺工作。杜宪非常难过，陈道明对她说：“你安心回学校，每个星期我都会给你写信的。”

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 陈道明说到做到，每周他都会给杜宪写一封信，信里偶尔会写到他和街坊们打麻将的情况。一封封情书让两个人的感情更加稳定，但是他们没想到这段感情遭到了杜宪父母的反对。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 杜宪的父母对陈道明的学历和工作状态都不满意，杜宪的母亲甚至说：“我担心你跟了他会受苦的！”得知杜宪父母的态度后，陈道明急忙从天津赶往北京，然而他在楼下等了四个小时，都没能见到杜宪。夹在陈道明和父母中间，杜宪很难过，她对陈道明说：“要不我们私奔吧。”

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 陈道明却很理解杜宪父母对女儿的用心，他向杜宪承诺：“你相信我，我一定会考到北京来的，让你父母同意你和我在一起。”回到天津后，陈道明便辞去天津人艺的工作，在家准备中央戏剧学院的考试。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 第二年，陈道明顺利考入中央戏剧学院表演训练班学习表演理论。毕业时，他们两人都被分配到中央电视台，陈道明从事电视剧制作，而杜宪则担任播音主持。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1982年，杜宪和陈道明结婚了。婚后不久，中央电视台筹拍电视剧《末代皇帝》。导演周寰和张建民觉得陈道明人长得帅气，又在天津人艺演过七年话剧，便点名让他出演末代皇帝溥仪。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 跑了七年龙套才等来这个机会，陈道明也想演好薄仪，他研读了大量清史文献、拜访了大批专家，并且在紫禁城里夜以继日地练眼神、背台词、找感觉。他的努力没有白费，《末代皇帝》播出后，获得巨大的成功，陈道明也凭借该剧荣获金鹰奖最佳男演员奖和飞天奖优秀男主角奖。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 即使获得了成功，陈道明依旧保持着谦虚的态度，他在提及这部作品时表示：“虽然我没有演得十分真实，但这部剧让我这颗糊涂的脑袋明白了如何去演绎一个角色、一个人物。”

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 不仅事业发展迅速，陈道明在麻将方面的造诣也在不断提高，他开始尝试参加一些麻将比赛，和一些专业选手同台竞技，没想到回回表现不俗。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 沉淀人生

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1990年，导演黄蜀芹想要拍摄电视剧《围城》，第一次见到陈道明时，黄蜀芹就被他身上的书生气质所吸引，认为他就是饰演方鸿渐最适合的人选。尽管陈道明很喜欢这个剧本，但是他缺乏自信。他觉得《围城》的境界太高，担心自己难以胜任。他婉拒了导演黄蜀芹：“钱老的大作我怕自己理解得不透彻，还是算了吧！”

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 黄蜀芹不愿放弃，多次到陈道明家中劝说他出演方鸿渐，但是陈道明就是铁了心，不管怎么劝都态度坚决地拒绝了。给黄蜀芹介绍演员的人很多，但她却坚持要用陈道明，她甚至对陈道明说：“你什么时候觉得自己准备好出演这部戏了，就给我打电话，我会等你，只要你答应，我们就开始拍摄。”陈道明被黄

layout_dets.label: 页眉
layout_dets.text: 海外版名人明星

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 蜀芹感动了，但还是在犹豫中。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 有人便给黄蜀芹出主意：“陈道明最喜欢打麻将，你告诉他剧里有打麻将的戏份时，说不定他就答应了。”当陈道明知道《围城》中有打麻将的戏份时，他真的点头答应出演方鸿渐。为了演好方鸿渐，陈道明特意多次拜访钱锺书，求钱老帮助自己理解剧本和方鸿渐这个人物。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 除了拜访钱老，陈道明还一边练习上海普通话，一边减肥，并在两个月内成功减肥了25斤，成为最合适的方鸿渐。陈道明的执着和努力最终获得了导演和原著作者的肯定。钱锺书专门给陈道明写了一封信，信中赞扬他：“成功地呈现出了一个活生生的方鸿渐。”

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 这部电视剧成为陈道明事业中的又一巅峰，巩固了他在演艺界的地位。陈道明凭借《围城》荣获中国电影表演艺术学会第三届学会奖、全国制片厂第二届优秀电视剧评选最佳男主角奖和第十一届飞天奖最佳男主角奖。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 演而优则唱，陈道明火了之后，就有人向他提议：“你唱歌也不错，怎么不出唱片呢。”在朋友的帮助下，陈道明出了一张情歌专辑《宽恕我的爱》。这张专辑并没有陈道明想象中的火爆，他开始反思自己是不是过于膨胀了。后来，他曾评价那段岁月中的自己：“不知深浅地以为，天下都是自己的。”

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 陈道明发觉迷失了自己，他想调整状态却怎么也做不好，他决定再次拜访钱锺书老先生。这次来到钱老家中，他发现钱老家里，没有电视，没有铜臭味，只有满屋的书香气和钱、杨二老的满腹学问，钱家安静宁和的情景，让陈道明犹如遭到凉水浇头，浑身一个激灵，内心五味杂陈。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 陈道明回忆起那时说：“我曾是个浮躁的人，幸好遇到了钱锺书先生。他让我知道，在学问面前我什么都不是。”

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 之后，陈道明接到了许多影视剧的邀约，但是他都婉拒了：“我想要休息一下。”许多人都不理解他为什么在巅峰时刻选择休息。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 陈道明却说：“在拜访钱老时，我突然发现自己对文学作品和人物的理解还是太浅薄了，想要呈现好的作品，就不能贪多求快，还是要稳扎稳打，精益求精。”从此，陈道明一边沉浸在对中国文化的深度探索中，一边继续打起了麻将。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1998年1月，北京钓鱼台国宾馆举行“98迎春竞技麻将邀请赛”。陈道明对此十分感兴趣，他回家和杜宪商量：“媳妇儿，有麻将邀请赛，我想去看看。”杜宪了解陈道明对麻将的喜爱，她十分支持：“你去比赛吧，争取拿个冠军回来。”在这次比赛中，陈道明

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 从64人中脱颖而出，取得了冠军，国家体委主任亲自给他颁奖。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 拿了这个奖，陈道明非常开心，他把奖杯放在飞天奖和金鹰奖旁边，连杜宪都笑话他：“感觉你拿麻将冠军比得影帝还开心。”

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: “这不一样，演戏是我的工作，我一定要做好，麻将是我的爱好，得奖我就开心。”言语中可以知道，陈道明是真的很喜欢打麻将。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1999年，陈道明带着作品《我的1919》走到大众面前，并凭借此作品获得华表奖优秀男演员奖以及金鸡奖最佳男主角奖。自此之后，陈道明还拍摄了许多脍炙人口的影视作品。努力拍戏、学习之余，陈道明还是会叫上朋友们在家里打麻将。朱时茂在《年代秀》里面讲过，一群人经常去他家打麻将，其中就有陈道明、宋丹丹、那英。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 雷恪生也在《群英会》说：“我会跟陈宝国、陈道明、鞠萍姐姐一起打麻将。但是我不想跟陈道明打，因为费脑子，重点是陈道明还很凡尔赛，他都不愿意和。”

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 演员袁立说：“在拍摄《黑洞》的时候，发现陈道明打得一手好麻将。陈道明日常工作会比较严肃，但是一打起麻将，皱纹都绽开了花。”

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 虽然爱玩麻将，但是陈道明却坚持做人做事都不能有投机取巧的心理。他认为：“适当的游戏放松是对的，但是不能想着走捷径，就像武术和麻将其实都是中国的‘国粹’，打麻将是中国老百姓休闲娱乐的一种最常见方式，但麻将只是一种娱乐，用来赌博则是不可取的。”

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 正因为陈道明有这种想法，所以当欢乐传媒公司邀请他担任监制来制作国内第一部关于麻将题材的电视剧《诈糊人生》时，他很开心。在面对记者提问时，陈道明说：“《诈糊人生》立意很好，我爱打麻将也见过为了麻将家破人亡的人。所以感觉应该有这样一部剧作告诫大家要踏实走好人生每一步，不能浮躁，更不能想着通过歪门邪道一夜暴富。”

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 在朋友们眼中，陈道明爱玩，能把很多东西玩得很好，他有兴趣，又有点较真，不想输。他就是个小孩，因为大人会给自己输找个理由，但是他不愿意，就比别人更下功夫去研究，这才成了全国麻将冠军。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 几十年的演艺生涯，陈道明谱写了一段“数风流人物，还看今朝”的“风流岁月”。他拍戏不多，却将《末代皇帝》围城》喜剧的忧伤》中的角色塑造得有血有肉，被奉为“国宝级演员”代表。闲暇之余，陈道明爱读书、练字、打麻将，过着开心自在的生活，实属娱乐圈的一股清流，也是很多年轻演员敬重和见贤思齐的对象。编 辑/叶正正

layout_dets.text: 海外版本刊特稿

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 跟着味蕾探索舌尖上的中国

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 凤尾

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 一身精致的西装、一句阿拉伯语与中文同时“在线”的问候语和一架自拍的相机，便拉开了王立轩一天的工作序幕。作为中国互联网上的伊拉克网红，王立轩不仅在中文社交媒体平台运营着拥有1500多万粉丝的美食达人账号“老王在中国”，还与朋友合伙经营着一家食品营销公司，是一名成功的商人。他的短视频账号简介是这样写的：“经历过生离死别的痛楚，更懂得珍惜来到中国后安定生活的来之不易，我爱这里的美食，我爱这里的风景。”

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 10年前，王立轩因为特殊经历来到中国，从此和中华文化结下了不解之缘。近年来，他凭着对中国美食的炽热兴趣，一直用味蕾探索着舌尖上的中国。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 童年时颠沛流离

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1994年，艾哈迈德·贾巴尔出生在伊拉克一个家族庞大且富裕的家庭。9岁前，他有一个幸福的童年：祖父是成功的生意人，父亲是石油工程师，一家人住着800多平方米的别墅。每到周末，全家老小聚在一起谈笑风生，他和他的堂兄弟们嬉戏打闹。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 2003年，伊拉克战争爆发了，曾经的幸福安宁被动荡不安所取代。艾哈迈德一家迫不得已舍弃万贯家产，逃离被战火笼罩的伊拉克。他和家人饱经战火洗礼，艾哈迈德还被流弹打穿了身体，差点失去生命。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 2014年，艾哈迈德一家人在亲戚的帮助下，来到了中国。初到中国时，他在宁夏银川的一个国际学校做阿拉伯语的实习老师。为了能更好地融入和开启异国新生活，他给自己起了一个特别中国化的名字：王立轩。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 王立轩一边在学校教阿拉伯语，一边自学汉语。为了早一天用汉语和人无障碍交流，他成了社交达人，哪里人多，他就往哪里钻。他学会的第一句汉语是：“你好，这是什么？”之后，这句话成了王立轩与人打招呼的开头语。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 久而久之，不管是同事还是学生，

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 只要看到王立轩，就会习惯性地教他一句中文“这是水杯”“这是烤羊肉串”“这是照相机”……王立轩为了表达自己的感激，包里随时准备着各种小礼品，他会把不同的礼品送给不同的人。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 有一次，一个名叫丁波涛的人带着自己的女朋友，来学校报名学习阿拉伯语，但是因为错过了报名时间，名额已经报满。丁波涛的女朋友很失望，言语里充满了对他的责怪。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 王立轩得知后，就主动提出每天晚上抽出两个小时免费帮对方补习阿拉伯语。丁波涛特别感动，后来两人成了无话不谈的好朋友。王立轩也在对方的帮助下，学习了更多的中文。短短一年时间，他就可以用中文与人无障碍交流了。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 2017年初，王立轩遇到了人生中职业转折的第一个契机。他被一家模特公司看上，并邀请去做了一次时装走秀。最初，双方谈好的价格是一次500元，因为王立轩形象好，台步走得也好，做事努力又真诚，打动了老板，当即又给他加了300元。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 王立轩抽出三张百元大钞，还给老板，说：“我就按我们约定的价格收费，希望我们合作愉快。感谢您为我提供的机会，我非常喜欢在舞台上的感觉。如果再有这样的工作，希望您还能找我。”

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 之后，王立轩就和那位模特公司的老板成了朋友，对方还把他举荐给了一位电影导演，让王立轩得到了人生中第一次拍电影的机会。结果，因为王立轩

layout_dets.label: 页眉
layout_dets.text: 海外版 本刊特稿

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 的勤奋努力，敢拼敢做，把角色塑造得很精彩，又给导演留下了深刻的印象。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 该导演又将王立轩推荐给了其他导演，就这样，王立轩陆续参与拍摄了32部电影，并随剧组去了新疆、内蒙古、四川、重庆、江苏、广东、东北……每到一个地方，王立轩一定少不了去品尝当地美食，游览当地的名胜古迹。他说：“我爱中国，我一定要了解我脚下的这片土地，走遍中国的大好河山，交遍天下朋友。”

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 王立轩有一次和朋友聊天，他说：“我童年的伙伴都在战乱中失去了生命。所以，我特别羡慕你们有发小，我也渴望交到很多很多朋友，弥补我的遗憾。”而王立轩的热情和真诚也确实让他交到了不少朋友，同时也让他的事业一步步走向成功。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 王立轩对朋友非常讲义气。有一次，一个同事家里遇到了困难，王立轩得知后，把身上仅有的5000元钱全部给了他。而那一个月，因为没有足够的生活费，他靠面包与白开水充饥。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 因为喜欢表演与创作，2018年，王立轩报名了宁夏回族自治区政府举办的网络短视频培训班，开始学习网络短视频的制作和平台的运营技巧。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 不久后，王立轩成立了自己的影视公司，开始尝试拍摄微电影。公司规模不大，包括他在内一共有11人。他把每一位员工都当成了自己的兄弟，和大家一起策划，找剧本，选场地……然而，就在公司慢慢好起来时，却因为投资方遇到了无法解决的困难，公司面临着破产。王立轩便用积蓄和借的5万元给员工发了工资，影视公司就此戛然而止。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 用诚信开创事业

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 王立轩的生活再次举步维

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 艰，可即便如此，与朋友聚会时，他还是会抢着买单，开心地与大家交流，脸上看不出一丝愁容。知道他处境的朋友，对他说：“你应该学会向我们示弱，毕竟朋友就是用来麻烦的。所以你需要帮助了请一定告诉我们。”王立轩笑着说：“授之以鱼不如授之以渔，我想创业，只要你们愿意教授我一些生意经就可以了。”

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 有一位做销售的朋友给王立轩出主意：“找到一个你喜欢做的领域，在这个领域找一个你认为不错的品牌，再找更多人一起销售。不光对外批发，还可以线上线下一起做。等有了固定客户，就可以开始做自己的品牌了。”

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 朋友不仅把自己的创业经验告诉王立轩，还手把手教他怎么寻找品牌，怎么做宣传，怎么去销售。王立轩说自己有一个中国胃，特别喜欢中国美食，所以他想选择这个领域。于是，他瞄准了牛肉干这个创业领域。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 2020年5月，王立轩开始跟两个朋友合伙做美食团购，主要销售牛肉干。内蒙古牛肉干全国闻名，不仅好吃，其历史文化背景更是源远流长，是王立轩最喜欢的一道“开胃小菜”。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 朋友负责提供货源，王立轩负责前端销售。在他们的共同努力下，由于货源质量过硬，物美价廉，团购生意越来越好，回购率也越来越高。这一年，他们竟然销售了2000多万元的产品。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 但好景不长，因为货源不充足，其中一个合伙人竟然找来了猪肉干代替牛肉干卖给了消费者。得知此事后，王立轩第一次向朋友发了脾气，并要求追回卖出去的产品。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 最终，王立轩决定退出合作团队，大家都劝他算了，毕竟一天的流水就是一百多万元。而且，又不是只有他们一家公司以次充

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 好，以假乱真，只要他们不再有下次，就行了。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 但王立轩不想让利益蒙住自己的眼睛。他说：“诚信就如碎了的玻璃，再也回不到最初的模样。尤其对我更重要，失去了它，就等于失去了我的生命，所以我必须得离开。”

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 2022年，王立轩又和朋友丁波涛合作，步入了第三次创业，他们选择的仍然是牛肉干的销售。不过，这次的模式是自产自销。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 两人给公司起名“龙帮”。“龙”代表中国，“帮”是友好地互帮互助。公司成立之初，王立轩就立下规矩：诚信和品质永远第一。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 王立轩和丁波涛经常出去考察市场。有一次，他们刚到锡盟，王立轩便拉着丁波涛开启了“炫”饭模式：牛肉面、羊蝎子、贴骨肉、羊肉汤、涮羊肉……种类繁多的锡盟美食，让王立轩应接不暇。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 吃饭时，王立轩不停地念叨：“好吃好吃，实在太好吃了。”吃到麻辣的食物，他说：“有很多蚂蚁在我嘴巴里打架。”吃到软糯香甜的糯米粥，他说：“这是一团棉花糖，咬上一口，滋味胜过千言万语。”

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 王立轩还一边吃一边讲解美食的来历。丁波涛觉得有趣，便拍下来发在了王立轩的个人视频账号“老王在中国”上。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 那条视频赢得了很多人的点赞和转发，丁波涛便对他说：“既然你这么喜欢吃美食，又喜欢旅游，不如去做一个美食探店达人。”朋友无意的一句话，点醒了王立轩。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 在一次旅途中，王立轩吃到一份“肉比面多”的牛肉面。他觉得店主很真诚，于是就把那家店和那碗牛肉面拍在了他的镜头里，还一边吃一边说出了对美食的感受。出乎意料的是，这条无比“随意”的作品竟然又大火了。

layout_dets.text:
我，一个作家，一度迷上了
绘画，没考虑  
效果，因为这个原因，
画，是静态的，

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text:
反而，物体的静止，
——花，手套——
恰恰因此使它们摆脱一种
仅仅在空间中移动的

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 必然性，仿佛它们是——不是孩子！而是思考中的男人或充满电荷并传递着的女人狂躁中带着狂喜；

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 对于我，更像是用来呈现某种更意味深长的动静：一系列变化的叶子静静依附，假定说，在

layout_dets.text: 昨晚暴风雨后的猫荆棘，它的水滴不规则地排列在拱曲的茎上，作为一种伴奏。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text:
噢，多好的黎明在窗子里！鸣炮致敬。  
摩西的竹筏漂向绿色的尼罗河。  
凝然站立在空气里，我飞过花丛：  
可爱的康乃馨和郁金香摆放在长桌上。  
也会听到狩猎号角的吹奏。  
无尽的大地上的造物：  
百里香的芬芳，枞树的色彩，白色的霜，鹤的舞蹈。每一事物同时存在。或者永恒。  
不能看见，不能听到，但它仍是。  
不能被琴弦和石头证明，但它  
仍存在着紫红色的冰淇淋，我们融化在天空中。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 今年的搞笑诺贝尔奖结果新鲜出炉了，9月18日，在波士顿大学举行了颁奖典礼。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 搞笑诺贝尔奖，有点像是“恶搞版”的科研比赛，评判标准和其他科研不同，它的宗旨是“表彰那些让人发笑但又会引发思考”的研究。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 每一届的获奖成果都让人忍俊不禁，今年也不例外。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 今年的生物学奖获得者来自日本，算上这一次获奖，日本的科学家已经连续19年获得搞笑诺贝尔奖了。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 研究团队的负责人是小岛知树，他们进行了一项古怪的实验，将颜料涂在牛身上，模拟出斑马的条纹，目的是研究这种条纹防蚊虫的效果。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: “穿上”条纹就能防蚊虫？听起来有点不靠谱，但最终的成果很意外。研究人员表示，对养牛户来说，吸血蝇是非常棘手的问题，在美国，每年造成的经济损失超过22亿美元。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 平常，大多数养牛户会使用杀虫剂来防蚊，这一次研究，就是希望能找到更环保的方式来替代化学杀虫剂。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 用条纹来防蚊虫，最成功的案例就是斑马，早期很多研究都认为，斑马条纹状的皮毛能有效防止蚊虫叮咬。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 受到这些研究的启发，研究人员就萌生了一个大胆的想法：在牛身上涂上班马一样的条纹，是不是也能骗过那些小飞虫？

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 此次研究的实验对象是日本黑牛，研究的结果是：涂了斑马条纹的牛，被蚊虫叮咬的次数减少了\(50\%\)。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 目前，日本爱知县和山形县已将该成果应用在农业中，作为示范基地，他们正在着手给牛儿们画上“斑马纹”。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 唯一不足的是，牛身上的颜料并不长久，几天就会消失，所以需要开发一种效果更持久但环保的涂料。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 这种圆鼓鼓的小鸟，是世界最萌小鸟之一，它们有着独特的社会行为

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 北长尾山雀生活在由高大树木组成的森林中，是高度肉食性的鸟类，主要食物来源是陆生无脊椎动物，对于人类来说算是一种“益鸟”了。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 另外，它们还是一种留鸟，它们会留在繁殖地内越冬，或者根据食物做短距离的迁徙。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 北长尾山雀不仅形象可爱，它们的社会行为也非常独特、有趣。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 越冬对于北长尾山雀来说是巨大的挑战，它们很容易受到极端寒冷天气的影响，据信在有些时候，一个冬季它们就会有 \(80\%\) 的个体死亡。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 为了度过冬季，北长尾山雀会组建临时的越冬鸟群，通常有6-17只个体组成，这些个体包括亲属，也包括非亲属，它们彼此挨在一起取暖。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 有趣的是，越冬鸟群中那些非亲属关系的友谊是在繁殖季节建立的。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 越冬结束之后，鸟群就会解散，各自筑巢寻找配偶繁殖，但是它们筑巢繁殖的成功率只有 \(17\%\) ，而那些没有筑巢成功的个体——无论雌雄，就会变成所谓的“辅助鸟”，帮助其它鸟巢喂养雏鸟。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 有研究揭示，大约 \(50\%\) 北长尾山雀的巢穴中都有一只或多只辅助鸟。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 辅助鸟通常是辅助自己的亲属，但也可能是非亲属。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 很多人可能好奇，辅助非亲属有什么意义？

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 这种牺牲可能确实有其意义，它们可以通过辅助积累经验，也可以为自己培养出更多的、未来潜在的配偶。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 当然，还有建立一起越冬的友谊，让自己更有可能度过冬季。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 虽然，北长尾山雀会在冬季损失掉大部分个体，同时大部分个体也都会筑巢失败，但是它们通过这种辅助的方式，能够提高一些巢穴的繁殖成功率，从而快速恢复种群。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 据网络 编辑/王培

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 百科&生活

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 【“坐站测试”可预测死亡风险】东芬兰大学的研究团队发现，“坐站测试”能有效预测中老年人未来的死亡风险。该测试要求受试者在无支撑物帮助的情况下，在地面坐下再站起。研究人员对4282名 \(46\sim 75\) 岁的受试者进行中位时间长达12.3年的随访发现，得分最低组 \((0\sim 4\) 分)的自然死亡率为 \(42\%\) ，得分8分组为\(11\%\) ，而满分(10分)组仅为 \(3.7\%\) 。专家解释，要在测试中获得高分，需具备良好的肌肉力量、柔韧性和平衡能力，这些正是长期健康的重要预测指标。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 【人类可与肠道工程菌远程“对话”】天津大学与西北农林科技大学的研究团队联合攻关，成功构建了“可吞服光电子胶囊——工程菌双向交流系统”，为肠道健康监测与疾病治疗开辟了新路径。专家认为，该成果为肠道微生物研究提供了全新工具，未来结合人工智能和云技术，有望实现对肠道健康的动态监测与精准调控。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 【科学家培育出新型“全脑”类器官】美国约翰·霍普金斯大学的研究人员培育出一种新型“全脑”类器官，不仅包含多个脑区的神经组织，还具有初步的血管结构。尽管其体积远小于真实人脑，仅包含600万至700万个神经元，而成年人脑中神经元数量多达千亿级，但该类器官为研究疾病提供了一个前所未有的人类脑细胞模型。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 【听音乐无感或是因为大脑“断连”】听觉正常者完全无法从音乐中感受到任何乐趣的现象，被称为特异性音乐快感缺乏症，其原因在于大脑听觉网络与奖赏网络之间的功能连接减弱。西班

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 牙巴塞罗那大学的神经科学家研究团队阐述了其背后的脑机制，并指出理解这种“断连”有助于揭示人们在体验愉悦与快乐时的个体差异。对音乐缺乏快感，是由于奖赏回路与听觉网络之间的连接出现了断裂，而不是奖赏回路本身功能异常。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 【“一喷通”切莫盲目使用】目前，市面上有号称“一喷通”的鼻喷雾剂。这类可快速起效药物的核心成分是减充血剂，其工作原理是快速收缩鼻腔黏膜血管，从而迅速缓解鼻塞。长期反复使用此类药物，会导致血管反射性持续舒张，使鼻腔黏膜肿胀更严重，鼻塞加剧，甚至发展成药物性鼻炎。鼻塞严重的患者应在医生的指导下正规、短期使用相应药物，但不建议连续使用超过7天。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 【营养不足影响渐冻症治疗效果】被确诊为渐冻症后，很多患者和家属都更关心“吃药”而不是“吃饭”。渐冻症患者的营养状况会影响病情，国内外的多项研究都显示，体重快速下降的患者，通常病情进展也更加迅速。因此，对

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 渐冻症患者来说，做好营养支持、保持体重稳定非常重要。如果患者的营养跟不上，还可能对治疗效果造成不利影响。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 【被蜱虫叮咬应立即处理】被蜱虫叮咬后的症状往往因人而异，被叮咬部位可能出现红肿、瘙痒或轻微疼痛，部分人群对蜱虫唾液中的蛋白质过敏，可能出现皮疹、水疱，甚至全身性的荨麻疹。被蜱虫叮咬后首先应尽快移除蜱虫，用镊子或者专用蜱虫移除工具，紧贴皮肤夹住蜱虫头部，缓慢垂直向上拔除，切勿旋转或者猛拉，以免蜱虫口器断裂留在皮肤内。移除虫体后，使用酒精或碘伏清洁被叮咬部位，避免感染。在接下来的几周内，如出现发热、皮疹或其他异常症状，应及时就医。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 【要重视卵巢癌的预警信号】卵巢癌的隐匿性在于，一旦超声检查提示性质可疑，往往已是晚期。女性应从青春期开始，每年定期进行妇科检查；若出现腹胀、尿频、腰围突增、持续疲劳等，且症状持续超过2周，请务必到妇科就诊；绝经后女性出现持续性腹胀、阴道流血，或6个月内体重下降超过 \(10\%\) ，都要立即就诊。一旦确诊为病理性囊肿，应及时手术治疗，不要拖延。早发现、早诊断、早治疗，永远是防治肿瘤的关键。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 【锻炼肌肉有助于神经元生长】美国麻省理工学院的机械工程学家发现，肌肉在人体运动过程中收缩时，会释放出一种名为肌肉因子的生化信号。在存在肌肉因子这种生化信号的情况下，神经元的生长速度快了4倍。这项研究成果有望为修复受损和功能恶化的神经元提供相关的运动疗法。据网络编辑/王培

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 张朝阳商界登顶再搏浪，人生下半场更热血

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 2025年9月14日，粤东南澳岛饶平海湾。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 搜狐创始人、CEO张朝阳，缓缓钻进汹涌的海水中。8.69公里的距离，他用蛙泳坚持了5小时18分钟，最终成功横渡饶平海湾。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 61岁的张朝阳，除了管理公司，还在网上讲物理课，同时又抽出时间练游泳……

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 外界不禁好奇：他的精力怎么这么旺盛？

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 吃生蚝“报仇”

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 横渡当天，上午8时59分，张朝阳在热身后正式入水，从汕头南澳岛出发，开始了这次横渡挑战。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 一开始，张朝阳保持了稳定的划水频率与呼吸节奏，进展顺利。然而，当他游至深水海域时，遭遇了洋流与蚝区险情。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 洋流速度约3公里/小时，游泳速度一旦跟不上，方向可能被洋流带偏；水下的蚝区则布满绳索和锋利的贝壳，很容易划伤皮肤。为此，张朝阳一度不得不上船暂避，观察情况后才再次下水。事后他回忆说：“洋流和蚝区本身问题不大，但二者结合非常危险。”

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 游了5小时18分后，张朝阳顺利抵达潮州市饶平县长溪湾沙滩。上岸那一刻，张朝阳浑身湿透，嘴唇发紫，但眼神里有种久违的光芒。“水非常干净，空气也非常好。”他如此评价这次横渡

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 第二天，张朝阳又出现在汕头美食街吃生蚝。店家介绍说，这些生蚝正是来自他前一天“搏斗”过的那片蚝区。张朝阳一边吃蚝烙，一边开玩笑说：“今天吃到蚝，有一种复仇的感觉。”

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 这次横渡，成了张朝阳人生中的又一次“跨界”。有网友感叹：“不羡慕张朝阳的亿万身家和学历，但羡慕他的游泳实力和顶尖耐力。”

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 其实，为了备战横渡，张朝阳已经坚持训练了两个月。他每天游泳2公里，隔天跑步5公里，到后期增加到每天跑步6公里、游泳2公里。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 他说，人活着就是要不断折腾，而运动和自律是保持身心健康的基础。“当你处在焦虑状态，或者卡

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 在人生某一个地方的时候，可以适当运动。运动的出发点，是要做一个健康的人、有活力的人。”

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 我是中国互联网第一代创业者

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 张朝阳和他所创立的搜狐曾是很多人的互联网“初代记忆”。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1995年，31岁的张朝阳拿到美国麻省理工学院(MIT)物理学博士学位后，回国创办了“爱特

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 信”网站，提供分类搜索服务。没过多久，他把网站改名为“搜乎”。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1998年，“搜乎”正式更名为“搜狐”。那时，后来成为巨头的几家互联网公司才刚刚起步，甚至还没成立。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 两年后，张朝阳带领搜狐在纳斯达克成功上市，但这还不是搜狐最辉煌的时候。2008年北京奥运会，搜狐作为官方赞助商，创下了5分钟访问量300万、1小时访问量破亿等多项纪录，不仅是中文网站中的佼佼者，在全球互联网上也引起关注。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 那一年，身家达到67亿元的张朝阳坐上了中国首富之位。然而，身处巅峰后，他有些意兴阑珊：“我是中国互联网第一代创业者，这些年够煎熬的了，我厌倦了。如果现在全然退休，肯定能活得更高兴。”

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 他后来坦言，那时的他“自我”“傲慢”，人生目标被简化为追求更高的市值和更多的财富，这反而带来了巨大的空虚和痛苦。他甚至公开表示：“钱多不是幸福的保证，我这么有钱，却这么痛苦。”随后，他开始了彻底“放飞自我”的生活。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 他把公司交给高管团队，不再频繁见客户，也不主动张罗会议，而是把时间花在看书、听音乐、蹦迪、散步、登山、运动等各种兴趣上。他在三亚湾有一艘叫“Sunset”（落日）的游艇上还自创了一种舞步，名叫“查尔斯狐步舞”（查尔斯是张朝阳的英文名字）。他开始注重养生，很少吃肉，夏天不喝冰水，每天坚持做瑜伽。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 但正是在那几年，互联网格局悄然改变。新浪转型为资讯门户，网易靠游戏站稳脚跟，而后起的百度、腾讯、阿里巴巴在搜索、社交和电商领域快速崛起。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: MAKING THE GRADE

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Assessing the future value of graduated National League prospects

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: by J.J. COOPER, MATT EDDY and GEOFF PONTES

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Future value is often in the eye of the beholder, especially when it comes to projecting the future value of prospects and young major leaguers.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: That's why we asked three of our writers to identify the best bets for future success among this year's graduated National League rookies.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: To do so, JJ Cooper (JJ), Matt Eddy (ME) and Geoff Pontes (GP) took part in an informal 30-pick draft. The goal was to identify players with the highest perceived

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: peak value and likelihood of achieving it.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Eligible players are those who lost rookie status in 2025 by exceeding 130 career at-bats, 50 career innings or 45 career days of active MLB service. Big leaguers who retain rookie status in 2026, including Bubba Chandler, Bryce Eldridge and Nolan McLean, are excluded.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Each player drafted is presented with an upside role, expressed as BA Grade, a risk assessment and an adjusted grade that factors role and risk.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 1. DRAKE BALDWIN

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: C, BRAVES

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Upside Role: 60 (occasional all-star C). Risk: Mild. Adjusted: 55.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Baldwin is one of about a dozen rookie catchers to produce a three-win season at age 24 or younger in the 30-team era. The lefthanded batter did a bit of everything well, with positive indicators for contact and impact to go with near-average fielding ability. Baldwin's offensive production remained steady all season, even as he started a career-high 85 games behind the plate. (ME)

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 2. CADE HORTON

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: RHP, CUBS

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text:
Upside Role: 60 (No. 3 starter)  
Risk: Low. Adjusted: 55.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Horton was the Cubs' ace for much of the second half of the season before his season ended with a rib fracture. The Cubs have reason to wonder if their postseason run would have played out differently had he been healthy. Horton's mid-90s fastball, sweeper, curve and changeup give him a multitude of ways to keep hitters off-balance. (JJ)

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 3. CHASE BURNS

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: RHP, REDS

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text:
Upside Role: 70 (No. 2 starter)  
Risk: High. Adjusted: 55.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The Reds drafted Burns second overall in 2024 and called him up within a year. It came down to Burns or Jacob Misiorowski for this spot. Burns wins in the command department, without sacrificing swing-and-miss stuff. His velocity is elite and so is his strikeout potential. (GP)

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 4. JACOB MISIOROWSKI

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: RHP, BREWERS

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Upside Role: 70 (No. 2 starter). Risk: High. Adjusted: 55.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Misiorowski averaged 99.3 mph on his fastball, making him a fraction slower than Hunter Greene as baseball's hardest-throwing starter. Misiorowski's 94 mph slider/cutter and 87 mph curveball are the fastest breaking pitches among starting pitchers and point to the reasons to be optimistic about his future in the rotation, especially as he dials in his control and command with experience. (ME)

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 5. MATT SHAW

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 3B, CUBS

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Upside Role: 55 (solid-average 38). Risk: Average. Adjusted: 45.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Shaw's rookie season started poorly enough that he was demoted to Triple-A in late April. He returned by mid May and handled third base for the remainder of the season. His pullheavy approach showed flashes of power to go with his plus speed. Nothing about his rookie season was spectacular, but he was a league-average hitter for most of the second half of the season. He could be a solid third baseman for years to come. (JJ)

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 6.ROKI SASAKI

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: RHP, DODGERS

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Upside Role: 60 (No. 3 starter). Risk: High. Adjusted: 45.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: After a humbling beginning to his MLB career—24 strikeouts and 22 walks in his first 34.1 innings—Sasaki found success

layout_dets.label: 页脚
layout_dets.text: NOVEMBER/DECEMBER 2025 - BASEBALLAMERICA.COM

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: out of the bullden at points during the Dodgers' 2025 World Series run. He missed four months of his rookie season with a shoulder injury but still has a chance to develop into a long-term rotation piece. (GP)

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 7. DYLAN CREWS

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: OF, NATIONALS

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Upside Role: 55 (first-division CF). Risk: Average. Adjusted: 45.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: While Crews has not yet lived up to his draft pedigree as the No. 2 overall pick in 2023, he has shown flashes of power, speed, on-base ability and capability in center field, where he might align best if James Wood and Daylen Lile occupy the corners in Washington. Crews showed above-average bat speed in his 2025 rookie season—one interrupted for nearly three months by an oblique injury—but he has plenty of work to do to become a productive regular. (ME)

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 8. CHASE DOLLANDER

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: RHP, ROCKIES

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text:
Upside Role: 60 (No. 3 starter)  
Risk: High. Adjusted: 45.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Dollander became the latest in a long line of pitchers to be devoured by Coors Field. He posted a 9.98 ERA at home, but his stuff is better than the results. Dollander's plus velocity didn't play. MLB hitters beat up his 98 mph softball, and his plus curveball was hindered by Coors Field. The underlying pieces are here to be a solid starter,

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: but the new Rockies regime will need to help him figure out how to adapt to altitude. (JJ)

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 9. DALTON RUSHING

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: C, DODGERS

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Upside Role: 55 (First-division C). Risk: Average. Adjusted: 45.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Used sporadically throughout the year, Rushing spent nearly a full season in the majors in 2025. He showed flashes of his power-and-patience approach in his 155-plate appearance sample. If given the opportunity to play every day, Rushing could develop into a dynamic, bat-first catcher. Playing time with the Dodgers will be difficult to come by with Will Smith behind the plate and first baseman Freddie Freeman under contract through 2027. (GP)

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 10. JAKOB MARSEE

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: OF, MARLINS

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Upside Role: 50 (solid-average CF). Risk: Mild. Adjusted: 45.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Marsee piqued interest by hitting 14 homers and stealing 47 bases in a four-month stretch at Triple-A. He continued to hit when the Marlins called him up in August and seized the center field job as a rookie. While Marsee may lack a true carrying tool, he does a little bit of everything well—he hits for average, takes walks, steals bases, defends and throws—and should remain a contributing player through his 20s. (ME)

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: FORMER BALLPLAYERS REFLECT ON PRO SUCCESS AND FAILURE

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: FROM D-III TO MLB

layout_dets.label: 图注
layout_dets.text: CHRIS TROT MAN/GETTY IMAGES

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Zach Lutz's unique journey took him from Alvernia to Queens

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: by KYLE BANDUJO

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Home is where the heart is, they say. In the case of Zach Lutz, that adage was true.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: In 2004, Lutz was the senior third baseman for Governor Mifflin High outside Reading, Pa., when he had to decide between prominent Division I programs such as Notre Dame, South Carolina and Stanford—and their state-of-the-art facilities and annual Omaha aspirations—or staying home to attend Division III Alvernia.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Alvernia had gone a respectable 27-17 in 2004, but the real draw was that it was coached by Zach's father Yogi. "My mind was always set on going to play for my dad," Zach Lutz said. "That's what I had my trust in. He knew my swing better than anybody."

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: As an Alvernia freshman, Lutz teamed with fellow future big leaguer Anthony Recker to lead the club to a 41-6 record. He played both ways, hitting .423 and carrying a 9-0 record and 3.32 ERA on the mound.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Lutz followed with a .464 average as a sophomore and then hit .454 as a junior in 2007, when he was named D-III player of the year. The Mets drafted him in the fifth round that year.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: He had never struggled in high school or college, but the jump to pro ball was different. It was apparent from his first Mets minicamp in Port St. Lucie, Fla.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: "I faced some Latin kid, and he was throwing 98 miles per hour," Lutz said, "and afterward I called my dad and said, 'Dad I've got no shot. I couldn't even see it."

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Coach Lutz calmed his son, and while Zach was able to quickly correct his mindset and assert himself at the plate, his main problem was not being up there nearly as much as he would have liked.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: "Most of my career was derailed by injuries, a lot of freak injuries," he Lutz.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Lutz broke a bone in his foot in his first pro game, which resulted in surgery to insert six screws into his foot. The injury bug didn't stop there.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: In his minor league career, Lutz suffered multiple concussions, injuries to his hamstring and ankle and a broken ring finger via a foul ball hit into the dugout.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Because of those injuries, Lutz didn't see significant Double-A time until 2010. He proved he was up for the challenge with a .967 OPS. He followed with productive, albeit truncated, seasons at Triple-A in 2011 and '12.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Finding an opening on the Mets' major league roster proved to be more of a challenge.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: "I had David Wright in front of me at third base." Lutz said. "I had Lucas Duda and Ike Davis over at first base.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: "I knew I just needed to swing the bat (if) they were going to find a spot for me."

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Lutz received his first callup in late April 2012 to replace the injured Jason Bay. He appeared in 22 games for the Mets in 2012 and '13 but struggled to break through. He went 7-for-31 (.226) with two doubles, six walks and 11 strikeouts in 22 games.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Lutz spent his later years searching for an opportunity to keep hitting. He played in both Japan and Korea. He played winter ball in the Dominican Republic. He spent time in the independent Atlantic League.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: He retired following the 2017 season, still able to hit, but unable to keep up with the physical day-in, day-out demands of professional baseball.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Lutz's on-field results in pro ball, not to mention big league service time, gave him the satisfaction that he was built for his unique journey.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: "You get drafted out of a Division III school and thrown into pro ball, it's a completely different world," Lutz said. "You've gotta be mentally tough to get through that, and that's how it was."

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Zach Lutz earned Division III player of the year honors in 2007, the year the Mets drafted him. He reached the majors briefly with New York, but a series of injuries undercut his potential.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: The Urban Imperative

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: One of the recommendations made in October by the Communist Party of China Central Committee for formulating the 15th Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development (2026-30) has attracted widespread attention among the Chinese public: "We should continue to tap the full potential of cities, make a strong push to advance urban renewal and build people-centered modern cities that are innovative, livable, beautiful, resilient, culturally rich and smart." The reason for the buzz is the boom in urban infrastructure construction the recommendations are expected to bring and the resulting economic development.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Urban renewal is a core strategy in China's ongoing urbanization process. It transcends mere physical transformation, representing a comprehensive process essential for building sustainable cities of the future.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: China's urban population reached 67 percent of the total at the end of 2024, with urban development shifting from the stage of large-scale incremental expansion to the stage of improving the quality and efficiency of existing resources. But many Chinese cities, especially those that have expanded rapidly, are confronted with severe urban challenges, such as aging infrastructure, outdated water supply, drainage, gas and electricity networks, poor roads, and substandard living conditions. Old residential

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: communities lack modern facilities, parking spaces, elevators and green spaces. Urban renewal aims to alleviate these problems, enhancing the carrying capacity of cities and making them more livable.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Urban renewal is also a crucial engine for stimulating domestic demand and promoting economic growth. Renewal projects will drive huge private investment in multiple industries such as construction, building materials, design and real estate, thus stimulating investment. In addition, by renovating old factories and neighborhoods, new business forms including cultural and creative industries, technology and tourism can be introduced to achieve industrial upgrading and cultivate new drivers of growth.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: However, improving people's wellbeing and enhancing their sense of happiness and fulfillment are the core goals of urban renewal in China. Renovating or replacing dilapidated or old buildings, installing elevators and improving kitchen and bathroom facilities can directly enhance people's quality of life. In areas under renewal, elderly care, child care, medical care, education and community service facilities will be upgraded to improve public services. The optimization of community environments and the expansion of community spaces will lead to greater community cohesion and social harmony. BR

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Aircraft Maintenance

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Staff of the Grand China Aviation Maintenance Co. Ltd., a subsidiary of Hainan Airlines Group, perform maintenance on an aircraft at the Hainan Free Trade Port One-Stop Aircraft Maintenance Base in Haikou, Hainan Province, on November 21.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Domestic Violence

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The Supreme People's Procuratorate (SPP), China's top procuratorate, said on November 25 more than 500 defendants in domestic violence criminal cases have been sentenced to life imprisonment or more severe penalties over the past five years.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Chinese prosecutors have stepped up supervision over the handling of domestic violence cases to protect women's rights and interests. Since 2021, Chinese procuratorial agencies have approved the arrest of more than 2,800 suspects involved in relevant crimes and have prosecuted more than 3,400, according to the SPP.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: "Domestic violence is not only an infringement on the legitimate rights and interests of family members, but is also harmful to social order and public interests," Ge Xiaoyan,

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Deputy Procurator-General of the SPP, said.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The SPP pledged greater efforts to punish criminal offenses against women in accordance with the law. It also vowed to carry out regular crackdowns on the trafficking of women and seriously punish sexual assault crimes.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: China revised the Law on the Protection of Rights and Interests of Women and put it into force on January 1, 2023, protecting women in a wide range of areas, including gender equality, employment and maternity insurance.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Curbing Tax Evasion

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The Supreme People's Court (SPC), China's top court, has reiterated the importance of cracking down on crimes related to tax collection and management, calling for stronger judicial efforts to safeguard national tax revenues and

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: maintain market order.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The SPC released eight notable tax-related cases on November 24, emphasizing the need to reinforce tax compliance and guide lawful tax practices through judicial measures. It urged courts nationwide to focus on combating the use of dual contracts for tax evasion purposes and the profiteering from reselling invoices through online platforms.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Yin and yang contracts, or dual contracts, involve producing two documents for the same agreement. One reflects the parties' true intentions, while the other lists a lower amount to be submitted to tax authorities.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: In March 2024, the SPC and the SPP declared these contracts to be a tax evasion method in a judicial interpretation aimed at helping judges and prosecutors address increasingly covert and difficult to detect illegal practices.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Science Forum

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The Greater Bay Area Science Forum 2025 will be held in Guangdong Province and Hong Kong and Macao special administrative regions between December 6 and 8 in a bid to advance the building of an international scientific and technological innovation hub in the region. The Greater Bay Area is a city cluster encompassing nine cities in Guangdong and Hong Kong and Macao special administrative regions.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The opening ceremony will take place at the Nansha International Convention and Exhibition Center in Guangzhou on December 7, gathering high-ranking officials and prominent representatives from the business and academic fields from home and abroad, Guo Yile, Deputy Secretary-General of the Guangdong Provincial Government, said.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Sub-forums will be held in Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Yangjiang, and Huizhou in Guangdong and in Hong Kong and Macao, focusing on emerging and future industry technologies, Guo said at a news conference in Guangzhou on November 26.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: During the forum, the Chinese Academy of Sciences will deliver a report on the performance of the major scientific and technological infrastructure it has jointly built in Guangdong, Ren Hai, Director of the academy's Guangzhou branch, said.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Ice Building

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The annual construction of the world's largest ice-and-snow theme park, Harbin Ice-Snow World, began in Harbin, capital of Heilongjiang Province, on November 25.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Work on the park, which is

About 10,000 workers will use some 200,000 cubic meters of ice stored for over 10 months for building the ice sculptures and buildings, as rivers have not yet fully frozen this winter, according to Cong Peiyu, Director of the design and development department of Harbin Ice-Snow World Co. Ltd.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The early start and use of reserved ice will help the park open as scheduled in late December, Cong said.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The park drew more than 3.56 million guests over its 68-day operation during last season, which ran from December 21, 2024 to February 26 this year.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Harbin, often called China's "ice city," has turned its long, cold winters into a major tourist attraction. Last winter, the city welcomed a record 90.36 million visitors, generating 137.22 billion yuan (\$19 billion) in revenue, a 16.6-percent increase year on year.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Giant Panda Population

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: China's population of captive giant pandas has nearly doubled over the past

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: decade, reaching 808, head of the National Forestry and Grassland Administration, Liu Guohong, said on November 21.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: This growth has established a sustainable breeding group for the species, Liu said at the Global Panda Partners Conference 2025 held in Chengdu, capital of Sichuan Province, from November 20 to 22.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The population represents a significant rise from the 422 recorded in late 2015. Liu attributed the growth to improved breeding research, including establishing a national innovation alliance for giant Panda conservation, which pools resources for the study of key issues such as genetic diversity.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: China has improved the protection of giant panda habitats. Seventy-three isolated nature reserves were integrated into the Giant Panda National Park, which covers 22,000 square km.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Known as the "hometown of giant pandas," Sichuan has the largest panda habitat in the world and is home to over 70 percent of China's wild giant panda population.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: College Graduates

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The Ministry of Education said on November 20 the total number of college graduates

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: A Flourishing Industry

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: A worker sorts potted flowers at a smart agriculture demonstration park in Xingqing District of Yinchuan, Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region, on November 25. In recent years, the district has leveraged its abundant sunshine to develop the floriculture industry, creating jobs for local farmers.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: nationwide in 2026 is estimated to be around 12.7 million, which will mean a surge of 480,000 from 2025.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: In light of the situation, the ministry has arranged localities and higher education institutions to launch a specific campaign on improving the quality and expanding the scale of employment for college graduates in 2026.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: To advance the high-quality and full employment of the graduates, the campaign focuses on efforts such as supporting

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: entrepreneurship to drive employment, deepening the integration of industries and education to further align supply and demand and ensuring support for needy groups through targeted assistance, the ministry said.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Since the start of the autumn semester this year, more than 12 million job opportunities have been gathered and offered to graduates via a series of campus recruitment activities carried out by universities across the country, according to the ministry.

layout_dets.text: Students show greeting cards made to celebrate the World Hello Day, which falls on November 21 each year, at a primary school in Qingdao, Shandong Province, on November 20.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Green Electricity Certificates

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: China issued 370 million green electricity certificates in October, bringing its total issuance in the first 10 months of 2025 to 2.478 billion, official data showed on November 25.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Of the certificates issued in October, 158 million were classified as tradable, accounting for 42.61 percent of the month's total, according to the National Energy Administration (NEA).

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Green electricity is electricity generated from renewable energy sources such as wind, solar or biomass power.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Trading activity remained robust in October, with 66.7 million certificates changing hands nationwide. The cumulative trading volume for the January-October period was 596 million.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: China introduced the green electricity certificate system as a pilot program in 2017. In December 2023, the NEA issued an initial batch of certificates.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The country has built the

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: world's largest clean power system and carbon trading market, and its green industries continue to grow, according to the administration.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Civil Aviation

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The civil aviation industry recorded a year-on-year increase of over 20 percent in both international passenger and cargo traffic in October.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The country's monthly air cargo and mail throughput surpassed 900,000 tons for the first time in history, data from the Civil Aviation Administration of China revealed on November 25.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: In October, the total transport turnover of the industry reached 14.6 billion ton·km (the weight of the goods transported in tons multiplied by the distance traveled in km), up 10.8 percent year on year.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The volume of passenger transport hit 67.84 million, increasing 5.8 percent from the same period last year, and the volume of cargo and mail transport grew 13.4 percent to about 917,000 tons.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: In the first 10 months, the industry's total transport turnover increased 10.3 percent year on year

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: to 136.63 billion ton-km. Some 650 million passenger trips were made during the period, up 5.3 percent year on year, while cargo and mail transport volume rose 13.9 percent to 8.31 million tons.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Emerging Industries

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: China will start building national emerging industry development demonstration bases, with the goal of establishing about 100 industrial park demonstration bases and 1,000 enterprise-type demonstration bases by 2035, according to a circular released by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Per the circular, the construction of demonstration bases will align with national development strategies for 2035 and the 15th Five-Year Plan (2026-30) period, with a focus on key emerging sectors such as next-generation information technology, new energy, new materials, biology, high-end equipment, intelligent connected new-energy vehicles, low-altitude equipment and aerospace, and the green and environmental protection

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: industries.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Industrial park demonstration bases will aim to promote the clustered, large-scale and high-end development of leading industries, strengthen the supply of key generic technologies, enhance the transformation and industrial application of sci-tech achievements, and explore management approaches suited to emerging industries.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Demonstration enterprises will focus on strengthening product development, tackling key and core technologies and achieving breakthroughs in major original innovations. They will also work to foster new business forms and models, and promote innovation in application scenarios, according to the ministry.

layout_dets.text: Carbon Market Expansion

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The national carbon market will cover all major industrial emitters by 2027 amid China's efforts to leverage market mechanisms for green and low-carbon transition, according

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: In October, the 20th Communist Party of China Central Committee adopted the recommendations for formulating the country's 15th Five-Year Plan, laying out priorities including to expand the China Carbon Emission Trade Exchange to cover more sectors. The MEE has already launched preparatory work to include the chemical, petrochemical, civil aviation and paper manufacturing sectors.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: For the steel, cement and aluminum smelting industries, which were added to the market in March, the MEE recently issued quota allocation plans for 2024 and 2025.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Key emitters in these newly added sectors must complete their quota compliance for 2024 by the end of this year. Quotas for 2025 will be pre-allocated in the first half of next year, with compliance due by the end of 2026.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Xia Yingxian, an official with the ministry, said the expansion would enforce emission reduction

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: responsibilities and drive investment in low-carbon technologies.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The MEE plans to expand coverage gradually, adding new industries only when they meet strict data and emissions standards.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Installed Power Capacity

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: China's total installed power-generating capacity reached 3.75 billion kilowatts (kw) by the end of October, rising 17.3 percent year on year, official data showed on November 24.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Solar power capacity continued to drive the expansion, jumping 43.8 percent year on year to 1.14 billion kw. Wind power capacity also posted strong growth, increasing 21.4 percent to 590 million kw, according to the NEA.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: By the end of September, China's installed renewable energy capacity had reached nearly 2.2 billion kw, accounting for approximately 59.1 percent of the country's total installed power capacity, earlier NEA data showed.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The country has built the world's largest renewable energy system. In the first four years of the 14th Five-Year Plan (2021-25) period, China's energy consumption per unit of GDP dropped by a cumulative 11.6 percent. China has vowed to accelerate green transition across the board and build a Beautiful China in the coming five years.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: China's electricity consumption, a key barometer of economic activity, rose 10.4 percent year on year in October to 857.2 billion kw-hours, according to NEA data released on November 21.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Power consumed by the overall industrial sector rose 6.4 percent year on year, while the tertiary sector saw a 17.1 percent increase. Residents' electricity consumption totaled 115.5 billion kw-hours, up 23.9 percent year on year.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: From January to October, China's total power use climbed 5.1 percent to about 8.62 trillion kw-hours.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Rural Banks

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Small and medium-sized banks

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: in rural areas have seen steady expansion in scale, with their overall growth becoming more stable and sound, according to a report recently released by the China Banking Association.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: As of the end of 2024, their total assets and liabilities had reached 57.91 trillion yuan (\$8.2 trillion) and 53.69 trillion yuan (\$7.6 trillion), up 6.06 percent and 6.02 percent year on year, respectively, the report shows.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Outstanding loans at these banking institutions accounted for more than 55 percent of their total assets by the end of last year, with their credit business continuing to focus on the real economy, according to the report.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The report indicates that rural small and medium-sized banks are embracing multiple strategic opportunities, such as rural revitalization, coordinated regional development and upgrading consumer spending. They are also confronting practical challenges, including intensifying market competition and lagging digital transformation.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: DESIGNER BEHIND POPULAR MASCOTS

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Liu Pingyun, a professor at the Guangzhou Academy of Fine Arts, was the creative force behind the hugely popular mascots for the 15th National Games, held in November in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area (GBA).

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The mascots, named Xi Yangyang and Le Rongrong, are based on the Chinese white dolphin, an ecological icon of the GBA. The design team, led by Liu, introduced innovative pink and white color schemes.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: "We observed that the skin of a Chinese white dolphin turns pink when it's physically active due to increased blood flow, so we incorporated this into our design," Liu explained.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Liu's team also designed the Games' emblem, featuring interlocked petals representing the three host regions. He was the lead executive designer of Bing Dwen Dwen, one of the two Beijing 2022 Winter Olympics mascots.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: From Playgrounds to Python

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Gmw.cn November 24

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Given the spread of AI in recent years, a parallel industry of after-school coding classes has sprung up to meet surging demand for tech-related skills. Yet parts of this new market have developed in curious—and troubling—ways. Some classes now pitch coding not as a tool for creativity or problem-solving, but as a supposed fast track to elite universities, boasting that certificates and medals in coding competitions offer decisive

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: advantages in college applications. In doing so, they recast programming as a vehicle for peer pressure.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Children who are too young are pushed into coding drills they cannot digest and those in early primary grades are handed languages far beyond their grasp. The result is predictable: frustration, resistance and a quick extinguishing of curiosity.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The sector itself remains uneven, with copied curricula, inconsistent teaching quality and little oversight. Bringing order to the market will require clearer national standards on course design, teacher qualifications and marketing practices. For parents, a calmer perspective may help: Coding is a useful skill, but hardly a golden pass to success.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Sports Mean Business

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Oriental Outlook November 13

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: China's tourism scene is undergoing a subtle yet profound transformation. Travelers are moving beyond passive spectating to seeking experiences that combine sports, culture and natural sightseeing. Once a niche segment, sports tourism is now entering the mainstream. According to a 2023-24 report by the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences, the global sports tourism market has been growing at roughly 15 percent annually, while China's domestic sector is expanding at 30-40 percent per year.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: "This is the first time China has contextualized the two battlefields within a single exhibition space, underscoring the united anti-fascist spirit of people across the world."

layout_dets.label: 段落

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The modern society that we are living in did not emerge out of nowhere. Instead, it grew from the deep soil of our traditional culture.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Jin Minqing, head of the Institute of Contemporary China Studies at the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences, during the Global South Modernization Forum in Beijing on November 21

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The trend has prompted many traditional scenic areas to rethink their operations. Wugong Mountain in Jiangxi Province, for instance, has reinvented itself as a hub for outdoor sports, offering hiking trails, highland football fields, rafting courses and a range of camping facilities. In many regions, sports tourism is also driving rural revitalization. In Shiwo, a village in Sichuan Province that houses a popular ice and snow scenic area, more than 150 of its 500 residents have become certified mountain guides. During the climbing season, guides can earn up to 8,000 yuan (\(1,100) per month, boosting the village's average annual income by roughly 30 percent.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The boom is even feeding into manufacturing. One classic example is Zhangjiakou, co-host of the 2022 Winter Olympics, which has developed into a hub for both skiing destinations and snow sports equipment manufacturing, producing everything from cable car systems to carbon fiber skis.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Yet this rapid expansion is exposing a serious talent gap. With only a handful of university programs dedicated to sports tourism, the industry struggles with a dire shortage of trained managers, venue operators and other specialized professionals. As the sector matures, closing this skills gap will be critical—not only to keep pace with rising demand but also to ensure that China's sports tourism boom remains sustainable.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Work Without Barriers

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Ce.cn November 26

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: In Chengdu, many passengers have recently noticed a rising number of ride-hailing drivers with hearing impairments. This is part of a wider shift, where more and more people with disabilities are increasingly integrated into the country's workforce. According to the China Disabled Persons' Federation, by the end of 2024, 9.14 million work-eligible people with disabilities were employed nationwide, an increase of 512,000 from the previous year. The figures highlight not only the ability of people with disabilities to

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: realize their potential through work, but also society's expanding support for inclusive employment.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: In recent years, local governments across China have introduced dedicated programs to help disabled residents find work, offering full-chain support ranging from skills training to professional certification. A national three-year action plan for 2025-27, issued earlier this year, requires governments at all levels to prioritize employment for people with disabilities.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The engagement of companies is also crucial. Employers are encouraged to recognize employees with disabilities as equal participants in the workforce, ensure their rights and design roles suited to their abilities.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: YOUNGEST CAS MEMBER

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: With the announcement of the 2025 election results on November 21, Liu Ruochuan, 44, became the first Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS) member born in the 1980s.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: CAS membership is China's highest academic accolade in science and technology. Liu, a professor at Peking University, earned the distinction for his groundbreaking work in arithmetic geometry and algebraic number theory. His research in number theory, a core branch of fundamental mathematics, provides crucial theoretical sup

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: port for cryptography and AI.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: A gold medalist at the 40th International Mathematical Olympiad in 1999, Liu obtained his bachelor's and master's degrees from Peking University and his Ph.D. from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology in 2008. He returned to teach at Peking University in 2012 after postdoctoral research in France.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: J ust when football was in danger of becoming too predictable, along came 2025 to buck the trend and prove beyond doubt that the unexpected can always still happen.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: After years of dominance in the Premier League, there were zero trophies won by Manchester City this year. Instead we saw Crystal Palace secure their first ever major trophy and Newcastle bring an end to their 70-year wait for domestic silverware. Spurs won their first European trophy in four decades as they beat Manchester United to lift the Europa League, while Paris Saint-Germain claimed their first Champions League.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: On the international front, England retained both the Women's Euros and the Under-21 Euros, but neither team did it the easy way. The new version of the Club World Cup, meanwhile, was clinched by Chelsea - how big that tournament becomes will be determined by a few more editions.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: In this issue, we look back on an unpredictable 2025 - Lee Carsley, Dan Burn, Joao Pedro and plenty more speak to us about their successes over the past 12 months, not all of them expected when the year first began.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: There's also our 2026 calendar - we travel back to USA 94, as the World Cup returns to North America next year - and for the very first time we've created special FourFourTwo wrapping paper, so you won't be short when you're putting presents under the tree this Christmas. Enjoy the mag.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Hello gamers, and welcome to FUSION. We put this issue together earlier than usual to allow time for my trip to New York, but I saved this editorial for when I returned. I did so in the hope that I might have some juicy retro game purchases to share, but alas, I don't. I couldn't

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: find a boxed copy of Resident Evil 2 or Conker's Bad Fur Day for the N64. I only found the time to visit two video game stores during my four days in the Big Apple, so it's not a reflection on the stores themselves (J & L Game on 6th Avenue and Videogamesnewyork on 6th Street) but rather a reflection on the rarity of those two N64 titles outside of pricey listings on eBay in the US and the UK. A lonely cartridge of Conker's Bad Fur Day was available at J & L Game, but nothing less than a boxed copy in good condition with the instructions will satisfy me.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: We have a packed issue for you this month. Graeme Mason chats to Dying Light franchise director Tymon Smektala about creating the latest entry in the series, The Beast, and gives his verdict on the finished code. Andrew Oyston tackles another finely crafted point-and-click adventure, and Paul Twist learns the Art of Vengeance in the first new Shinobi title for 13 years. Complementing our coverage of the latest releases are retrospectives on the classic PC shmup, Tyrian, the first entry in Capcom's Devil May Cry series and a look at the games that make up the Cube Escape Collection. You'll also find our customary selection of columns and tributes to the titles we adore. Right — time to shake off the last of the jet lag and get back to some serious gaming.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: CASEBOOK 1899 THE LEIPZIG-MURDERS

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text:
DEVELOPER: HOMO NARRANS STUDIO  
PUBLISHER: HOMO NARRANS STUDIO  
SYSTEM: MACOS, STEAMOS, WINDOWS (REVIEWED)  
PRICE: £14.99  
RELEASE: 2022, 2025 (STEAM)  
WORDS: ANDREW OYSTON

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Amateur sleuths may be popular in some circles, but we all know that it's the professional detectives who solve murder cases. In Casebook 1899: The Leipzig Murders, you fill the shoes of Inspector Joseph Kreiser, who's investigating a series of horrendous homicides on the streets of the titular German city during the final months of the 19th Century.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: M

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: uch like The Supper: New Blood (reviewed last issue), Casebook 1899 presents its events in the past tense, each one bookended

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: by scenes in which Kreiser recounts the day's details to his landlady, Ms Faber. She does not let her blindness keep her from observing the goings-on in Leipzig, and Kreiser's accounts of his duties provide the framework on which the narrative hangs. Immediately, Casebook 1899 scores highly as it presents these vignettes from Ms Faber's perspective. The room, the objects within and all who enter are depicted only when sound

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: reveals them. It's highly stylistic and just the first evidence of the care and attention lavished by the developer Homo Narrans Studio.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Once into the investigations proper, players experience an artistically varied Leipzig as it might have been — not quite Baedeker-level detail, but a recreation that more than delivers on atmosphere. Visuals are backed by a soundtrack that evokes the period exceedingly well, and many of the tracks are reminiscent of the similar-styled music used in period television recreations. Fans of Sherlock Holmes and Jack the Ripper, as seen on ITV in the '80s, will know what I mean.

layout_dets.label: 图注
layout_dets.text: Kreiser's beat has him travelling throughout the city.

layout_dets.label: 页脚
layout_dets.text: FUSION

layout_dets.label: 图注
layout_dets.text: Casebook 1899's opening immediately delivers on the eye candy.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Every good detective needs a sidekick, so Prosecutor Möbius tags along as you investigate crime scenes, interview witnesses, and interrogate suspects. He provides the odd hint or two when required and highlights various on-screen hotspots. The latter is a nice touch, and a much-needed one at times, but the repeated conversation to get to that point made me wish for a simple hotkey by the time

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: the credits rolled. However, it's nice that he is more than just a golem-like Watson figure taking up space in the background.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: For each crime you make copious annotations in your notebook, a must for any detective worth their salt, and in doing so, ascertain clues that point you in the direction of a possible solution. You then need to combine those clues within your notebook to unlock

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: possible events and motives on your deduction board — a portable whiteboard, so to speak. Here, theories can be manipulated and linked to motives, thereby unmasking the killer, or killers. With multiple solutions for each case, it feels more like a personality test for the player as you switch and swap between the available 'facts' before deciding when the case can be closed.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Aside from the detective work, there are the more typical logic puzzles that never stretch mental acuity, and there is an annoyingly high reliance on pixel

layout_dets.label: 页脚
layout_dets.text: FUSION

layout_dets.label: 图注
layout_dets.text: Above: More picturesque pixels as Kreiser and Möbius engage in some rooftop sleuthing.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: hunting when looking for objects. This is where the hot key I mentioned would be useful, as the same repetitious chat when asking Möbius for his visual capabilities does become rather tiresome. Alternatively, you can just sweep the locales with your cursor until you pass

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: over a hotspot. Minigame-style puzzles are also thrown into the mix, but these can be skipped, which is much appreciated considering one in particular was a head-scratcher.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: They are, however, varied enough and don't pop up too often.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: There is full voice acting for those who wish to develop their German-language skills, although this is absent for Kreiser's internal monologues. While it's

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: authentic to the setting and period, it could bring back nightmares for those who studied GCSE German. Combined with the artistic direction and tightly written script, this imbues the game with an ambience that is impossible to criticise. Indeed, I found myself picking up the odd phrase here and there that has stayed with me since. I'm not suggesting you use this game as a learning tool, but hey, maybe I'd have achieved a better French grade with a point-and-click adventure game than with a decade-old graffiti copy of Tricolore. Text is available in German, naturally, as well as English and Italian.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The quartet of cases presented here takes around five to six hours to work through. Some players, however, will tally up a longer play time if they avoid the use of the skip button for those mini-puzzles. Pacing for the most

layout_dets.label: 页脚
layout_dets.text: FUSION

layout_dets.label: 图注
layout_dets.text: The infuriating puzzle, thankfully with a Skip option.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: part is steady, and once you've established enough links to collar someone for the crime, you run your decision past Ms Faber. Her commentary on your deductions and choice of culprit often plants seeds of doubt in your mind, but by that point, it's too late. Or is it?

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: To its credit, Casebook 1899 almost nails the landing, but even after much thought, I'm still not convinced the denouement sits properly within the overarching story. I like to think even Ms Faber would be querying just how and why we get to the end. After asking the player to use logic to that point, there's a tonal shift away from that course that confounded me, though it in no way ruins the experience. Casebook 1899 is one of those adventure games that does

layout_dets.label: 图注
layout_dets.text: Investigations are not limited to the 'well-to-do' areas.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: almost everything right. It looks and sounds great, the atmosphere is pitch-perfect, and there's enough of a challenge to engage both casual and hardcore point-and-click fans alike. Yet all that good work and effort is somewhat undone by a conclusion that offers a binary choice for the player but fails to explain how they got there clearly.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: For a game whose core mechanic is based on deductive reasoning, that's enough to make it a good adventure experience, rather than a great one.

In GooD
FaiTh

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Another month, another rise in costs for gamers. Xbox has announced a rather hefty rise in its Game Pass subscription service that has torn gamers around the world. As a gamer who subscribes to Game Pass on my PC, I've seen my cost rise from £10 to £13.50. That is

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: more than a \(33 \%\)increase, and I’m seriously considering just dropping it altogether. This isn’t an easy decision, though. I play Xbox on my PC a lot, and when it was £10 (£2.50 a week), I didn’t bat an eyelid at the cost, and it felt like extreme value to me.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: So, how does a measly three quid suddenly change my viewpoint? It's less than a cup of coffee in London. I feel it comes down to perceived value, and our own personal experience and limits. Just to put it into perspective, a few years ago, Netflix increased its streaming price to over £10, and so many of my friends who never even thought about the cost suddenly started questioning it. I saw a great quote on an online forum that stated all these subscription services have a cost ceiling, which once crossed, makes customers question.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: I do love Game Pass. I really do. For the last few years, I've switched between Sea of Thieves, Diablo IV, and a myriad of other high-quality video games. I complete an indie game every couple of months, enjoy unlimited online play and many classic titles, as well as hidden gems I may not have played. Games such as Sea of Stars cost £30 when released, but I finished it in about three weeks and have no intention of ever going back to it. I was happy to 'rent' it and enjoy the whole thing. I have embraced digital, and honestly don't care about 'owning' titles that I have just wanted to blitz through once.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: But now the cost of this convenience has risen substantially, and I'm questioning its value. Heck, console players have it even worse with the cost of the highest tier now being £23. That does seem an awful lot of money to pay each month to rent some games and play online. To be fair to Xbox, it has stated that over 400 games are available at any one time, with more being added than before. This, at

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: We gardeners know that just because it is cold and still outside, it does not diminish the beauty of our gardens – in fact it can enhance them. This issue, we dive deeper into a collection of winter wonderlands, revealing the

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: importance of underlying structure and revelling in pared-back simplicity.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Piet Oudolf has transformed a former poultry farm in Berkshire into a stunning new garden, which at this time of year relies on the frosted silhouettes of seedheads and elegant silvery grasses (page 30). Having visited the garden of John Little in Essex earlier this year to see its summer glory, we return to his experimental plot in winter (page 66). In Norfolk, Adrian Bloom enjoys the magic of a morning walk in his gardens at Bressingham (page 84). And at Broadwoodside in Scotland, one couple have developed an intriguing series of garden rooms over many years (page 92).

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Winter is also the perfect time to enjoy crisp topiary. At Brodsworth Hall in South Yorkshire, the multitude of shapes in the formal gardens hold the interest through the colder months (page 52); and we visit HM The King's garden at Highgrove to discover how the team there create and clip the incredible array of forms, with top tips to help you have a go yourself (page 74).

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Structural plants are the bedrock of a good winter garden, and this issue we are celebrating *Mahonia*, an unfussy evergreen that blooms over winter and can manage shade and poor soil (page 42). Dan Pearson also shares his favourite December plants from his garden at Hillside (page 14).

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: And who could forget that it's almost Christmas? Nigel Slater reflects

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: on the pleasure of a well-chosen gift (page 39) and we have our top picks of presents for gardeners (page 21), plus floral artist Fiona Pickles shows how to create beautiful natural seasonal decorations for your home (page 60).

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: THE ART ISSUE

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: ART IS OFTEN considered a form of conversation—an exchange of ideas, experiences, impulses, and actions that forges connections and allows us to arrive at a deeper kind of truth. Technology is changing that conversation. It is faster, easier, and more accessible for almost anyone to make a picture, write a novel, compose a song, take a photograph, or shoot a film today. Images appear at the speed of a prompt; music arrives algorithmically tailored to our predilections and moods; our memories are stored and sorted by our phones. As with so many aspects of life in the 21st century, friction—the messy, tough parts—has been reduced, with the aim of eliminating it altogether. But what hasn't is the very human desire to see our thoughts and feelings reflected in the world. Art, at its most potent and powerful, is about more than aesthetics. It's about where we find genuine empathy and real beauty. It's about how we find each other. It's about the way we find out who we are and what inspires us. Some of the oldest, most foundational forms of art—the painting, the live performance, the objects we make—offer evidence of someone or something that existed in time and space. They are reaffirmations of our presence. This issue looks at art through that lens and what it means to feel, to be seen, to be heard. The way we talk about art—and what we view as art—will continue to evolve as we experiment with all these new tools we have at our disposal. But what's most essential is that we find ways to continue that conversation, wherever it may lead, because ultimately it's one about us. HB
