layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: We made it! 250 issues of hi-fi+. And the stars aligned to make this celebratory issue our annua Awards... just in time for Christmas, too. It doesn't get much better. OK, so perhaps the free Rolls-Royce with a glove-box filled with Patek Philippe watches for every reader we were hoping to give away this issue might have been a little better, but only a little!

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Keen calculating types might point out that 250 monthly issues would put the first issue of hi-fi+ back in February 2005, and yet the magazine was launched back in 1999. So what happened?

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: For the first ten years of the magazine, hi-fi+ was a true periodical. The magazine was a quarterly at first, then moved to a bi-monthly, and only became a monthly magazine in January 2013.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: From the outset, the magazine set a high standard. We maintain that audio is a luxury product and, if you are reading about it, then it's best to do so in something that looks and feels luxurious. Alongside the high design values, by-product of high-quality paper gave us the reputation of being 'the best smelling magazine in the audio business.' Sadly, some of the olfactory boons of the past have stayed in the past, as print stocks change over time, but we have tried as much as possible to keep the luxury touches.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: However, things do change. Some of the things that we did in those early issues never quite took off. For example, while it stands to reason that people who buy high-performance audio share common interests, that doesn't mean they want to read about those other interests in their audio magazines. So, things like wine reviews were tried... and failed. In team meetings, we periodically think it's a good idea to try this again, but it tends to become 'a good idea' a few hours after the team meeting has moved from 'office' to 'bar'.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: We stay close to good audio's core, but that core is undergoing some tectonic shifts (mixing geographic metaphors is probably why I failed geography... that and writing something rude about drumlins!). Combining the retrospective and crystal-ball gazing elements of an anniversary and Awards issue throws such shifts into sharp focus. We cannot be sure what will fill the pages of hi-fi+ a few years from now, but it probably won't be the same mix we see today. As today's magazine's content is subtly different from that of a few years ago.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: That's a good thing. Audio is perhaps the most mature part of consumer electronics, and with maturity comes the risk of stagnation. And there can be no stagnation when the type and nature of products are in a state of flux. It's surprising how far we've come in 250 issues, but there's still a lot of room for change. "May you live in interesting times" need not be a curse, after all!

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text:
BUILD ROCK
HARD ABS

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Discover how this programme works, plus how the various elements of each session can be changed and tweaked for greater gains

layout_dets.label: 页眉
layout_dets.text: INTRODUCTION WORKOUT STRUCTURE

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: SESSION BREAKDOWN

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: In just four weeks' time, you'll be the proud owner of rock-hard abs, as well as wider shoulders, bigger arms and a broader chest. Here's how you'll do it

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The four-week training programme in this guide is divided into two fortnightly blocks, or cycles. You'll perform three sessions every week, each one concentrating on different muscle groups in addition to your abs. Here's what each one entails.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: WORKOUT1

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: ABS AND LEGS

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The first session of each week focuses not only on your abs, but also on your legs. A six-pack may be what you're after, but you can't afford to ignore your other major muscle groups entirely. This is especially true of your legs because they're the biggest muscles you have and the best way to get solid abs and burn body fat is to work them hard. Doing so will result in more testosterone being released, which in turn will encourage new muscle growth. The simple truth is that ignoring other muscle groups in favour of working just your abs will limit how much they can grow.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: WORKOUT 2

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: ABS, CHEST AND BACK

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The second session each week will hit your chest and back muscles hard so you can build a strong, lean and powerful torso that will perfectly showcase your six-pack.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: New abs moves are also included in this session, to work these muscles from different angles and in different ways, to force them to growing bigger.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: WORKOUT 3

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: ABS, ARMS AND SHOULDERS

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The third weekly session trains your shoulders to create a wide V-shape torso, which not only looks great but also makes your waist look smaller. This session also includes biceps and triceps moves to build bigger arms, and there are more direct abs moves to keep your six-pack mission on track.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Ignoring your other muscle groups in favour of working just your abs will limit how much they can grow

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: HOW TO DO THE WORKOUTS

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: In each two-week cycle, you will do each workout twice.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: However, while the exercises remain the same in both weeks, the workout in week two won't be exactly the same as in week one, because you'll tweak certain elements to make sure your muscles are constantly stimulated and working outside their comfort zone.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: In the second week, the number of sets increases in each workout, while the number of reps in each set decreases. This means the second week is harder because there's an increase in the total number of reps you're performing.

layout_dets.label: 页脚
layout_dets.text: Build Rock-Hard Abs

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: SUPerset STRUCTURE

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Each workout in this guide is made up of eight moves split into four supersets

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: A superset is two moves performed back to back, with a set amount of rest - from nothing to 90 seconds - between the last rep of the first move and the first rep of the second move. After that set is completed, you rest again before returning to the first move and repeating this process.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Only when all the sets of the first two moves have been completed do you move on to the second superset and repeat the process again until all the sets of all the moves are done. At this point your workout is over.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Supersets are described using a number and a letter. 1A is the first move of the first superset, 1B is the second move of the first superset and so on.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: TEMPO EXPLAINED

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Another key component in each workout is the tempo, or speed, at which each rep must be performed. It is described using a four-digit code. The first number is the speed in seconds of the lowering part of the lift, such as lowering the bar to your chest in a bench press. The second is the pause at the bottom, the third is the speed at which you lift the weight back to the start position and the fourth is the time you hold at the start position before starting the next rep.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: If the tempo for a bench press is 3010, for example, you lower the weight in three seconds, don't pause at the bottom, lift the bar in one second and don't pause at the top. X means you do that part as quickly as possible while maintaining form.

layout_dets.label: 页脚
layout_dets.text: Build Rock-Hard Abs

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: P

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: erhaps rather appropriately, as this issue goes on sale just ahead of Halloween, our free

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: pull-out plan this month is Spooky! But fear not, as contributor John Goodyear has tried to keep his super-sleek Club RG65 Racer design (relatively) easy and inexpensive to build by following the instructions laid out in his illustrated guide to the model's construction (starting on page 42).

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: I think I've mentioned in a past column that I like to put together a themed play list of tunes I can have on in the background while I work. Naturally, this month it was cue Dusty Springfield's Spooky, followed by a whole host of fantastic tracks inspired by Nick Brown's AAR (After Action Report) on the build of the Dean's Marine 1:24 scale Vietnamera LSSC laser-cut kit (starting on page 10).

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: But while Nick's crew figures conjure up the heat of the Mekong Delta, winter is now on its way (at least for those of us in the Northern Hemisphere). So, if you're looking for a project you can tackle indoors (rather than needing to spend hours in a perhaps less than warm and cosy garage, shed or workshop), then you need to check out this month's exclusive prize draw (see pages 26-27). Thanks to the generosity of Fentens Productions, we're delighted to be able to offer you the chance to win one of five of HMV (Hamburger Modellbaubogen Verlag) kits and laser cut set packages for the 1:250 scale Flower Class corvette HMCS Agassiz (as featured in the first instalment of Stuart Deacon's new series The Learning Curve, starting on page 18).

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: You couldn't really get three more different vessels/models/builds, but of course that's not where the variety stops, as you will discover in the pages ahead.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Enjoy your read,

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Redcar MBC Boating Lake: fixed, filled and fabulous!

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Redcar Model Boat Club is delighted to announce that repairs to its boating lake at Newcomen Terrace in Coatham, Redcar (originally constructed in the 1930s), have, thanks to Redcar & Cleveland District Council, now been completed, with the

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: lake having been successfully refilled this September.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Rob Heseltine,

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Secretary of Redcar MBC, tells us: "It's very rare these days that there is a 'good news' story, but this is ours...

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: "For the past several years the club has suffered from a leaking lake and for the majority of that time we've had no water at all. A handful of members have been able to keep the club going by switching to R/C cars when there's been no water, using the bottom of the lake as a racetrack, but, sadly, this saw our membership dwindle to around just six members. The club was formed in 1995, and we once had a thriving membership of around 60 members.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: "I am pleased to say that the local council and highways authority have spent a lot of time, effort and money on the lake and it has finally been fixed. The lake, which is more than 100 years old, is also a pillar to the local community and has been saved from being turned into a carpark.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: "This year the club celebrates its 30th anniversary.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: "We have our own Facebook page and

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: membership costs are £10 a year, this covering insurance and admin costs. We sail four times a week – Tuesdays, Thursdays, Saturdays and Sundays from around 1pm till about 3pm, and attend various events throughout the year.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: "I'm very happy to report we've recently seen membership rise again, swelling our ranks to nearly 30 members, all thanks to our local partners and the community who have saved the lake from closure".

layout_dets.label: 图注
layout_dets.text: Congratulations to Redcar Model Boat Club, whose members can finally enjoy sailing again on the newly repaired and filled Coatham Lake!

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Nick Brown provides an AAR (After Action Report) on his build of the Dean's Marine 1:24 scale Vietnam-era LSSC kit

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: W

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: hat do classic rock songs and river patrol boats have in common? For me, they're

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: both essential ingredients in capturing the spirit of the Vietnam War era. The title of this article is intended to reference the group Creedence Clearwater Revival and its Vietnam protest songs 'Fortunate Son' and 'Up Around the Bend' for those who are familiar with the band and the tracks. Combined with the Dean's Marine latest Vietnam era model, I hope you will enjoy the play on words.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: The LSSC

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The Grafton Boat Works of Illinois, a small boat manufacturer, constructed the Light SEALs Support Craft (LSSC), producing 22 vessels, with 20 deployed to Vietnam in 1969. The LSSC, measuring 7.3 meters in length, was powered by two water jets made by Jacuzzi and could reach speeds of up to \(50\mathrm{mph}\). Radar equipment was installed for night operations; however, the radome was susceptible to damage from Rocket Projected Grenades (RPG), which could result in splinters affecting the crew when struck. Armament choices were determined by the SEAL team members, leading to variations, but most included .50 calibre and \(7.62\mathrm{mm}\) machine guns,

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: as well as grenade launchers. Although 'STAB' (Strike Assault Boat) is a general term for this class of vessel, it does not specifically refer to the LSSC, though the designation is commonly used.

layout_dets.label: 标题

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: As the festive season approaches, and twinkling lights start to appear, there's a special kind of magic in the air - and there's plenty of joy to be found both indoors and out! Even though our gardens may be quieter than they were a few months ago, they're still brimming with delights - and just a quick potter outside can be wonderfully uplifting, whatever the weather.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: With Christmas just around the corner, our outside spaces can provide plenty of materials to use as decorations – or, if you timed them right, some veggies for the dinner plate! To help spark some festive cheer, we've put together our '12 days of instant garden joy': simple, satisfying projects and planting ideas to brighten your winter days.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: And what would Christmas be without a little gifting magic? Our hand-picked gift guide is packed with brilliant finds for every garden lover (and treating yourself is absolutely encouraged!). Plus, we've rounded up our favourite houseplants that

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: will bring a splash of greenery indoors – perfect for perking up your home or delighting someone special.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: If you're dreaming of a greener Christmas, why not swap plastic for a real, living tree and embrace the fragrance and feel of perfect pines? We've picked our favourite varieties and share top tips on looking after them - and, crucially, how to keep them going when the festivities are just a distant memory. Hard to imagine such a time, we know!

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: We're also excited to share some incredible real-life garden transformations that show just how creative and resourceful our gardening community can be. You'll find clever, achievable ideas to inspire your own patch, and, as always, all your much-loved features and money-saving offers to help you fill your home and garden with cheer (and maybe a few more plants - you know you want to!).

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: So, get the Christmas songs on, settle down with a cuppa, and dive into another joyful edition - we can't wait to celebrate the season with you!

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text:
ENTERTAINMENT
 ACCIDENTAL TOURIST
 ITV1·Sunday

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 'When viewers first hear about Accidental Tourist and how it features me alongside Ant and Dec, they may think it's going to be a funny show where we're going to be pranking each other and doing wind-ups,' says Stephen Mulhern. 'But it's anything but that.'

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: We thought we knew Stephen, but this new series forces us to think again. The presenter, who has spent 25 years joking, pranking and hosting game shows, suddenly finds himself doing none of the above. Instead, he's more than 5000 miles from home, navigating South Korea with a suitcase full of Wagon Wheels, a wary attitude towards unfamiliar food, and the constant long-distance interference of two men who know him best - Ant McPartlin and Declan Donnelly.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The result is part travelogue and part self-discovery, wrapped in warmth, humour and genuine vulnerability. 'Whilst there are funny moments, there are also shocking moments where your jaw will drop – and then there are emotive moments,' says Stephen.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 'I'd say you see me like you've never seen me before. You see me getting upset at times and you see me very scared. Every emotion comes out, whether it's fear, surprise, happiness or sadness. I can't wait for the audience to see it. It's really personal, and my hope is that viewers will be able to relate.'

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: If Stephen is the emotional heart of the show, Ant and Dec are the drivers, architects and cheerleaders of his journey - as well as suppressing cackles in the background when he has to confront something terrifying in a new country.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Stephen likes what he knows and never deviates from that, Ant says. 'He very rarely ever goes away on holiday. He'll go to Spain or Portugal and that's about it. He's never drunk coffee,

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Stephen Mulhern opens up on how Ant and Dec sent him on an emotional journey to East Asia

layout_dets.label: 页脚
layout_dets.text: TVguide

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: ORTUNITIES

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: or eaten a curry - and until recently had never eaten ham!

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Dec looks incredulous. 'How do you get to 48 years old and not try ham?'

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 'I'm from a family of market traders,' explains Stephen. 'My mum and dad are very plain eaters. Fish and chips, steak and chips, roast dinners... typically very English food. I think when you start your life and that's all you've really known, it's very hard to change your palate.'

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Ant picks up the story of how the show came about. 'So Stephen came to us and said that he thought it was time to change. When he asked us to help him broaden his horizons and see the world, we jumped at the chance.'

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 'The motivation for us was largely selfish,' Dec confesses. 'Because before, if we wanted to go for dinner with Stephen - which we love doing - we'd have to go somewhere quite bland.'

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 'Even a Nando's would be progress!' Ant says.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: We're all hitting birthday milestones, adds Dec, noting that he and Ant turned 50 this

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: year, while Stephen remains a spring chicken at 48. 'So what better time for Stephen to push himself out of his comfort zone and not only try new things but experience other countries and cultures?'

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Another reason we wanted to embark on this together was because they are such good friends - Ant and Dec are the best people to help me push the boundaries a bit more, adds Stephen. They really researched places and things for me to experience, and it really helped. If it was up to

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: me, I would have probably stayed in the hotel.'

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text:
Korean cuisine,  
famously bold  
and unapologetic,  
was never going  
to be a gentle  
introduction  
for Stephen's  
traditional taste  
buds. 'When I had  
to try different  
stuff there, it was  
a shock to the  
system,' he says.  
'It's quite intense,  
but having tried

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: different foods, it opened my eyes more than ever before in my life.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: But the show isn't just about what's on the plate. It's about Stephen doing things he would never normally go near - activities, traditions and cultural moments that push him mentally and emotionally. 'Each task challenged me in various ways,' he says. 'It really was collaborative, and I couldn't have done it without Ant and Dec.'

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Before he even got on the plane, Stephen felt out of his depth and packed a few reassuring items. 'I had to take a few comfort foods, so I took some Wagon Wheels and some custard creams - and some Monster Munch crisps, because I'm not very worldly.'

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: How do you get to 48 years old and not try ham?

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: During the experience, something shifted in him. 'This trip has really opened my eyes and I want to experience more,' he says. 'The whole process has really helped me more than I ever imagined. I had edamame beans the other day, and I loved them! Now I'm like, "Why have I not tried these before?"

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Stephen's transformation isn't the only story here.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: His admiration for Korea runs deep. 'Korea was sensational,' he says. 'It's beautiful, the people are beautiful, their culture is beautiful, and their attitude is amazing.'

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: More than the scenery, it was Korean honesty that struck him. "They have taught me how to be more honest, more direct and to just say things as they are. Normally, I would be, 'Everything's fantastic, everything's great," when sometimes it wasn't. But now I can honestly admit that I've had a tough day or that I'm feeling a bit tired.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: And this shift stayed with him after returning home. 'I've started to open up more with friends,' he says. 'I ask questions about how they are feeling.'

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: For all their joking, Ant and Dec's mission to help their friend is heartfelt. Ant says, 'We hope that we can help Stephen have an amazing adventure and to show him that sometimes trying things that might seem scary at first can be an amazing and life-changing experience.'

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Dec adds a final nudge. 'And if nothing else, that ham sandwiches are very tasty!'

layout_dets.text: Jason Arnopp

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Trap in the heat and keep out the cold during winter with a warm and welcome insulated jacket. Here's what to look for.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: TYPE OF INSULATION

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Insulated jackets are filled with either natural down (from geese

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: or ducks), synthetic insulation, or a mix of both, each with pros and cons. Down is lightweight, highly compressible, and very warm for its weight, but it loses insulating power when wet. Water-repellent (hydrophobic) treatments improve its moisture resistance but don't eliminate the problem. Synthetic insulation, by contrast, stays warm when wet and is usually cheaper. It does, however, tend to be heavier and bulkier overall, although new developments in fibre technologies increasingly mimic the feel of down. Synthetics also avoid animal products (though standards like RDS improve down traceability and welfare) and can be made from recycled materials.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: FILL POWER

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Relating specifically to down insulation, fill power (FP) is a

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: measure of down's ability to trap heat. The higher the fill power the 'fluffier' the down is and the more warmth it'll trap. 650FP is fairly standard for good quality down jackets, but 800FP and even higher can be found in high performance premium down jackets.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: BODY MAPPING

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Different areas of our body generate heat in varying quantities. The best

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: performing insulating layers are often 'body mapped', with the amount of insulation weighted depending on which part of the body it covers. For example, under the arms will often have much less insulation than across the torso, allowing you to vent excess heat while keeping warmth where it's needed. Body mapping like this can

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: also ensure an insulated jacket remain unrestrictive during energetic activities.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: SHELL FABRIC

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Most insulated jackets are not fully waterproof. Instead the insulation is

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: usually wrapped in a nylon or polyester shell - more often than not treated with a durable water-repellent (DWR) finish to fend off dampness. Lighter shell fabrics save weight and size, but heavier fabrics offer better durability and tear resistance.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: FEATURES

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: There's more to look for in an insulated jacket than you might

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: imagine. A well insulated hood protects your head against heat loss, while fleece-lined, insulated pockets will keep hands toasty. Stretch 'dump pockets' inside the jacket are useful for stashing bulky gloves, and a cinch cord around the waist, cinchable cuffs, and a main zip backed with an insulated baffle keep out chilling draughts.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 简介

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 概述

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 上海思泰基的SB-810是PII级别的工控主板，它与一般的PC机完全兼容，其使用方法也与一般的PC机一样。SB-810具有一般主板的功能外，还具有思泰基特有的增强功能。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 特征

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 主板SB-810的主要配置

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - 在板低工耗的PII级别的CPU

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: \(\bullet\) 支持64M或128M SDRAM内存

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: \(\bullet\) 支持10M/100M自适应RJ-45接口两个

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: \(\bullet\) 支持声卡AC97标准接口一个

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: \(\bullet\) 标准1.1USB接口两个

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - LCD液晶显示接口一个

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - CRT接口一个

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: \(\bullet\) 标准LPT口一个

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: \(\bullet\) 支持与标准的16C550兼容的五个串行口。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: ? 在板32M DISKONCHIP（贴片方式）

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - Watch-Dog

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: CPU

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 采用美国国家半导体SCX200，集成一个GeodeGX132位X86兼容微处理器，和一个支持CRT/TFT/STN的图形处理器芯片（2D图形加速），以及支持SUPERI/O模块。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: CRT接口

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 主板上的CRT接口可直接支持标准的CRT显示器，分辨率可达 \(1024\times 768\) ，同时还带有TV接口（可选）

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: LCD接口

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: SB-810主板的LCD接口可直接支持多种LCD液晶显示屏，可支持TFT、STN显示方式下包括\(1024\times 768\)、\(800\times 600\)、\(640\times 480\)、\(320\times 240\)等各种模式的液晶显示屏。其中如果是STN方式必须加转接板，才能实现。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 串口

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: SB-810主板支持与标准的16C550兼容的五个串行口。一组为LPC支持的标准COM1（RS232），COM2(RS232)；另一组为由SuperI/O芯片中引出的COM3（RS485/RS422/TTL）接口，COM4（RS232/TTL）接口，COM5（TTL/IRDA）。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 并口

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: SB-810主板上有1个并行口，为标准的双向打印口，并支持EPP/ECP功能。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: IDE接口

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: SB-810主板上带有一个标准的IDE硬盘接口，同时可接两个硬盘。支持ATA33的传输模式，也可支持光驱。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: DOC接口

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 在板32MDOC。

layout_dets.text: SB-810主板上可支持一个标准软驱接口。

layout_dets.text: USB接口

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: SB-810主板上可支持三个标准USB1.1接口。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 网络接口

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: SB-810主板上可支持两个10M/100M的自适应网络接口，支持全/半双工模式，支持即插即用安装，并提供支持多种操作系统的网络驱动程序。

layout_dets.text: 声卡接口

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: SB-810主板上可支持一个在板AC97/AMC97标准的声卡。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 物理特征

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: SB-810主板是具有低噪音全功率和接地层的6层PCB板，大小尺寸为： \(135\mathrm{mm} \times 96\mathrm{mm}\)；操作环境为：空气流通情况良好，相对湿度 \(5 - - 95\%\) ，无冷凝环境，操作温度 \(-20 - +700^{\circ}C\) 存放温度为： \(-40 - +850^{\circ}C\)

layout_dets.text: 该器件包含防止高静态电压或电场造成损坏的电路，但建议采取预防措施，以避免实际应用中高于额定电压的输入造成这部分电路的损坏。未用输入引脚连接到适当的逻辑电压电平（例如，VSS或VDD）或使能相关引脚的内部上拉电阻，可增强操作的可靠性。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 注意：

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 为防电击，请勿打开机盖(或后盖)。本机内部无使用者可以维修的部件。请委托有资格的技术人员进行维修。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 等边三角形中有箭头闪电标号的图形表示警告使用者在产品内有非绝缘的“危险电压”，可能会对人体造成很大的电击危险。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 等边三角形中有感叹号的图形表示警告使用者该设备在操作与维护(维修)方面应严格按照所附设备说明书。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 警告：

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 为防止火灾或电击，请勿将本机暴露于雨中或潮湿的处所。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 注意：为了完全切断本机的电源，请从墙上插座中拔出插头。电源插头用于完全中断机器的电源供应，必须置于使用者容易接近的地方。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text:
·  执行标准
   Q/YL 001-2009

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 使用注意事项

layout_dets.label: 表格
layout_dets.html:
警告
·避免高温。
·装置机架时应允许充分散热。
·小心操作电源线。
·从插座上拔出电源线时应抓住插头将其拔出。
·勿将本机放置于湿度很高或多尘的位置。
·长时间不使用本机时须拔下电源插头。
·勿阻塞机壳的通风孔。
·勿使异物掉入机内。
·勿使杀虫剂、苯和稀释剂与机箱接触。
·切勿拆解或以任何方式改装本机。
·不得用报纸、桌布或窗帘等物品覆盖通风口,以免妨碍通风。
·不得将点燃的蜡烛等明火源放置在本机上。
·请留意和遵守当地有关电池处置的法规条例。
·请勿使液体滴落或喷洒到本机上。
·请勿将花瓶等装有液体的物体放置在本机上。
·请勿用湿手操作主电源线。
·当开关位于“关闭”位置时,设备并未与主电源彻底切断。
·应将本设备安装在电源附近,以便于接入电源。
·不要让本器材暴露于雨水,湿气,滴水或溅水之中。

layout_dets.text: □安装注意事项

layout_dets.label: 段落

* 为确保适当的散热，请勿将本机安装在狭小的空间内，例如书柜或类似的封闭空间中。
. 建议超过0.3m。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: ·请勿将任何其它设备放置在本机上。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: ·关于冷凝

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text:
如果本机内部和环境之间存在较大温差，则本机内部的运转部件上可能会产生冷凝(结露)，导致本机无法正常运转。  
如果发生这种情况，请断开电源并将本机搁置1到2个小时，然后等到几乎没有温差时再使用本机。

layout_dets.label: 段落

layout_dets.label: 段落

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: ·请用软布擦拭和清洁机身及控制面板。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: ·使用化学清洁剂时，请遵守使用说明。

layout_dets.label: 段落

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 使用说明书

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 一、概述：

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: R-1000型变压器绕线机是绕制R型铁芯变压器线圈的专用设备。对提高R型变压器的生产效率和产品质量提供了可靠的保证。它具有计数准确、运行平稳、安全耐用等特点，还配置了脚踏控制功能，操作方便。适用于中小型变压器生产厂家使用。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: R-1000型变压器绕线机主要由以下部分组成：（1）控制器；（2）计数探头；（3）机身；（4）电动机；（5）主轴磨擦轮；（6）压紧装置；（7）脚踏开关。结构如下图：

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 二、主要技术指标和性能参数：

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1、绕制变压器铁芯范围：R10~R1000。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 2、绕制变压器线圈线径范围： \(\Phi 0.1\sim \Phi 1.8\)

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 3、设置匝数最大值：8999（一般状态下）；999（绕制大变压器状态时）。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 4、计数探头离骨架（色斑）的距离： $2\sim 10\mathrm{mm}$

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 5、主轴转速小于1200转/分，无极变速。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 6、直流并（他）激电动机，额定输出功率：200W。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 7、工作电压：AC 220V； \(50\mathrm{Hz}\)

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 8、工作环境：温度-5℃-40℃；相对湿度≤90%

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 9、外形尺寸： \(450\mathrm{mm}\times 340\mathrm{mm}\times 340\mathrm{mm}\) （长 \(\times\) 宽 \(\times\) 高）。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 10、重量（净重）： \(38\mathrm{Kg}\)

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 三、主要功能特点：

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1、电脑（单片机）控制，全按键操作的面板结构，工作状态数码显示。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 2、具有预置数、手控或脚踏启动、升速、降速和停电记忆功能。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 3、智能化的“异常示警”功能，可在出现“探头信号异常”、“误记、多记”和“超值”时示警并停车。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 4、满匝自动停车采用程序控制提前减速，可消除转动惯性影响，计数准确可靠。5、“电杀车”能在紧急停车时起作用。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 6、在“大变压器状态”时，控制器不作“异常判断”，不会异常停机，可随意绕制。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 7、“倒回”功能可以实现电动退线。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 8、脚踏控制具有正、反转启动和停机功能。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 9、计数探头可离线圈骨架端面较远处准确可靠检测圈数，从根本上解决了探头碰撞滚轮及骨架窜动带来计数不可靠的问题。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 四、调整绕线机及绕制变压器的操作步骤：

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1、磨擦轮、铁芯垫板和压紧装置上压轮的位置并加以固定；调按绕制变压器的规格调整主轴上整压紧装置时，先将压紧装置中心线对准变压器骨架中心，然后再分别调整固定左、右压轮的位置。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 2、在变压器线圈骨架侧面贴上深色斑，把变压器正确放入绕线机绕制位置，并将有色斑的一面与计数探头在同一方向。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 3、接通电源，将控制器电源开关置于“开”的状态。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 4、调整计数探头，探头轴线垂直骨架端面，与骨架的距离 \(2 - 10\mathrm{mm}\) ，并使光束对准色斑，调整完毕后固定计数探头。探头、色斑处应避免外来强光！

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 5、按照控制器说明设置绕制圈数和运转速度，并做好其它绕线准备工作。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 6、将压紧装置的手柄压下，使变压器固定，按“计数清零”键，再按“启动/停止”键，进入绕线状态。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 7、绕制过程中，可随时通过控制器面板按键提速、降速或终止运转。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 8、绕制中如需停机退线，可直接按“倒回”键。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 9、到达预置圈数，绕线机自动减速、停止运转，绕制工作完成。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 10、绕制时也可使用脚踏开关进行正、反转启动和停机的操作。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 注意：面板操作与脚踏操作不能同时进行！

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 五、脚踏操作形式：

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本系统提供了两种形式脚踏操作，使用操作面板上的小船形开关可进行选择：

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1、上按开关，处于正转状态：踏下开关踏板，机器运转，放开脚踏，迅速停机。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 2、下按开关，处于倒转状态：踏下开关踏板，机器低速倒转，放开脚踏则停机。注意：放开脚踏后，必须等待2-3秒钟（听到控制器内发出“哒”一声）才能再次踏下踏板。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 六、使用说明和异常处理：

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 1、控制器显示说明：

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: （1）、预置圈数以X.X.X.X形式数码显示(X代表0-9之间的自然数)，数字表明设定圈数。当“绕制大变压器”，状态时，字头A。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 注意：在“A”状态下，控制器不作“异常判断”，不会异常停机。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: （2）、所计圈数以无点自然数形式显示，无字头。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: (3)、速度以为 \(15\sim 100\) 范围内的自然数形式显示，字头为U。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: （4）、异常情况：E1——无探头信号或反转。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: E2——出现误计数、多计数。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: E3——计数值超过设定值。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: (5)、停机时，“设置值”与“计数值”交替显示或“异常号”与“计数值”交替显示。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 2、控制器面板按键说明：

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: （1）、“圈数设置”键——用来预置圈数，停机时此键才起作用。首次按动此键，控制器进入“圈数设置”状态，显示器闪烁被设置位，继续按此键可设置闪烁位的数，中止按键后闪烁位会右移一位。停止按键数秒钟后，控制器自动退出此状态。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: (2)、“计数清零”键——用来清除显示器的计数值,此键在停机时才起作用。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: (3)、“提速”、“降速”键——用来提高或降低电动机运转速度，设置值可在 \(15\sim 100\) 范围内设定。按键时，显示器立即显示速度设置值并增加或减少；停止按键，速度设置值也停止改变，延时数秒钟后退出此状态。此两键在停机或运转时都起作用。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: （4）、“启动/停止”键——用来启动或终止电动机运转。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: （5）、“倒回”键——用来倒转退线，按住此键电机低速倒转，松开此键后倒

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 转停止。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: (6)、当出现“异常示警”（显示E1、E2、E3时），按动任一按键可消除“异常示警”。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 2、异常及处理方法：

layout_dets.label: 表格
layout_dets.html:
异常提示可能原因处理方法
探头信号无或线接反。可能探头离骨架距离不合适。没对准色斑、端面有脏污、有断线、色斑太小,或色深度不够、两信号线接反等。调整探头位置;擦净探头端面;将探头线脱离仪器,用万用表检查是否有断线现象;对调两信号线。色斑较小时,可适当缩短骨架与探头的距离,以解决计数不可靠问题。
出现计数误计、多计现象,可能骨架的拼缝太大,骨架端面有污斑等。适当增大探头与骨架的间距;清除骨架端面污斑。
计数已超过设定值。重新按“计数清零”键即可

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 七、安装与维护：

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1、开箱后将装箱清单、使用说明书、脚踏开关、磨擦轮和六角板手取出，把脚踏开关插头正确插入控制器后的插座内。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 2、本产品无需特殊安装，水平放置于坚固的工作台上即可。但为了减轻振动，可在绕线机底面垫上一块橡胶垫。需要时也可将绕线机用螺栓固定在工作台上（底板上留有安装孔）。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 3、使用软毛刷清除计数探头灰尘，以确保计数可靠。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 4、附件中提供了一套磨擦胶轮，当该绕线机原装磨擦胶轮因过度磨损影响使用时，用户

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 可自行更换。更换时，先拆掉手轮、轴承压盖，再拆去左墙板，然后借助轴承拉码等工具进行更换。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 5、产品若长期不用，应作清洁处理，涂油防锈，盖上防尘罩。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 6、产品重新使用前，应做全面检查。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 八、注意事项：

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1、产品搬运安装过程应小心轻放，机器移动或长时间不用应将电源插头拔离电

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 源插座。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 2、机器就位后，机体应可靠接地！

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 3、机器每次使用前应开机预热三分钟。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 4、接通电源后，若表现为无电，可能控制器内部的保险（管）已熔断，切断电源后打开控制器外壳更换保险管（保险管的容量为5A）。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 5、绕线机运转时，禁止搬动机器或触摸转动部件。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 6、绕制大变压器时，注意避免电动机负载过重造成堵转现象，以免烧坏电动机或控制器。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 7、控制器按键只能用手指按动，不能用其它硬物代替。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 8、给计数探头除尘时应仔细小心，以免损坏探头。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 9、脚踏开关禁止带电插拔或用力拖拽。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 10、产品日常维护，应由专职设备维修人员或具备电器知识的技术人员进行。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 11、控制系统出现故障，按本说明书处理仍不能排除，应与本公司联系。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: R-1000 R型变压器绕线机的操作和维护人员必须认真阅读本说明书，以便掌握正确的使用和维护方法。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 感谢您购买英创信息技术有限公司的产品：EM9161工控主板主板。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: EM9161是一款面向工业自动化领域的高性价比嵌入式主板，其内核CPU为工业级品质的AT91SAM9261S，模块已预装正版WindowCE5.0实时多任务操作系统，用户可直接使用Microsoft提供的著名免费软件开发工具eVC（+SP4）或微软的其他开发工具，在EM9161上直接开发应用程序。英创公司针对EM9161提供了完整的接口低层驱动以及丰富的应用程序范例，用户可在此基础上方便、快速地开发出各种工控产品。EM9161G是EM9161的增强型产品，其运行速度更快，各管脚功能与EM9161完全相同。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: EM9161主要特点：

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - 标准的 Windows 图形界面：EM9161 带有工业标准的 TFT 彩色 LCD 及触摸屏接口，为客户提供高性能的人机界面。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - 丰富的标准接口资源：作为一款高性能的嵌入式主板产品，EM9161 带有多种标准接口，以满足不同应用需求。这些接口包括：（1）以太网接口，支持标准 WinSock 以及基于 WinSock 的各类 API；（2）4 个标准异步串口；（3）2 路 USB HOST 接口；（4）USB Device 接口，支持 ActiveSync 方式对内部文件操作以及程序调试；（5）MicroSD 卡接口，直接支持 SD 卡；（6）I2C 总线；（7）32 位 GPIO；（8）CAN 总线接口（可选）；（9）精简 ISA 扩展总线。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: \(\bullet\) 强大的应用开发工具：EM9161预装了微软的WindowsCE操作系统，WindowsCE是当前市场上最流行的实时多任务操作系统之一，微软针对CE的应用开发推出一系列完善的开发工具，eVC就是其中的代表，eVC是基于VisualC/C++发展的嵌入式版本，且可免费获取。英创公司为EM9161的所有接口编写符合CE标准的驱动程序，因此用户可直接调用标准WindowsAPI来操作各个通讯接口。此外用户可利用微软工具链中所提供的远程维护工具或ActiveSync来对EM9161运行的程序进行调试，以及后续的产品维护。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - 产品的兼容特性：EM9161在板卡的尺寸及管脚信号定义方面与英创公司的主流产品ETR232i/H（x86平台）和EM9160（ARM9平台）具有高度的兼容性。如果

layout_dets.label: 页脚
layout_dets.text: www.emtronix.com

layout_dets.label: 页眉
layout_dets.text: 英创信息技术有限公司

layout_dets.label: 页眉
layout_dets.text: EM9161工控主板数据手册V3.0

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 不考虑 EM9161 新功能的使用，用户可用 EM9161 直接替代 ETR232i / H 或 EM9160，只是重构应用程序，就可快速实现产品的升级换代。EM9161 的低成本特性为客户产品的升级换代在预算上同样提供了保证。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - 紧凑的外型尺寸：EM9161 的外型尺寸仅为 \(74\mathrm{mm} \times 53\mathrm{mm}\)，是业界尺寸最小的 ARM9 工控主板模块之一，模块采用坚固的 IDC 插针，可非常方便的插入用户的产品主板上，快速搭建各种工控产品。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - 极高性价比：作为一款工业级品质的嵌入式网路模块，EM9161的售价相比其他同类的ARM9产品具有强劲的竞争力。特别适合运用于运行环境恶劣，无人值守、连续24小时工作、对成本敏感的各种应用领域。是一款具有极高性价比的工业产品。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本手册详细介绍了EM9161的硬件配置、管脚定义及相关的技术指标，供用户使用时备查。此外，英创公司针对评估底板的使用编写有《EM9161嵌入式模块开发评估底板手册》。这两个手册都包含在英创为用户提供的产品开发光盘里面，用户也可以登录英创公司的网站下载相关资料的最新版本。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 用户还可以访问英创公司网站或直接与英创公司联系以获得EM9161的其他相关资料。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 3、模块信号管脚功能描述

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: EM9161的使用是以模块形式，通过板上的相关插针，插在应用主板上，同时实现EM9161板卡的固定以及与应用主板的信号连接两个功能。EM9161共有3组信号插针，分别编号为CN1、CN2和CN3，其中的CN1和CN2分别位于EM9161板卡模块的两端，为2组标准0.1英寸间距IDC36针双列直插管脚，EM9161正是通过CN1和CN2与应用底板连接在一起的；EM9161的CN3为40芯ZIF插座，主要引出彩色LCD及触摸屏的相关信号，实际应用中通过40芯的扁平软带线与LCD相连。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: EM9161的CN1主要包括以太网接口、异步串口、USB、GPIO等信号；而CN2主要包括数字IO（精简ISA扩展总线与部分DIO复用管脚）、电源输入。CN1和CN2的管脚编号均为奇偶排交错顺序编号，且1#管脚标志为方形焊盘。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: EM9161 不仅外形尺寸与英创公司 X86 系列的主流产品 ETR232i/H 完全一致，而且 CN1 和 CN2 中相应的管脚插针信号也能实现与 ETR232i/H 完全兼容，因此在电路上可直接替代 ETR232i/H，快速实现产品升级。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: EM9161所有管脚的信号电平，除非特殊说明，均为LVTTL（3.3V）电平，输入 \(+5\mathrm{V}\) 兼容。对低电平有效的信号，信号名称后均带“#”表示。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 关于CN1中相关信号的进一步说明：

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - 为了提高管脚的利用率，以太网口的状态指示只提供单路低电平有效输出，需要外部提供5V偏置，才能点亮相应的LED。根据客户需要，出厂可配置为双路连接指示（LINK-, LINK+）。为了提高整机的电磁兼容性能，通常情况下网络变压器应布局在客户应用底板上，且尽可能靠近网络的RJ45插座，所以EM9161的缺省配置是不带网络变压器的。对一些普通要求的应用，客户在购买时也可选择EM9161模块带网络变压器。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - EM9161 的异步串口编号从 COM2 开始，4 个串口分别为 COM2 - COM5。其中 COM5 与 GPIO0-GPIO1 复用管脚，上电复位后这些管脚处于数字输入状态，当应用程序打开文件“COM5:”后，管脚将自动切换到 TXD 和 RXD 的状态。

GPIO7SDA, I2C 双向地址数据串行信号

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 在缺省状态下，GPIO0-GPIO7的管脚均为数字输入，当应用程序打开相应的I2C文件（“I2C1:”）时，对应管脚将自动转为各自通讯口的功能，而不需要专门的切换操作。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - 鉴于英创产品中的异步串口在工业现场中被广泛作为RS485使用，EM9161为COM4和COM5两个串口，设置了相应的RTSn控制信号，用于控制RS485的数据收发方向。这两个RTSn信号分别与GPIO8和GPIO9复用管脚，其中GPIO8 \(\leftarrow\) →RTS4n、GPIO9 \(\leftarrow\) →RTS5n。应用程序在打开串口时，只要简单地设置：dcb.fRtsControl = RTS_CONTROL_TOGGLE

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 就会自动启动RTS方向控制功能。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 关于CN2中相关信号的进一步说明：

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - DBGSL#信号用于选择系统启动的工作状态，DBGSL#设置为低并启动系统时，EM9161将进入调试状态；DBGSL#设置为高或悬空并启动系统时，EM9161将进入运行状态，若此时文件userinfo.txt包含有效信息，客户的应用的应用程序将被启动。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - EM9161的固定数字输入DINO-DIN7已带有51K上拉电阻，对悬空的管脚，API函数读入为高。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - EM9161 的固定数字输出 DOUT0 - DOUT7，在系统上电复位时，DOUT0 - DOUT3 输出高电平，而 DOUT4 - DOUT7 输出低电平。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - 在CN2的通用GPIO10-GPIO15，在上电复位时，GPIO10-GPIO14均为输入状态，而GPIO15为输出状态，输出电平为低。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - 精简 ISA 总线的 RSTOUT#与 GPIO15 复用管脚 CN2.28#, 在应用程序初始化阶段, 应首先调用 API 函数 void ResetISA( UINT nMillisecond) 完成对 ISA 总线的复位, 使 RSTOUT#变为高电平, 然后才能对 ISA 总线进行正常的读写操作。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - GPIO10 与精简 ISA 总线的硬件中断输入 IRQ1 复用管脚，IRQ1 为上升沿有效。当应用程序打开驱动程序文件“IRQ1:”时，其管脚将自动切换到 IRQ1 状态，否则均作为 GPIO10 使用。

layout_dets.label: 段落

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 本产品可与我们制造或指定的备选产品配合使用。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 由于显示器电子零件的性能需要约30分钟才能稳定，因此在电源开启之后，应调整显示器30分钟以上。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 为了降低因长期使用而出现的发光度变化以及保持稳定的发光度，建议您以较低亮度使用显示器。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 当显示器长期显示一个图像的情况下再次改变显示画面会出现残影。使用屏幕保护程序或省电模式避免长时间显示同样的图像。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 建议定期清洁，以保持显示器外观清洁同时延长使用寿命（请参阅“清洁”（第4页））。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 液晶面板采用高精技术制造。但是，LCD面板上可能会出现像素缺失或像素发亮，这不是故障。有效点百分比：99.9994% 或更高。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 液晶显示屏的背光灯有一定的使用寿命。当显示屏变暗或开始闪烁时，请与您的经销商联系。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 切勿用力按压显示屏或外框边缘，否则可能会导致显示故障，如干扰图案等问题。如果持续受压，显示屏可能会性能下降或损坏。（若显示屏上残留压痕，使显示器处于黑屏或白屏状态。此症状可能消失。）

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 切勿用尖锐物体刮擦或按压显示屏，否则可能会使显示屏受损。切勿尝试用纸巾擦拭显示屏，否则可能会留下擦痕。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 如果将冷的显示器带入室内，或者室内温度快速升高，则显示器内部和外部可能会产生结露。在此情况下，请勿开启显示器并等至结露消失，否则可能会损坏显示器。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 感谢你选择EIZO彩色液晶显示器。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: ·23英寸大屏幕液晶

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - 适用于 \(1920 \times 1080\) 分辨率。

layout_dets.text: ·宽视野面板

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 水平视角和垂直视角均为 \(178^{\circ}\) 的VA面板。

layout_dets.text: HDMI连接器 \(\times 2\)

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - 适用于采用HDMI输入的PC输入信号，允许来自PC的三个不同的数字信号输入。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - 色彩模式功能使用户能够针对显示的图像选择最佳显示模式。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - Paper模式再现外观类似于打印纸的美观显示效果。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 参阅“选择显示模式（色彩模式）”（第14页）。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: ·对比增强器功能

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 根据图像自动调整对比度，支持显示高对比度和清晰的动画图像。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 参阅“设置对比增强器“对比增强器”（第18页）。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - Power Resolution功能

layout_dets.label: 段落

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 参阅“消除图像模糊“PowerResolution””（第19页）。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - 两种专用的伽玛模式（“Power1”/“Power2”），适用于采集的游戏图像图像可通过增加半色调(Power1)和低色调(Power2)对比度进行锐化。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 参阅“调节伽玛曲线“伽玛””（第19页）。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - 可选择各种屏幕尺寸，如点对点（显示图像，而不缩放输入信号）、信箱模式、过度扫描（更改输入图像的显示区域）

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 参阅“2-5.屏幕尺寸更改”（第25页）。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - 包括“ScreenManager Pro for LCD (DDC/CI)”软件，便于你用鼠标和键盘调节屏幕。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 参阅“1-3.EIZO LCD Utility Disk”（第9页）。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - 通过遥控器可以实现轻松操作、设定和调节显示器。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 参阅“1-2.控制和功能”（第7页）。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - 在包括的显示器底部粘贴色卡（三色）选择所需的颜色以便为显示器增加强调效果。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 参阅“设定指南”。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - HDCP（高带宽数字内容接口）

layout_dets.label: 段落

layout_dets.label: 标题

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: USP-CDG是一套单门门禁管理系统，用于控制、接收和管理单门门禁控制器。一套系统最多可控制64台单门控制器。系统可通过通用的TCP/IP或485网络进行通讯，主要实现接收控制器上传事件、下载配置数据、批量加卡、远程控制开门、多卡开门等功能。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: USP-CDG门禁软件界面友好，操作简单。您可以应根据门的实际应用要求，使用不同功能的结合，满足客户对各种个性化的通道管理需求。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 2.1 数据库安装

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 安装LSP-CDG应用软件前，用户应自行决定哪一个数据库系统将用于接入控制系统。软件光盘包括MSDE服务管理器，用户还可以选择为数据库管理购买SQL server 2000。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 双击启动MSDE文件夹中的“Set up”，系统开始安装数据库。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 3.3 网络连接

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 登录系统后，软件进入USP-CDG“网络连接”的设置页面。控制器可通过UDP或COM两种方式进行连接到应软件（TCP暂未使用）。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1 门禁服务器网络接口：当用 UDP 方式连接控制器时，请选择门禁服务器的网络地址，即操作应用软件的服务器的 IP 地址。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1 UDP上行端口：软件上传信息的端口号，此端口号不能和PC上其他软件的端口号重复。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1 门禁服务器本地直连串口：当用串口直连控制器时，请选择连接该控制器的串口号。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1波特率：选择通讯波特率，选择的波特率要和控制器的波特率相同。默认设置波特率为9600。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1 自动运行并启动服务器：当勾选这个选项以后，每次重启电脑CDG软件会自动运行并启动服务器。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1 工作模式：选择是服务器还是客户端操作。在服务器模式下可使用默认的事务接收端口、服务器IP、事务发送端口、数据接收端口和数据发送端口设置（分别为：9010、127.0.0.1、9011、9012、9013），客户端模式时请把事务接收端口和事务发送端口号以及数据接收端口和数据发送端口号调换过来（调换后分别为9011、9010、9013、9012）。使用客户端软件时也要设置数据库，数据库名和服务器端设置的数据库名相同。（当用基本版软件时，工作模式为不可更改的服务器模式，插上客户端USBKey后用户可选择是服务器还是客户端模式。当客户用的是完整版或专业版客户端USBKey后，服务器端软件版本为基本版时客户端软件也只能设置基本版软件所能设置门的个数，也就是只能设置6个门）

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1 选择发卡器：发卡器为USB接口，查上发卡器后在这里选择发卡器的端口号，用来发行用户卡。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1 选择卡格式：有Wegand26、32、34、64四种标准卡格式，还提供4种自定义卡格式，用户可选择正确的卡格式发行用户卡。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1 同步设备时钟：以PC时间为准，在指定的时间段给所有的在线控制器同步时间，且在软件启动后，同步所有联机的控制器时间。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1 API端口：应用软件提供的第二次开发端口

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1 事件存期：勾选这个复选框用来保存设定时间内的事件记录，自动删除多余的事件。可选择下拉框保存事件的时间，以月为单位最多24个月，最少1个月（可选择），软件每天检测判断1次，如选择保存的时间是6个月，如果检测到已有7个月的事件记录，则自动删除最初1个月的事件，保存最新6个月的事件。如果不勾选该项功能则数据库保存所有事件记录，不会自动删除事件。

layout_dets.text: 选择好通道类型和工作模式或加卡读卡器类型后点击“启动”来连接控制器或发卡器。

layout_dets.text: 3.4 新建门

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 新建门即添加控制器到软件，并对控制器进行名称、编址等进行编辑。点击功能目录里的“门” $\rightarrow$ “新建”，弹出新建门对话框，填写名称、说明、编址等内容后按“确定”完成门的建立。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1 串口：门（控制器）的端口号，当有转换器模拟多个串口将系统中的控制器接入服务器软件时，客户可对每一个控制器选择一个不同的虚拟串口进行连接。当系统只以一个串口连接时，可对每个门（控制器）选择相同的端口号。（当在网络连接界面选择COM口后这里也可以不用选择；当网络连接栏的串口和门配置栏的串口相同时，波特率取网络连接栏的波特率）

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1 波特率：选择软件通讯波特率，选择的波特率应与控制器波特率相同。默认设置波特率为 9600。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1 名称：门的名称，默认为“Door 1”

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1 说明：对门进行说明，默认为“门1“

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1 编址：门地址，控制器的拨码地址。一套系统最多支持64台控制器，地址从$1\sim 64$。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1 开门延迟：为开门选择延时期限(默认:4000ms)，成功刷卡后门不执行打开动作直到锁头再次锁上的一段时间。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1 门常开超时：为开门状态选择超时期限(默认:8000ms)，刷卡成功门被打开后在设置的

layout_dets.label: 页眉
layout_dets.text: USP-CDG门禁管理软件使用说明书

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 时间还没关上就会报警。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1   门关延时：为门关好选择延时期限（默认：20s），每次认证成功，推开门，关门后开始“关门延时”计时，计时结束后，如有未认证成功就推门情况发生，将产生“强行闯入”报警。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1 电锁控制器类型：选择关门状态的类型

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: a) 开门延时结束时--在设置的延时时间结束时锁门

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: b) 门回应时--在关门状态回应时锁门

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1 自动门常开时段分组：必须勾选“启用”才能启用以下的两个的功能。从时间分组的下拉框中选择一个时间分组来控制以下的两个功能。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: a）首卡门常开：系统内合法卡中其中一张卡在设置的时间段里第一个打开门后，门一直处于打开状态直到设置的时间段结束。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: b）自动开关门：在设置的时间内不用刷卡，继电器自动跳转门打开直到设置的时间段结束，如果门到位会立即关上，此时要刷卡才能开门。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 注：同时只能启用“首卡门常开”、“自动开门”中的一项功能

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1 考勤点：以该门的打卡数据来做考勤数据分析（系统默认启用考勤点）

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1 多卡开门：多卡控制开门：设置多卡开门功能，在下拉框中选择多卡开门的卡数量，能通行该门的所有持卡人中任意多张卡（最多8张）刷卡后门才能打开，每张卡之间的最长间隔时间为10秒。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1 例：对门1需要2张卡控制开门，软件设置时需要勾选“多卡开门控制”并选择下拉框中“2”，表示能通行该门的所有持卡人中任意两张卡刷卡后门才能打开。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1 远程开门：设置此门为远程控制开门，合法卡认证成功后也需要控制中心管理员的认可（在“事件视图”的“远程开门请求”里确定）才能开门。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 胁迫码开门：遇到“胁迫开门”时，只有该“门”启用了“胁迫报警开门”选项才执行开门动作。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: （注：编址必须填写且每个门地址编号不能重复）

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 人工呼吸器 決策指南

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Ventilator Decision Aid

layout_dets.label: 页眉
layout_dets.text: COALITION FOR COMPASSIONATE CARE OF CALIFORNIA

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 什麽是人工呼吸器？

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: What is a ventilator?

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 人工呼吸器是幫助無法自行用肺部呼吸的病人呼吸的一個機器。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 當病人連上人工呼吸器時會發生什麼情況？如何操作？

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: What happens when someone is attached to a ventilator? How is it done?

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - 將一根管子從口腔或鼻子插入氣管（氣管插管）。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 機器（人工呼吸器）會經由管子，將空氣打入肺部。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - 為了減輕病人的疼痛與不適，一般會藉由靜脈注射給予藥物使病人嗜睡。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 什麼時候須要人工呼吸器？

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: When do people need a ventilator?

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 對於那些無法自己正常呼吸的人來說，可能是有需要的。呼吸問題可能是短期（暫時性）或長期的（永久性）。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 除非病人已經選擇不使用人工呼吸器，為不能自主呼吸的病人使用人工呼吸器是醫療常規。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 短期使用人工呼吸器的原因可能包括：

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Reasons for short-term ventilator use may include:

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 手術時使用麻醉藥（讓您睡著）。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 突發，嚴重的疾病或嚴重受傷。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - 嚴重的肺部疾病，如慢性肺阻塞（COPD），肺气肿，哮喘或肺炎。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 因心臟問題或腫脹造成肺部積液。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 長期使用人工呼吸器的原因包括：

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Reasons for long-term ventilator use may include:

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 極度虛弱，用來呼吸的肌肉無法良好運作。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 在昏迷狀態，控制呼吸的大腦和神經無法正常運作。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - 肌肉或神經的疾病，脊椎受傷或嚴重的肺部損傷。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 可能導致一些病人永遠失去自主呼吸的能力。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 誰應該使用這份指南？

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Who should use this guide?

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 這份決策指南適用於患有嚴重疾病的人。它可用來幫助做醫療決定及用人工呼吸器做治療的討論。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 備註：本文件沒有討論非侵入性的呼吸支援選項。那表示是用其他方法而不是使用人工呼吸器來幫助您呼吸。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 人工呼吸器可能有何帮助？How might using a ventilator help?

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 醫療團隊在治療突發的疾病時，可以使用人工呼吸器試著讓病人存活。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - 人工呼吸器可以用來幫助呼吸並且為身體器官提供氧氣。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - 人工呼吸器可以在手術或其他嚴重醫療處置時幫助呼吸。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - 人工呼吸器可以讓一些病人在意外傷害或脊椎受傷後得到改善，並延長生命。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 人工呼吸器可能造成哪些傷害？How might a ventilator cause harm?

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 使用人工呼吸器的人，可能得到难以治疗的肺部感染。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 人工呼吸器可能對肺部產生傷害並造成用來呼吸的肌肉變得無力。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 在醫院使用人工呼吸器的人通常不能說話或吞嚥。這可能會是長期的副作用。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 在使用人工呼吸器時，有些人可能會變得困惑或害怕。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 人工呼吸器能使病情好转嗎？Does a ventilator help people to get better?

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 這取決於他們醫療問題的類型以及他們為什麼須要人工呼吸器。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 人工呼吸器對哪些病人最有益？Who is most likely to be helped from being on a ventilator?

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 在疾病或受傷之前大致都是健康並且可能有體力復原的人

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 那些只需要短期（幾天或一兩週）呼吸器的人。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 覺得使用人工呼吸器，他們的生活品質還是能被接受的。例如，脊椎嚴重受傷的年輕病人或殘疾病人。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 人工呼吸器對哪些病人較無益？Who is less likely to be helped by using a ventilator?

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - 患有嚴重心，肺，肝或腎衰竭的病人。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - 末期病人，例如癌症末期或晚期失智症的病人。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 老年人，虚弱或非常脆弱的人。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 使用人工呼吸器，會是什麼樣的情況？ What is it like being on a ventilator?

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 使用人工呼吸器的人大多數是不清醒也不能說話，飲水或進食。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 使用人工呼吸器的人通常會給予藥物讓他們放鬆。當他們清醒時，有些人可能會感到不舒服或焦慮。醫療團隊對這些症狀，都會非常謹慎的處理。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 一旦用了人工呼吸器，他們可以停止不用嗎？

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Once someone is on a ventilator, can they come off?

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 是的，當人們可以自己呼吸或任何時間他們決定停止使用人工呼吸器，例如當他們的治療計劃改變時。有些人可能不確定而想要在短期內（試用期）嘗試人工呼吸器，看它是否有幫助。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 如果有人需要長時間使用人工呼吸器，會有什麼情況出現呢？

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: What happens if someone needs a ventilator for a long time?

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 大約兩週後，醫療團隊為了讓呼吸管更加穩固和舒適，會在頸部和氣管做手術，為呼吸管開一個口。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 需要長期使用人工呼吸器的病人可能需要轉到不同的醫院。它可能是一個長期的急症療護醫院（LTAC），或一個專業護理療養院（SNF），或者他們可能需要特殊的居家療護。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 對決定不嘗試人工呼吸器的病人，會有什麼情況？

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: What happens to people who decide NOT to try a ventilator?

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 他們還是可以接受其他的治療。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 預先決定不想嘗試接受人工呼吸器並不表示他們無法得到可能需要的其他治療。這可能包括手術或住進加護病房。總是有方法可以幫助緩解疼痛的。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 可以用其他方式幫助呼吸。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 》詢問有關非侵入性呼吸支援

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 可以用藥物幫助治療呼吸急促

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - 不想接受人工呼吸器的人也應該和他們的醫師討論有關心肺復甦術的議題。因為接受心肺復甦術，通常也需要使用人工呼吸器一段時間。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 他們可能無法延長生命。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 如果人工呼吸器是有須要的卻沒有使用，那麼死亡可能無法被延遲。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 人們如何決定是否要試用人工呼吸器？

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: How do people decide whether or not to try a ventilator?

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 和醫師討論人工呼吸器是否會影響他們的健康及生活品質。考慮利弊決定人工呼吸器是否適合他們。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 和您的醫生和醫療團隊討論：

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - 人工呼吸器如何能幫您達到您的目標，例如恢復到一定程度的健康或功能。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 是否需要短期或長期的使用人工呼吸器。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 人工呼吸器可能會導致什麼樣的傷害。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 使用或不使用人工呼吸器的存活期可能會有多長。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 在使用人工呼吸器期間和之後的生活，會是什麼樣的情況。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 1 概述

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1.1 本文档适用于深圳市易连物联网4G血糖仪模块，接入AiLink应用。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: MCU利用串口（UART）与4G血糖仪模块通信，从而把数据通过网络传输到AiLinkAPP。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 请扫描此二维码下载 AiLink APP。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1.2 本文档描述的4G血糖仪模块，适用于易连物联网的GM02模块。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1.3 本文档适用于使用深圳市易连物联网4G血糖仪模块的客户，接入私有云端服务器以及私有APP应用。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 1.4本文档详细介绍硬件设计、固件对接。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 下文中表明的MCU为与4G血糖仪模块通过UART交互的主控芯片，4G模块则为4G血糖仪模块.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: 2 说明

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 2.1我们提供标准化的蓝牙BLE芯片、蓝牙连接模块、wifi连接模块、4G连接模块、APP、云平台帮助客户快速实现产品智能化，并提供sdk、云平台配置、增值服务和技术支持帮助客户实现差异化、个性化定制。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 2.2 使用4G血糖仪模块，仅需进行精简的硬件电路设计，即可使血糖仪产品方便的接入移动网络，将血糖仪产品的测量结果推送到云端，并在AiLink应用中获取到测量结果。

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 2.3 使用4G血糖仪模块，接入私有云服务器及私有APP应用，请联系我司获取相关服务器配置文档以及4G血糖仪应用端应用手册。

layout_dets.text: 2.4 4G血糖仪模块需要有CID、VID、PID配置参数，其中CID为固定0x002C，VID和PID参数需要客户联系我司进行分配，并且在MCU端必须通过UART发送相关指令进行配置，以使4G血糖仪产品可以接入到AiLink。

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: New Product Announcement

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Garmin is pleased to announce the quadix marine watch. Designed for avid mariners of all types, from dinghy racers and kayakers to big sail and power boaters, quadix is a high-sensitivity GPS navigator marine watch from Garmin – the world's most trusted name in GPS navigation. quadix is the only GPS-enabled device in existence to provide this range of marine navigation features, remote control of Garmin equipment, automatic MOB activation<sup>1</sup> and streaming NMEA 2000 data<sup>1</sup> to a marine watch. This highly accurate watch includes altimeter, barometer, 3-axis compass and temperature sensor, and tide information. Plus sailing features never before combined into one watch, including race countdown timer, virtual starting line and tack assist. It also can share data wirelessly with other compatible Garmin marine products and apps.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - For projectors which audio can be input with the USB cable in the USB Display function, there is no need to connect the audio cable.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - Be sure to connect the projector and the computer directly, not via a USB hub.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Connecting with HDMI Cables

layout_dets.label: 产品图
layout_dets.text: HDMI H

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: If you use a thick HDMI cable, it may disconnect under its own weight. Use the HDMI cable clamp to secure the cable.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - When the projector only has one HDMI port, make sure you connect the HDMI cable to the [HDMI1/MHL] port.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - You may not be able to connect an MHL cable to all devices. Also, depending on the model or settings of the device, images may not be projected correctly.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - When connecting an MHL cable, make sure the cable meets the MHL standards. If the cable does not meet the MHL standard, the connected device may malfunction.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - If you connect using a commercially available MHL-HDMI conversion adapter, you may not be able to charge the connected device or you may not be able to perform operations from the projector's remote control.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - If images are not projected correctly using an MHL cable, disconnect and then reconnect the MHL cable.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - If you switch the HDMI1/MHL source and the HDMI2 source while playing a movie, the movie may freeze. Stop the movie before switching sources.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Troubleshooting

layout_dets.label: 表格
layout_dets.html:
No images appear
Did you turn on the connected device?Turn on the power of the connected device.
Did you turn on the projector?Press the [Projector] button.
Did you press the correct Input Source button for the connected device you want to play?When no specific input source is selected, [Computer1] button is automatically selected and images from the [Computer1] input port are displayed. Press the correct Input Source button corresponding to the connected device.
Did you press the [A/V Mute] button?Press the [A/V Mute] button again.
Is the operation indicator light on ?Orange
?If no operations are made on the Connection & Control Box for eight hours, it enters standby status. Press any button and the indicator turns to ? press the Input Source button.
The source can not be switched
Did you press the correct Input Source button corresponding to the connected device?Press the correct Input Source button.
Is the Message Broadcasting dialog displayed?Press the [Projector] button and restart the projector.
The Connection & Control Box is not operating
Is the power of this product on?Turn on the power switch.
Is the power cable plugged?Plug in the power cable of the Connection & Control Box.
Is the operation indicator flashing ?Blue
?Unplug the power cable of the Connection & Control Box, and contact your dealer.
No sound comes out or the sound is faint
Is the projector's audio input setting correct?Check that the projector's "A/V Settings" or "Audio Input" are correct. ? Projector's user's guide
Did you turn down the audio volume of the projector or speakers too much?Turn up the volume with the [Volume] dial. ? Projector's or Speakers' user's guide.
Is the projector's "MIC Input Level" appropriate?Adjust the input level of the microphone.
Is the audio cable of the connected device correctly connected?Check the connection of the audio cable. ? This manual "Input Ports", Connection & Control Box Installation Manual "Connecting to the Speaker"
Is there a cable connected to the projector's audio output port?If a cable is connected to the projector's audio output port, sound does not come out from the built-in speaker.
Is the Dip switch setting correct?Check the Dip switch setting. ? Connection & Control Box Installation Manual "Connecting to the Speaker"

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Refilling is so easy with Refill Tank System 3 Easy Steps!

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Designed to give you big savings, the new Brother Inkjet Multi-Function Centre DCP-T500W features a new Refill Tank System and offers ink bottles with ultra-high 6,000 page-yield#. You can now maximise your savings and benefit from a smarter design that makes ink refilling effortless!

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Exceedingly Affordable

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Save more with Brother's low cost ink with up to 6,000 page-yield per bottle. Now, high print volume users can reduce overall operating costs with every print.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Moreover, with Brother's original refill ink, you minimise the risk of print head damage. This means less repair and replacement costs on your machine.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Make the most out of your budget and choose Brother's original refill ink. Maximise savings day after day!

layout_dets.label: 图注
layout_dets.text: aReferes to black ink. Colour ink: 5000 page-yield. Quoted approx. yields are extrapolated based on Brother original methodology using Test Patterns ISO/IEC 24712. Quoted approx. yields are not based on ISO/IEC 24711.

layout_dets.label: 图注
layout_dets.text: Open cover Accessing ink tank is so easy with the cover right in front.

layout_dets.label: 图注
layout_dets.text: Refill ink tank. Remove tank cap. Tilt ink bottle at \(45^{\circ}\) angle and gently squeeze it to refill ink tank.

layout_dets.label: 图注
layout_dets.text: You're done! Replace cap and close cover. It's that easy!

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Saves Space and Convenient

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Other printers with external ink tanks usually require additional room for opening and closing the ink tank compartment, as well as for reviewing ink levels.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Brother's Refill Tank System features a smart design with an embedded, front-access ink tank and a see-through cover. This saves space effectively and makes it easy to check how much ink is left.

layout_dets.label: 图名
layout_dets.text: Brother's Smart Design Saves space

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Most conventional printers require users to tilt the ink bottles vertically when refilling, which increases risk of spillage. Brother's smart design allows for refilling at an optimised \(45^{\circ}\) refilling angle. This minimises ink leakage and takes the hassle out of refilling.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Safety instructions

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Your safety is of paramount importance, please ensure you read this instruction book before installing or using this appliance.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: General safety

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - Repairs to the machine must be carried out only by qualified personnel. Repairs carried out by inexperienced persons could cause injury or serious malfunctioning. Contact your local AEG/ELECTROLUX Service Force Centre.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - Never start the machine if the mains cable is damaged or the control panel or worktop are damaged allowing inner components to be accessible.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - Unplug the appliance before carrying out any cleaning or maintenance operations.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - Never pull the mains cable to remove the plug from the socket; always take hold of the plug itself.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - During high temperature wash programmes and during the drying cycle, the door glass may get hot.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - Let the water cool down before carrying out emergency emptying or before opening the door in an emergency.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Installation

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - Follow the installation instructions carefully.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - Carry out a first wash without laundry (COTTONS 95, with half the amount of detergent) in order to remove any manufacturing residue from the tub and the drum.

layout_dets.label: 页眉
layout_dets.text: Safety instructions

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Child safety

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - This appliance is designed to be operated by adults. Children should not be allowed to tamper with the controls or play with the appliance.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - Pets and children have been known to climb into washing machines. Please check the drum before use.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - Keep all packaging well away from children.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - Keep all detergents in a safe place out of children's reach.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - When disposing of the appliance, cut off the mains cable, and destroy the plug. Disable the door catch to prevent young children being trapped inside.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: During use

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - Always unplug the appliance and turn off the water tap after use.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - This appliance is designed for domestic use only. If the machine is used for any other purposes or is not used correctly, the manufacturer accepts no responsibility for any possible damage that might occur.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - For safety reasons, the appliance must not be modified.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - Use only detergents suitable for washing machines and follow the manufacturer's instructions.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - Garments which have been in contact with flammable solvents should not be machine washed.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - Dyes and bleaching agents may only be used if specifically permitted by the manufacturer of these products. We cannot be held liable for any damage.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Disposal

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Packaging materials

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The materials marked with the symbol are recyclable.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: >PE<=polyethylene

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: >PS<=polystyrene

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: >PP<=polypropylene

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: This means that they can be recycled by disposing of them properly in appropriate collection containers.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Machine

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Use authorised disposal sites for your old appliance. Help to keep your country tidy!

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The symbol \(\mathbb{N}\) on the product or on its packaging indicates that this product may not be treated as household waste. Instead it shall be handed over to the applicable collection point for the recycling of electrical and electronic equipment. By ensuring this product is disposed of correctly, you will help prevent potential negative consequences for the environment and human health, which could otherwise be caused by inappropriate waste handling of this product. For more detailed information about recycling of this product, please contact your local city office, your household waste disposal service or the shop where you purchased the product.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Tips for environmental protection

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: To save water, energy and to help protect the environment, we recommend that you follow these tips:

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - Normally soiled laundry may be washed without prewashing in order to save detergent, water and time (the environment is protected too!).

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - Use the energy saving programme when washing normally soiled garments.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - The machine works more economically if it is fully loaded (for both washing and drying cycles).

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - When small loads are washed, use only half to two thirds of the recommended amount of detergent.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - The machine will consume less energy if the laundry is adequately spun before being dried.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - With adequate pre-treatment, stains and limited soiling can be removed; the laundry can then be washed at a lower temperature.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Main features of your washer-dryer

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - Programme and temperature setting using the programme selector.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - Stain option for effectively treating stained washing.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - Energy saving programme for normally soiled cotton items.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - SOAK programme for heavy soiled items. The machine performs a soak at \(30^{\circ}\mathrm{C}\). By pressing the DELAY START button the soak time can be prolonged up to 10 hours max. This programme cannot be used with WOOL programme. The Soak programme ends with water in the tub. Before selecting the desired washing programme, drain the water setting the drain programme.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - Speed for the final spin can be reduced to 900, 700 or 500 rpm.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - RINSE HOLD: the laundry is left immersed in the final rinse water to prevent creasing.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - DELAY START (delayed start): programme start can be delayed by 30 minutes to 23 hours (e.g. to times with a more economical power rate).

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - Programme progress display showing the programme steps selected and the programme phase which is running.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - Because of its gentle washing action, the special wool cycle washes your garments with extreme care.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - The drying programmes will enable you to have dry and soft laundry in a short time.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - 3-compartment drawer for detergent and fabric softener.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - Unbalance detection device: to prevent vibration during spinning.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Programme selector dial

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The programme selector determines the type of washing cycle (e.g. water level, drum movement, number of rinses, spin speed), the washing temperature and enables the required drying programme to be selected according to the type of laundry.

layout_dets.label: 产品图
layout_dets.text: L 12710 VIT COTTON MINPROGRAMM SPIN 95 60 E DRAIN 50 SOFT NER 60 FOGS RINSES 60 SOAK 30 COLD 30 WOOL 40 30 30 40 50 EASY-CARE DELICATES DRYING

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The selector is divided into 5 sections:

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Cotton

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: - Easy-cares (Synthetics)

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Delicates

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: · Woollens (hand washing)

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: · Special programmes

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The selector dial can be turned either clockwise or anticlockwise.

layout_dets.label: 页眉
layout_dets.text: Description of the appliance

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Position 60E corresponds to the ENERGY SAVING programme for normally soiled laundry, extended washing time. The washing temperature will decrease (cannot be combined with QUICK).

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Position DRYING = drying phase;

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Position COLD = cold wash.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: ON/OFF button

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Press this button to switch the machine on. Press it again to switch the machine off.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Mains-on light

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: This light comes on when the ON/OFF button is pressed, and goes out when it is pressed again.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: START/PAUSE button

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: This button has two functions:

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: a) Start

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: After having selected the required programme, press this button to start the machine. The relevant pilot light stops flashing and remains static. If you have selected the DELAY START option, the machine starts its hourly countdown.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: b) Pause

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: To interrupt a programme which is running, press the START/PAUSE button: the information on the display remains lit and the START/PAUSE pilot light starts to flash.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: To restart the programme from the point at which it was interrupted, press the START/PAUSE button again.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: DELAY START button

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The wash programme can be delayed from 30, 60, 90 minutes and then 1 hour by 1 hour up to a maximum of 23 hours.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The button must be pressed after selecting the programme and before pressing the START/PAUSE button.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The figures indicating the delay appear for about 3 seconds in the display. The duration of the selected wash programme is then displayed. After depressing the START/PAUSE button, the machine starts its hourly countdown.

layout_dets.label: 页眉
layout_dets.text: Description of the appliance

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: To annul the preset delay, press the START/PAUSE button, then press the DELAY START button until the symbol 0'is displayed.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Then press the START/PAUSE button again to restart the programme.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: DRYING TIME button

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: If you wish to carry out a timed programme of dryness push the button until the drying time you want appears in the display according to the fabrics (cotton or easy cares) you have to dry.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: For COTTON and EASY CARES you can select a drying time from 10 minutes to 130 minutes.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: In automatic washing and drying programme the drying time is displayed for 3 seconds, then the duration of the programme will appear.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Programme Option buttons

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Depending on the programme, different functions can be combined. These must be selected after choosing the desired programme and before depressing the START/PAUSE button.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: When these buttons are pressed, the corresponding pilot lights come on. When they are pressed again, the pilot lights go out.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: When an incorrect option is selected, the button light flashes for 2 seconds and in the display the Err message appears.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: SPIN SPEED

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Press this button to reduce the maximum speed of the final speed proposed by the machine for the selected programme or to select RINSE HOLD option. The maximum spin speed for cotton is 1400 rpm (for L14710VIT), 1200 rpm (for L12710VIT), for easy cares, wool 900 rpm and for delicates and Miniprogramm 700 rpm.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: RINSE HOLD

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: By selecting this option, the last rinse water is not emptied out, to prevent the fabrics from creasing. When the programme has finished, the pilot light END on the programme progress display illuminates and the Door will be locked to indicate that the water must be emptied out.
